    if (st.name.length > 15) E('Patch name is longer than 15 characters.');
    const cpu = cpuTotal(st);
    // 0.443: an overloaded ZOIA does not refuse the patch, it freezes (save-back test 2026-10-14: 'Cover Z10', about 150 %).
    // 0.460 (user 2026-10-16): users report that 100 % on the display is a safe margin and a ZOIA runs fine up to 104-105 %.
    // From 90 %: close to the limit; from 105 %: will probably not run without dropouts or stutter; from 120 %: may crash the
    // device when it is loaded. Always warnings, never errors: the estimate can be off by several points, export always works.
    { const dv = cpuDev(st), on = dv === 'euro' ? 'the Euroburo' : 'the ZOIA';
      const tier = (load, dev) => load >= CPU_CRASH ? 'The patch may crash ' + dev + ' when it is loaded. Remove or simplify modules.'
        : 'The patch will probably not run on ' + dev + ' without dropouts or stutter. Remove or simplify modules.';
      if (cpu >= CPU_OVER) Wn('Estimated CPU load on ' + on + ' is ' + cpu.toFixed(1) + ' %. ' + tier(cpu, on));
      else if (cpu >= CPU_CAUTION) Wn('Estimated CPU load on ' + on + ' is ' + cpu.toFixed(1) + ' %, which is close to the limit, check the CPU on the device to be safe.');
      // a patch without Euroburo hardware can also go to a Euroburo, which needs about 11 % more
      else if (deviceOf(st) === 'any' && cpu * CPU_EURO >= CPU_OVER) Wn('Estimated CPU load is ' + cpu.toFixed(1) + ' % on a ZOIA, but about ' + (cpu * CPU_EURO).toFixed(0) + ' % on a Euroburo. ' + tier(cpu * CPU_EURO, 'a Euroburo'));
      else if (deviceOf(st) === 'any' && cpu * CPU_EURO >= CPU_CAUTION) Wn('Estimated CPU load is ' + cpu.toFixed(1) + ' % on a ZOIA, but about ' + (cpu * CPU_EURO).toFixed(0) + ' % on a Euroburo, close to its limit. Check the CPU on the Euroburo to be safe.'); }
    if (!st.modules.length) I('The patch has no modules yet.');
    // early Euroburo firmware (1 "Ready to Go" PatchStorage patch): the hardware modules sit on page 0 at grid button 45-59, and
    // pushbuttons 1-2 and CV Out 1-3 use type numbers that mean other modules today (Pushbutton, Midi Clock Out, Tap to CV, Midi Pitch Bend)
    const legacy0 = st.modules.some((m) => isEuro(m.type) && m.page === 0 && m.pos === EURO_POS[m.type]);
    if (legacy0) I('Saved by an early Euroburo version: the jacks and buttons sit on page 0 behind grid button 40. Pushbuttons 1-2 and CV Out 1-3 were stored with type numbers that mean other modules today, so ZoE shows them as pushbutton, midi clock out, tap to cv and midi pitch bend. A current Euroburo does not load modules stored this way: these jacks and buttons and their connections are left out. Add them again from the Hardware tab and reconnect them.');
    if (st.droppedConns) I(st.droppedConns + ' connection' + (st.droppedConns > 1 ? 's' : '') + ' in the file pointed at modules that do not exist and ' + (st.droppedConns > 1 ? 'were' : 'was') + ' removed.');
    if (deviceOf(st) === 'mixed') I('The patch uses ZOIA-only modules (footswitch, control port or device control) and Euroburo-only modules. On the Euroburo, stompswitch modules output a constant 0 (confirmed on the device). On the ZOIA the patch loads, and Euroburo pushbuttons output their stored state (confirmed on the device).');
    const byUid = new Map(st.modules.map((m) => [m.uid, m]));
    // ZOIA control port: one TRS jack on the back, set in the Config Menu (CPort) to one function: expression pedal, CV (0 to 5 V), MIDI or an external switch
    const cpUse = (m) => m.type === 54 ? 'in' : m.type === 55 ? 'out' : m.type === STOMP && Z.mod(STOMP).o[0][1][m.options[0] || 0] === 'ext' ? 'ext' : null;
    const cpExt = st.modules.filter((m) => cpUse(m) === 'ext'), cpIn = st.modules.filter((m) => cpUse(m) === 'in'), cpOut = st.modules.filter((m) => cpUse(m) === 'out');
    if (cpExt.length && (cpIn.length || cpOut.length)) Wn(cpExt.map(label).join(', ') + ' and ' + cpIn.concat(cpOut).map(label).join(', ') + ' need the control port on the back, which does one thing at a time (CPort in the Config Menu). Only the one CPort is set for will work, so they can only be alternatives.', cpExt[0].uid);
    for (const m of cpIn) I(label(m) + ' reads the control port on the back. Set CPort in the Config Menu to exp (expression pedal) or cv (0 to 5 V)' + (cpOut.length ? '; together with ' + cpOut.map(label).join(', ') + ' it has to be cv (CV in on the tip, CV out on the ring).' : '.'), m.uid);
    for (const m of cpOut) I(label(m) + ' sends 0 to 5 V on the ring of the control port on the back. Set CPort in the Config Menu to cv.', m.uid);
    for (const m of cpExt) I(label(m) + ' reads an external footswitch on the control port on the back. Set CPort in the Config Menu to the external switch.', m.uid);
    // 0.474 (user 2026-10-17): one warning in the Patch Inspector for pages above 63 (the device has pages 0–63; its loader skips
    // modules on page 64 or higher, firmware 5.41), instead of one per module. Euroburo hardware on page 127 is not affected.
    { const isHw = (m) => isEuro(m.type) || (legacy0 && m.page === 0 && m.pos >= 44 && m.pos <= 58);
      const hi = st.modules.filter((m) => !isHw(m) && m.page > 63), P = [...new Set(hi.map((m) => m.page).concat((st.pages || []).map((_, i) => i).filter((i) => i > 63)))].sort((a, b) => a - b);
      if (P.length) { const one = P.length === 1, lst = P.length > 2 ? P.slice(0, -1).join(', ') + ' and ' + P[P.length - 1] : P.join(' and ');
        Wn((one ? 'Page ' : 'Pages ') + lst + (one ? ' does' : ' do') + ' not exist on the device (it has pages 0 to 63), so ' + (one ? 'it' : 'they') + ' cannot be loaded'
          + (hi.length ? ': ' + (one ? 'its ' : 'their ') + hi.length + ' module' + (hi.length > 1 ? 's' : '') + ' and ' + (hi.length > 1 ? 'their' : 'its') + ' connections are left out.' : '.'), hi.length ? hi[0].uid : undefined); } }
    for (const m of st.modules) {
      const n = visible(m).length;
      if (!MOD_NAME_OK.test(m.name)) { if (untouched(m)) I('Module name [' + shown(m.name) + '] contains characters ZoE cannot type (stored that way by the device; kept unchanged on export).', m.uid); else E('Module name [' + shown(m.name) + '] contains invalid characters.', m.uid); }
      Z.mod(m.type).o.forEach(([on, vals], i) => { if ((m.options[i] | 0) >= vals.length) E(label(m) + ': option "' + optLabel(m.type, i) + '" has an unknown value (' + m.options[i] + '). Choose a valid value before exporting.', m.uid); });
      if (m.name.length > 15) E('Module name [' + m.name + '] is longer than 15 characters.', m.uid);
      { const d = Z.mod(m.type), okDs = [0, d.ds || 0, m.type === 69 ? 8 : -1, m.type === 106 ? 8 : -1 /* Reverse Delay version 0 (older patches) */].concat(m.type === 4 ? [572, 576, 4156, seqDs(m)] : []); if (!okDs.includes(m.ds)) E(label(m) + ': stored state has an unexpected size (' + m.ds + ' bytes). This module was not written by the device; delete it and add it again.', m.uid); }
      const hw = isEuro(m.type) || (legacy0 && m.page === 0 && m.pos >= 44 && m.pos <= 58); // Euroburo hardware sits outside the grid
      // the device's loader (firmware 5.41) skips normal modules on page 64 or higher and at grid button 41 or higher, with their connections
      if (!hw && m.page < 64 && m.pos > 39) Wn(name(m) + ': grid button ' + (m.pos + 1) + ' does not exist (1–40). The device does not load this module, nor its connections. Click a grid button in the inspector to move it.', m.uid);
      // 0.461 (user 2026-10-16): a module that runs past the end of its page is shown in its Module Inspector (section "Page End"), not here
      if (UNVERIFIED.has(m.type)) Wn(Z.mod(m.type).n + ' is not verified by any factory patch. Test it on the device before relying on it.', m.uid);
      // stored parameter count differs from what the firmware uses for these options (older firmware): more values are harmless
      // (the device's loader reads the ones it needs and skips the rest), fewer cannot be judged from the firmware data
      if (m.lockedParams && !hw) {
        const have = m.lockedParams.length, want = Z.paramBlocks(m.type, m.version, m.options).length, vs = (n) => n + ' parameter value' + (n === 1 ? '' : 's');
        const head = label(m) + ' stores ' + vs(have) + '; for its options the device uses ' + want + '. ZoE keeps the values unchanged and locks the module\'s options, so nothing shifts. ';
        if (have > want) I(head + 'The device loads it and ignores the extra value' + (have - want === 1 ? '' : 's') + '. To edit the options, delete the module and add it again.', m.uid);
        else Wn(head + 'Check this module on the device: its values may not be what you expect. To edit the options, delete the module and add it again.', m.uid);
      }
    }
    // 0.458 (user 2026-10-16): module overlap is no longer a check of the patch; the Module Inspector of a covered module shows it
    // in its own section "Module Overlay" (overlapOf below)
    const seen = new Set();
    // Euroburo hardware modules: one per jack/button, at its fixed position
    const hwSeen = {};
    for (const m of st.modules) {
      if (!isEuro(m.type)) continue;
      if (hwSeen[m.type]) Wn(label(m) + ' exists twice. The Euroburo has only one of this jack/button.', m.uid); hwSeen[m.type] = 1;
      const want = EURO_POS[m.type];
      if (!euroHwOk(m)) Wn(label(m) + ' is not at its fixed position (' + want + '). The Euroburo will probably not link it to its jack. Delete it and add it again.', m.uid);
    }
    for (const k of st.conns) {
      const a = byUid.get(k.sm), b = byUid.get(k.dm);
      if (!a || !b) { E('A connection points to a deleted module.'); continue; }
      const sb = Z.mod(a.type).b.find((x) => x[1] === k.sb), db = Z.mod(b.type).b.find((x) => x[1] === k.db);
      if (!sb || !sb[2].endsWith('_out')) E('Connection from ' + label(a) + ': block ' + k.sb + ' is not an output.', a.uid);
      if (!db || !db[2].endsWith('_in')) E('Connection to ' + label(b) + ': block ' + k.db + ' is not an input.', b.uid);
      for (const [m, pos, side] of [[a, k.sb, 'output'], [b, k.db, 'input']]) {
        if (visible(m).some((x) => x.pos === pos)) continue;
        Wn('Connection ' + label(a) + ' → ' + label(b) + ' ends at a hidden block.' + hiddenWhy(m, pos, side), m.uid);
      }
      if (sb && db && sb[2].startsWith('audio') !== db[2].startsWith('audio')) Wn('Connection ' + label(a) + ' → ' + label(b) + ' joins audio and CV. The ZOIA only connects audio to audio and CV to CV.', b.uid);
      const key = [k.sm, k.sb, k.dm, k.db].join();
      if (seen.has(key)) Wn('Duplicate connection ' + label(a) + ' → ' + label(b) + '.', b.uid); seen.add(key);
    }
    // 0.434: one CC on several starred parameters moves them together (a macro knob, used on purpose e.g. in Temperance): a note naming them
    const ccs = {};
    for (const s of liveStars(st)) if (s.cc >= 0) (ccs[s.cc] = ccs[s.cc] || []).push(s);
    const starWhat = (s) => {
      if (s.conn) { const c = st.conns.find((x) => x.uid === s.conn), a = byUid.get(c.sm), b = byUid.get(c.dm); return { uid: c.dm, t: 'the cable ' + label(a) + ' → ' + label(b) }; }
      const m = byUid.get(s.m), blk = visible(m).find((x) => x.pos === s.b);
      return { uid: m.uid, t: label(m) + (blk ? ' “' + blockLabel(m, blk.name) + '”' : '') };
    };
    for (const [cc, L] of Object.entries(ccs)) {
      if (L.length < 2) continue; const W = L.map(starWhat), list = W.length > 2 ? W.slice(0, -1).map((w) => w.t).join(', ') + ' and ' + W[W.length - 1].t : W[0].t + ' and ' + W[1].t;
      I('MIDI CC ' + cc + ' moves ' + L.length + ' parameters at once: ' + list + '. Fine when one knob should move them together; otherwise give each its own CC.', W[0].uid);
    }
    // 0.428: the device's starred list shows the module name cut to 5 characters, then the block name cut to 6
    // ("Rever|decay", "Rever|number", tested on a ZOIA): two starred modules whose names start alike are hard to tell apart there
    { const by5 = new Map(); for (const x of st.stars) { if (!x.m) continue; const m = byUid.get(x.m); if (!m) continue; const k = starName(m); if (!by5.has(k)) by5.set(k, new Set()); by5.get(k).add(m); }
      for (const [k, ms] of by5) if (ms.size > 1) I('In the device\'s starred list the module name is cut to 5 characters: ' + [...ms].map(label).join(', ') + ' all show as “' + k + '|…”. Give them names that differ in the first 5 characters.', [...ms][0].uid); }
    const hidStar = new Set(); for (const x of st.stars) { if (!x.m || hidStar.has(x.m)) continue; const m = byUid.get(x.m); if (m && !visible(m).some((b) => b.pos === x.b)) hidStar.add(x.m), Wn('A star on ' + label(m) + ' points to a parameter its options hide (e.g. quantizer key/scale need "key scale jacks: yes"). Turn the option on or remove the star.', m.uid); }
    // Unfiltered Euroburo CV In used as an on/off signal. Rule: warn when the jack's signal reaches an input that expects 0 or 1
    // (gate, trigger, clock, tap, reset, logic input, two-way selector), directly or through modules that pass CV on unchanged
    // in kind. Smoothing modules (Slew Limiter, CV Filter, Sample and Hold) end the path. If the same jack also feeds an analog
    // input, the filter would spoil that use: then the advice is a separate CV In for the on/off signal.
    for (const a of st.modules) {
      if (a.type < 88 || a.type > 91 || a.options[2] !== 0) continue;
      const bin = [], ana = [], seen = new Set([a.uid]); let q = [[a, null]];
      while (q.length) { const nq = [];
        for (const [src, via] of q) for (const c of st.conns) { if (c.sm !== src.uid) continue; const b = byUid.get(c.dm); if (!b) continue;
          const bx = Z.mod(b.type).b.find((x) => x[1] === c.db), bn = bx ? blockLabel(b, bx[0]) : '?';
          if (isGateInput(b, c.db)) bin.push({ b, bn, via });
          else if (CV_PASS.has(b.type)) { if (!seen.has(b.uid)) { seen.add(b.uid); nq.push([b, via || b]); } }
          else if (b.type !== 81) ana.push({ b, bn }); } // a Pixel only shows the signal: not an analog use
        q = nq; }
      if (!bin.length) continue;
      const t = bin[0], where = 'the ' + t.bn + ' of ' + label(t.b) + (t.via ? ' (through ' + label(t.via) + ')' : '');
      if (ana.length) Wn(label(a) + ' drives ' + where + ' and also ' + ana.slice(0, 2).map((x) => 'the ' + x.bn + ' of ' + label(x.b)).join(' and ') + '. A noise filter would spoil the continuous signal, so an unplugged or noisy jack can cause random triggers here. Use a separate CV In for the on/off signal and set its “clk filter” to 1,4 or higher.', a.uid);
      else Wn(label(a) + ' drives ' + where + ' without a noise filter. An unplugged or noisy jack then causes random triggers, recommended to set “clk filter” to 1,4 or higher.', a.uid);
    }
    for (const m of st.modules) { const sf = samplerFile(m); if (sf) I(label(m) + ' plays the sample file ' + sf.file + (sf.folder ? ' from the folder ' + sf.folder : '') + '.', m.uid); }
    sideCheck(st, I, label);
    wiringChecks(st, Wn, I, label);
    phaseChecks(st, Wn, label);
    return out;
  }
  // 0.454 (user 2026-10-15): every audio module in series delays the signal by one block of 64 samples, 1.33 ms (Empress). Where two
  // paths of the same signal meet again (two cables into one input, or the inputs of a mixer or balance that go to the same output)
  // and one path has more modules, the two arrive 1.33 ms per module apart and cancel some frequencies (comb filter). A buffer delay
  // in the shorter path aligns them. Not checked: paths through effects that delay or modulate on purpose (delays, reverbs, chorus,
  // flanger, phaser, vibrato, pitch shifter, all-pass, looper, granular, sampler), audio in switches (they pick one input),
  // multiplying inputs (audio multiply, bit modulator, ring modulator), the FM input of an oscillator, paths that meet at the input of
  // one of those effects (a send into a reverb or delay), feedback through the module itself, and paths from different outputs of an
  // audio out switch (only one of them carries the signal). A path also ends at an oscillator (its FM input) and at the multiplying
  // modules: what comes out is a new signal, not a delayed copy. Sidechain inputs are not followed (they only steer the module).
  const PH_TIME = new Set([13, 25, 27, 29, 30, 43, 59, 67, 69, 70, 71, 74, 75, 78, 79, 80, 83, 102, 106, 107]);
  const PH_SKIP = new Set([33, 8, 63, 73, 12, 36, 58, 81]), PH_NEW = new Set([14, 8, 63, 73]);
  const BLOCK_MS = 64000 / 48000;
  function phaseChecks(st, Wn, label) {
    const byUid = new Map(st.modules.filter((m) => m.page < 64 || isEuro(m.type)).map((m) => [m.uid, m]));
    const blk = (m, pos) => Z.mod(m.type).b.find((x) => x[1] === pos);
    const into = new Map(); // module uid -> audio cables into it
    for (const c of st.conns) { const a = byUid.get(c.sm), b = byUid.get(c.dm); if (!a || !b) continue;
      const sb = blk(a, c.sb), db = blk(b, c.db); if (!sb || !db || sb[2] !== 'audio_out' || db[2] !== 'audio_in' || db[0] === 'sidechain_in') continue; // a sidechain only steers
      (into.get(b.uid) || into.set(b.uid, []).get(b.uid)).push({ c, a, name: db[0] }); }
    const lat = (m) => m.type === 26 ? (m.options[0] | 0) + 1 : 1;
    // every module the signal at the output of p comes from, with the number of blocks from that module's output to the input of M
    const origins = (p, M) => { const res = new Map(), seen = new Set(); let q = [[p, 0]], steps = 0;
      while (q.length && steps < 4000) { const nq = [];
        for (const [u, L] of q) { steps++; const k = u.uid + ',' + L; if (seen.has(k)) continue; seen.add(k);
          if (u.uid !== M.uid) (res.get(u.uid) || res.set(u.uid, new Set()).get(u.uid)).add(L);
          if (u.uid === M.uid || u.type === -34 || PH_TIME.has(u.type) || PH_NEW.has(u.type) || L > 64) continue;
          for (const x of into.get(u.uid) || []) nq.push([x.a.type === 34 ? { uid: x.a.uid + '#' + x.c.sb, type: -34 } : x.a, L + lat(u)]); }
        q = nq; }
      return res; };
    for (const [uid, list] of into) {
      const M = byUid.get(uid); if (PH_SKIP.has(M.type) || PH_TIME.has(M.type) || M.type === 14) continue;
      const mix = M.type === 76 || M.type === 64, grp = new Map();
      for (const x of list) { const g = mix ? x.name.replace(/^audio_in_\d+/, '') : x.name; (grp.get(g) || grp.set(g, []).get(g)).push(x); }
      let best = null;
      for (const L of grp.values()) {
        const src = []; for (const x of L) if (!src.some((y) => y.c.sm === x.c.sm && y.c.sb === x.c.sb)) src.push(x);
        if (src.length < 2) continue;
        const O = src.map((x) => origins(x.a, M));
        for (let i = 0; i < src.length; i++) for (let j = i + 1; j < src.length; j++) for (const [A, S1] of O[i]) {
          const S2 = O[j].get(A); if (!S2 || [...S1].some((v) => S2.has(v))) continue;
          let d = Infinity, sh = null; for (const v of S1) for (const w of S2) if (Math.abs(v - w) < d) { d = Math.abs(v - w); sh = v < w ? src[i] : src[j]; }
          const near = Math.min(...S1) + Math.min(...S2);
          if (!best || near < best.near) best = { near, d, A: byUid.get(String(A).split('#')[0]) || byUid.get(+String(A).split('#')[0]), sh }; }
      }
      if (!best) continue;
      const n = best.d, from = best.sh.a.uid === best.A.uid ? 'the cable from ' + label(best.A) : 'the path through ' + label(best.sh.a);
      Wn(label(M) + ' mixes the signal of ' + label(best.A) + ' over two paths that differ by ' + n + ' module' + (n > 1 ? 's' : '') + ' (' + (n * BLOCK_MS).toFixed(1) + ' ms). Every audio module in series delays the signal by 1.33 ms, so the two can cancel some frequencies. Unless you want that, put a buffer delay with buffer length ' + n + ' in ' + from + '.', M.uid);
    }
  }
  // 0.427/0.458: module overlap. The later module in the patch covers the earlier one on the grid. For a module: the grid buttons
  // it covers, the ones covered by later modules (with those modules) and whether it is covered completely (then it cannot be seen
  // or reached on the device)
  function overlapOf(st, m) {
    if (m.page === EURO_PAGE || isEuro(m.type) || m.page > 63) return null;
    const occ = occupancy(st, m.page), cells = []; for (let c = m.pos; c < m.pos + visible(m).length && c < 40; c++) cells.push(c);
    const under = cells.filter((c) => occ[c].length && occ[c][occ[c].length - 1] !== m.uid);
    if (!under.length) return null;
    const by = new Map(); for (const c of under) { const u = occ[c][occ[c].length - 1]; (by.get(u) || by.set(u, []).get(u)).push(c); }
    return { cells, under, full: under.length === cells.length, over: [...by].map(([u, cs]) => ({ m: st.modules.find((x) => x.uid === u), cells: cs })).filter((x) => x.m) };
  }
  // 0.431: modules without connections (note), inputs a module needs (warning), chains that lead nowhere (one warning per chain)
  // a CV module whose CV output button can be seen on the grid (page 0-63, within the 40 buttons, not covered by a later module)
  function lightsOutput(m, st) {
    const d = Z.mod(m.type); if (d.b.some((x) => x[2] === 'audio_out') || m.page > 63 || isEuro(m.type)) return false;
    const v = visible(m), ov = overlapOf(st, m), under = new Set(ov ? ov.under : []);
    return v.some((b, i) => { const k = d.b.find((x) => x[0] === b.name); return k && k[2] === 'cv_out' && m.pos + i < 40 && !under.has(m.pos + i); });
  }
  function wiringChecks(st, Wn, I, label) {
    const mods = st.modules.filter((m) => m.page < 64 || isEuro(m.type)), byUid = new Map(mods.map((m) => [m.uid, m]));
    const conns = st.conns.filter((c) => byUid.has(c.sm) && byUid.has(c.dm));
    const cin = new Map(), cout = new Map();
    for (const c of conns) { (cin.get(c.dm) || cin.set(c.dm, []).get(c.dm)).push(c); (cout.get(c.sm) || cout.set(c.sm, []).get(c.sm)).push(c); }
    const starred = new Set(st.stars.filter((x) => x.m).map((x) => x.m + ':' + x.b)), starMod = new Set(st.stars.filter((x) => x.m).map((x) => x.m));
    const W = new Map(mods.map((m) => [m.uid, wiringOf(m)]));
    const pos = (m, n) => { const b = visible(m).find((x) => x.name === n); return b ? b.pos : -1; };
    const driven = (m, n) => { const p = pos(m, n); return p < 0 || (cin.get(m.uid) || []).some((c) => c.db === p) || starred.has(m.uid + ':' + p); };
    const wired = (m) => cin.has(m.uid) || cout.has(m.uid);
    // 1. no connection at all: a leftover (Euroburo hardware sits in every Euroburo patch; a starred module is a prepared control)
    const loose = mods.filter((m) => !wired(m) && !isEuro(m.type) && !starMod.has(m.uid) && W.get(m.uid).cls !== 'standalone');
    if (loose.length) I(loose.length + (loose.length > 1 ? ' modules have' : ' module has') + ' no connection and ' + (loose.length > 1 ? 'do' : 'does') + ' nothing: ' + loose.slice(0, 8).map(label).join(', ') + (loose.length > 8 ? ' and ' + (loose.length - 8) + ' more' : '') + '.', loose[0].uid);
    // 2. a wired module without the input it needs
    for (const m of mods) {
      if (!wired(m)) continue; const w = W.get(m.uid);
      if (!w.needs.length || w.needs.some((alt) => alt.every((n) => driven(m, n)))) continue;
      // 0.484 (ZOIA test 2026-10-17): random with "new val on trig" and no trigger outputs one fixed value all the time
      if (m.type === 39) { Wn(label(m) + ' only makes a new value when “' + blockLabel(m, 'trigger_in') + '” gets a signal. Without one it outputs the same fixed value all the time. Connect a signal or star the input, or set “new val on trig” to off for values that keep changing.', m.uid); continue; }
      const names = w.needs.map((alt) => alt.map((n) => '“' + blockLabel(m, n) + '”').join(' and '));
      const what = w.cls === 'audio' ? 'gets no audio' : 'gets no signal at ' + names.join(' or ');
      Wn(label(m) + ' ' + what + ', so it does nothing. ' + (w.cls === 'audio' ? 'Connect a signal to ' + names.join(' or ') + '.' : 'Connect a signal or star the input.'), m.uid);
    }
    // 3. chains that lead nowhere: nothing in them reaches a sound, a light, a CV or MIDI output or a device action
    // 0.459 (user 2026-10-16, DFAM review): a value module whose input gets a signal and whose output is free is a display (its grid
    // button follows the signal) or a patch-bay socket to be patched on the device: it counts as an end, not as leading nowhere
    const eff = new Set(mods.filter((m) => { const w = W.get(m.uid); return w.cls === 'standalone' || w.cls === 'sink' || w.out === 'optional' || (m.type === 45 && cin.has(m.uid) && !cout.has(m.uid)); }).map((m) => m.uid));
    for (let grow = true; grow;) { grow = false; for (const c of conns) if (eff.has(c.dm) && !eff.has(c.sm)) { eff.add(c.sm); grow = true; } }
    const dead = mods.filter((m) => wired(m) && !eff.has(m.uid)), deadSet = new Set(dead.map((m) => m.uid)), done = new Set();
    for (const m of dead) {
      if (done.has(m.uid)) continue;
      // one chain = the dead modules joined by cables
      const grp = [], stack = [m.uid];
      while (stack.length) { const u = stack.pop(); if (done.has(u)) continue; done.add(u); grp.push(byUid.get(u));
        for (const c of (cin.get(u) || []).concat(cout.get(u) || [])) { const v = c.sm === u ? c.dm : c.sm; if (deadSet.has(v) && !done.has(v)) stack.push(v); } }
      const ends = grp.filter((x) => !(cout.get(x.uid) || []).length);
      const end = ends[0] || grp[grp.length - 1];
      grp.sort((a, b) => (a.page - b.page) || (a.pos - b.pos));
      // 0.482 (ZOIA test 2026-10-17, user): a CV output without a cable still lights its grid button with its value, so a chain
      // that ends only at such visible CV outputs is a note, not a warning (it may be a display, or a cable may be missing)
      const shows = ends.length && ends.every((x) => lightsOutput(x, st));
      if (shows) {
        if (grp.length === 1) I(label(end) + ': its output has no cable; only its grid button shows the value.', end.uid);
        else I('A chain of ' + grp.length + ' modules ends at ' + (ends.length > 1 ? ends.slice(0, 3).map(label).join(' and ') : label(end)) + ' without a cable: ' + grp.slice(0, 5).map(label).join(', ') + (grp.length > 5 ? ' and ' + (grp.length - 5) + ' more' : '') + '. Only the grid button' + (ends.length > 1 ? 's show' : ' shows') + ' the value.', end.uid);
        continue;
      }
      if (grp.length === 1) Wn(label(end) + ': its output is not connected, so what it does goes nowhere.', end.uid);
      else Wn('A chain of ' + grp.length + ' modules leads nowhere: ' + grp.slice(0, 5).map(label).join(', ') + (grp.length > 5 ? ' and ' + (grp.length - 5) + ' more' : '') + '. Nothing in it reaches a sound, a light, a CV or MIDI output. It ends at ' + (ends.length > 1 ? ends.slice(0, 3).map(label).join(' and ') : label(end)) + '.', end.uid);
    }
  }

  // ---- arrange by signal flow --------------------------------------------------------------
  // Columns follow the audio signal (left to right); pure CV modules sit in a band below the
  // audio chain, one column before the module they drive. Feedback edges are ignored for the
  // column depth. Independent groups are placed one below the other; modules without connections go to the bottom.
  function signalLayout(st) {
    const GAPX = NODE_W + 90, GAPY = 26, BAND = 70, COLCAP = 2000; // COLCAP: max column height in px, taller columns continue in the next column
    const mods = st.modules, byId = new Map(mods.map((m) => [m.uid, m]));
    const kindOf = (m, pos) => { const b = Z.mod(m.type).b.find((x) => x[1] === pos); return b && b[2].startsWith('audio') ? 'a' : 'c'; };
    const hasAudio = (m) => visible(m).some((b) => b.type.startsWith('audio'));
    const edges = st.conns.filter((c) => byId.has(c.sm) && byId.has(c.dm) && c.sm !== c.dm)
      .map((c) => ({ s: c.sm, d: c.dm, k: kindOf(byId.get(c.sm), c.sb) }));
    const linked = new Set(); edges.forEach((e) => { linked.add(e.s); linked.add(e.d); });
    // connected components (undirected)
    const nb = new Map(mods.map((m) => [m.uid, []])); edges.forEach((e) => { nb.get(e.s).push(e.d); nb.get(e.d).push(e.s); });
    const comp = new Map(); const comps = [];
    for (const m of mods) {
      if (comp.has(m.uid) || !linked.has(m.uid)) continue;
      const list = [], stack = [m.uid]; comp.set(m.uid, comps.length);
      while (stack.length) { const u = stack.pop(); list.push(byId.get(u)); for (const v of nb.get(u)) if (!comp.has(v)) { comp.set(v, comps.length); stack.push(v); } }
      comps.push(list);
    }
    const order = (a, b) => (a.page - b.page) || (a.pos - b.pos);
    comps.forEach((c) => c.sort(order)); comps.sort((a, b) => b.length - a.length || order(a[0], b[0]));
    const OUT_TYPES = new Set([2, 95, 96]); // audio outputs: always last column
    const boxes = []; // one laid-out box per connected group, packed side by side afterwards (step 5)
    for (const list of comps) {
      let y0 = 0;
      const ids = new Set(list.map((m) => m.uid)), E = edges.filter((e) => ids.has(e.s));
      let aud = list.filter(hasAudio), cvs = list.filter((m) => !hasAudio(m));
      const pureCV = !aud.length; if (pureCV) { aud = list; cvs = []; } // a group without audio: lay out its CV flow as the main line
      const audIds = new Set(aud.map((m) => m.uid));
      const col = new Map();
      // 1. main line: longest path with feedback (back) edges removed
      const aE = E.filter((e) => (pureCV || e.k === 'a') && audIds.has(e.s) && audIds.has(e.d));
      const out = new Map(aud.map((m) => [m.uid, []])); aE.forEach((e) => out.get(e.s).push(e.d));
      const indeg = new Map(aud.map((m) => [m.uid, 0])); aE.forEach((e) => indeg.set(e.d, indeg.get(e.d) + 1));
      const state = new Map(), back = new Set(), topo = [];
      const dfs = (u0) => { const st2 = [[u0, 0]]; state.set(u0, 1);
        while (st2.length) { const top = st2[st2.length - 1], [u, i] = top; const vs = out.get(u);
          if (i < vs.length) { top[1]++; const v = vs[i]; const sv = state.get(v);
            if (sv === 1) back.add(u + '>' + v); else if (!sv) { state.set(v, 1); st2.push([v, 0]); } }
          else { state.set(u, 2); topo.push(u); st2.pop(); } } };
      aud.filter((m) => indeg.get(m.uid) === 0).forEach((m) => { if (!state.has(m.uid)) dfs(m.uid); });
      aud.forEach((m) => { if (!state.has(m.uid)) dfs(m.uid); });
      topo.reverse(); aud.forEach((m) => col.set(m.uid, 0));
      for (const u of topo) for (const v of out.get(u)) if (!back.has(u + '>' + v)) col.set(v, Math.max(col.get(v), col.get(u) + 1));
      const maxA = Math.max(0, ...aud.map((m) => col.get(m.uid)));
      aud.forEach((m) => { if (OUT_TYPES.has(m.type)) col.set(m.uid, Math.max(maxA, col.get(m.uid))); });
      // 2. CV modules (breadth-first, each placed once, so CV loops cannot run away):
      //    one column before the module they drive; pure CV sinks one column after their source
      const isCV = new Set(cvs.map((m) => m.uid));
      let q = aud.map((m) => m.uid);
      while (q.length) { const nq = []; for (const u of q) for (const e of E) if (e.d === u && isCV.has(e.s) && !col.has(e.s)) { col.set(e.s, col.get(u) - 1); nq.push(e.s); } q = nq; }
      q = [...col.keys()];
      while (q.length) { const nq = []; for (const u of q) for (const e of E) if (e.s === u && isCV.has(e.d) && !col.has(e.d)) { col.set(e.d, col.get(u) + 1); nq.push(e.d); } q = nq; }
      cvs.forEach((m) => { if (!col.has(m.uid)) col.set(m.uid, 0); });
      const minC = Math.min(...list.map((m) => col.get(m.uid))); list.forEach((m) => col.set(m.uid, col.get(m.uid) - minC));
      // 3. order inside each column by the mean position of connected modules (a few sweeps)
      const nCol = Math.max(...list.map((m) => col.get(m.uid))) + 1;
      const cols = Array.from({ length: nCol }, () => ({ c: [], a: [] }));
      list.forEach((m) => cols[col.get(m.uid)][audIds.has(m.uid) ? 'a' : 'c'].push(m));
      const nbr = new Map(list.map((m) => [m.uid, []])); E.forEach((e) => { nbr.get(e.s).push(e.d); nbr.get(e.d).push(e.s); });
      const rank = new Map(); const setRank = () => cols.forEach((cc) => { cc.a.forEach((m, i) => rank.set(m.uid, i)); cc.c.forEach((m, i) => rank.set(m.uid, 1000 + i)); });
      setRank();
      for (let sweep = 0; sweep < 4; sweep++) {
        for (const cc of cols) for (const k of ['c', 'a']) {
          const key = (m) => { const r = nbr.get(m.uid).filter((v) => rank.has(v)).map((v) => rank.get(v)); return r.length ? r.reduce((x, y) => x + y, 0) / r.length : rank.get(m.uid); };
          cc[k].sort((p, q) => key(p) - key(q)); }
        setRank();
      }
      // 4. coordinates: audio band on top (aligned top edge), CV band below (aligned top edge). 0.455 (user 2026-10-15): modules
      //    list their audio inputs above their CV inputs (39 of 45 types with both), so CV cables from a band above crossed
      //    the audio cables; from below they reach the lower CV inputs without crossing.
      //    0.416: no wrap, a chain stays in one row however long it is (reading the signal flow left to right).
      const colH = (arr) => arr.reduce((h, m) => h + nodeHeight(m) + GAPY, 0);
      //    Height limit: a column taller than COLCAP (many parallel chains, e.g. MIDI controller patches) continues in extra
      //    columns right next to it, in the same order, so no group becomes an endless vertical strip.
      const chunk = (arr) => { const out = [[]]; let h = 0; for (const m of arr) { const hh = nodeHeight(m) + GAPY; if (h + hh > COLCAP && out[out.length - 1].length) { out.push([]); h = 0; } out[out.length - 1].push(m); h += hh; } return out; };
      const split = []; for (const cc of cols) { const C = chunk(cc.c), A = chunk(cc.a); for (let i = 0; i < Math.max(C.length, A.length); i++) split.push({ c: C[i] || [], a: A[i] || [] }); }
      cols.length = 0; split.forEach((cc) => cols.push(cc));
      {
        const band = cols;
        const audH = Math.max(0, ...band.map((cc) => colH(cc.a)));
        band.forEach((cc, k) => {
          let y = y0; cc.a.forEach((m) => { m.x = k * GAPX; m.y = y; y += nodeHeight(m) + GAPY; });
          y = y0 + audH + (audH ? BAND : 0); cc.c.forEach((m) => { m.x = k * GAPX; m.y = y; y += nodeHeight(m) + GAPY; });
        });
        // the CV band in the order of the sockets its cables lead to (top socket first), so its cables cross less
        const portY = (m, pos, side) => { const L = visible(m).filter((b) => b.type.endsWith(side)); return m.y + HEAD + Math.max(0, L.findIndex((b) => b.pos === pos)) * ROW; };
        const lm = new Map(list.map((m) => [m.uid, m])), CE = st.conns.filter((c) => lm.has(c.sm) && lm.has(c.dm) && c.sm !== c.dm);
        for (let it = 0; it < 3; it++) band.forEach((cc) => { if (cc.c.length < 2) return;
          const key = new Map(cc.c.map((m) => { const ys = CE.filter((c) => c.sm === m.uid || c.dm === m.uid).map((c) => c.sm === m.uid ? portY(lm.get(c.dm), c.db, '_in') : portY(lm.get(c.sm), c.sb, '_out'));
            return [m.uid, ys.length ? ys.reduce((x, y) => x + y, 0) / ys.length : m.y]; }));
          cc.c.sort((p, q) => key.get(p.uid) - key.get(q.uid)); let y = y0 + audH + (audH ? BAND : 0); cc.c.forEach((m) => { m.y = y; y += nodeHeight(m) + GAPY; }); });
        const ms = band.flatMap((cc) => cc.c.concat(cc.a));
        y0 = Math.max(y0, ...ms.map((m) => m.y + nodeHeight(m))) + BAND * 2;
      }
      boxes.push({ list, w: Math.max(...list.map((m) => m.x)) + NODE_W, h: y0 - BAND * 2 });
    }
    // 5. pack the groups (largest first) in rows, left to right, up to a target width that follows a landscape screen,
    //    so many small groups (e.g. 40 separate pairs) sit side by side instead of forming one tall strip
    const PADX = GAPX - NODE_W + 60, PADY = BAND * 2;
    const area = boxes.reduce((a, b) => a + (b.w + PADX) * (b.h + PADY), 0);
    const TW = Math.max(...boxes.map((b) => b.w), Math.sqrt(area * 1.6), 0);
    // 0.456 (user 2026-10-15, rule: audio on top, CV below): groups with audio first, groups without audio in new rows below them
    boxes.forEach((b) => { b.aud = b.list.some(hasAudio); }); boxes.sort((a, b) => b.aud - a.aud);
    let px = 0, py = 0, rowMax = 0;
    for (const [i, b] of boxes.entries()) {
      if (px && (px + b.w > TW || (i && boxes[i - 1].aud && !b.aud))) { px = 0; py += rowMax + PADY; rowMax = 0; }
      b.list.forEach((m) => { m.x += px; m.y += py; });
      px += b.w + PADX; rowMax = Math.max(rowMax, b.h);
    }
    const y0 = boxes.length ? py + rowMax + PADY : 0;
    // 6. modules without connections: a grid at the bottom
    //    0.456: the audio modules first, the CV modules from a new row below them
    const loose = mods.filter((m) => !linked.has(m.uid)).sort(order), looseA = loose.filter(hasAudio), looseC = loose.filter((m) => !hasAudio(m));
    const perRow = Math.max(4, Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(loose.length * 2)));
    let rowY = y0, rowH = 0;
    for (const L of [looseA, looseC]) { if (!L.length) continue; if (rowH) { rowY += rowH + GAPY; rowH = 0; }
      L.forEach((m, i) => { if (i && i % perRow === 0) { rowY += rowH + GAPY; rowH = 0; } m.x = (i % perRow) * GAPX; m.y = rowY; rowH = Math.max(rowH, nodeHeight(m)); }); }
    // snap to the 18 px canvas grid
    mods.forEach((m) => { m.x = Math.round(m.x / 18) * 18; m.y = Math.round(m.y / 18) * 18 + 56; });
  }

(function(){const tip=$('#tip');let cur=null,timer=0,mo=null;

// Quantizer (type 28): [display name, intervals (semitones between scale degrees), full name]. Order, display names and intervals from
// Empress Effects ("What are the scale increments for the different scales in the ZOIA's quantizer?"); full names from the Empress include file.
// Device test (Euroburo): a parameter value v selects entry round(v * (N - 1)); basic = first 5 scales, extended = all 48.
const QSCALES=[['Chromatic','111111111111','Chromatic'],['Major','2212221','Major'],['m Natural','2122122','Natural Minor'],['m Harmonic','2122131','Harmonic Minor'],['m Melodic','2122221','Melodic Minor'],['M Harmonic','2212131','Harmonic Major'],['Dorian','2122212','Dorian'],['Phyrigian','1222122','Phrygian'],['Lydian','2221221','Lydian'],['Mixolydian','2212212','Mixolydian'],['Locrian','1221222','Locrian'],['M Locrian','2211222','Major Locrian'],['Ahava Raba','1312122','Ahava Raba'],['Akebono','2141421','Akebono'],['Bhairav','1312131','Double Harmonic Major'],['Marwa','1321221','Marwa'],['Purvi','1321131','Purvi'],['Todi','1231131','Todi'],['Pelog','1231122','Pelog'],['Ukrainian','2131212','Ukrainian Dorian'],['Romani','2131122','Romani'],['MHungarian','3121212','Hungarian Major'],['mHungarian','2131131','Hungarian Minor'],['Persian','1311231','Persian'],['M Neapol','1222221','Neapolitan Major'],['m Neapol','1222131','Neapolitan Minor'],['H Dim','2121222','Half Diminished'],['W-H Dim','21212121','Whole-Half Diminished'],['H-W Dim','12121212','Half-Whole Diminished'],['Istrian','121215','Istrian'],['Prometheus','222312','Prometheus'],['Harmonics','311223','Harmonics'],['Tritone','132132','Tritone'],['2semi Tri','114114','Two-Semitone Tritone'],['Wholetone','222222','Whole Tone'],['M Penta','22323','Major Pentatonic'],['m Penta','32232','Minor Pentatonic'],['Hirajoshi1','42141','Hirajoshi 1'],['Hirajoshi2','14214','Hirajoshi 2'],['Hirajoshi3','41421','Hirajoshi 3'],['Hirajoshi4','14142','Hirajoshi 4'],['Hirajoshi5','21414','Hirajoshi 5'],['Insen','14232','Insen'],['Fourth','57','Fourth'],['Dim Fifth','66','Diminished Fifth'],['P Fifth','75','Perfect Fifth'],['Aug Fifth','84','Augmented Fifth'],['Octave','c','Octave']];
const QKEYS=['A','A#','B','C','C#','D','D#','E','F','F#','G','G#'];
const qScales=opts=>opts&&opts[1]?QSCALES:QSCALES.slice(0,5);
const qIdx=(v,n)=>Math.max(0,Math.min(n-1,Math.round(v/65535*(n-1))));
const qVal=(i,n)=>n>1?Math.round(i/(n-1)*65535):0;
function qTip(m){const L=qScales(m.options),sc=L[qIdx(M.getParam(m,'scale'),L.length)],k=qIdx(M.getParam(m,'key'),12);return sc[2]+' in '+QKEYS[k]+': '+qNotes(sc,k)+'\n'+(m.options[1]?'Extended: 48 scales.':'Basic: 5 scales. Choose the option “extended” under Edit Module for all 48.')+'\nScale list: Empress Effects.'}
function qNotes(sc,key){const steps=sc[1]==='c'?[12]:[...sc[1]].map(Number);let n=key,out=[QKEYS[n]];for(const x of steps.slice(0,-1)){n=(n+x)%12;out.push(QKEYS[n])}return out.join(' ')}
// note name of a semitone count above A0 (A0 = 0), as the Oscillator shows notes
const noteName=n=>{const r=Math.round(n);return QKEYS[((r%12)+12)%12]+Math.floor((r+9)/12)};
// Quantizer cv_input without a cable: the note it outputs = input pitch (0..1 = A0..A10, 120 semitones) snapped to the nearest
// note of the chosen scale in the chosen key (key/scale jacks off: chromatic). Ties go to the lower note (not verified on the device).
function qOut(raw,opts,m){const x=raw/65535*120;let deg=null,key=0;
  if(m&&opts&&opts[0]){const L=qScales(opts),sc=L[qIdx(M.getParam(m,'scale'),L.length)];key=qIdx(M.getParam(m,'key'),12);const st=sc[1]==='c'?[12]:[...sc[1]].map(Number);deg=[0];for(const v of st.slice(0,-1))deg.push(deg[deg.length-1]+v)}
  let best=null;for(let n=0;n<=120;n++){const rel=((n-key)%12+12)%12;if(deg&&!deg.includes(rel))continue;if(best===null||Math.abs(n-x)<Math.abs(best-x))best=n}
  return best}
// 0.468: tooltip of a value the device replaces by the module's state
const STATE_TIP='On the device this block shows the module’s current state, which changes while the patch plays (the tempo you tap in, recording, playback, freeze). ZoE shows what the device shows after loading the patch.';
// 0.471: every format of a value (knob-press views), the one the device shows first: tooltip of the inspector value
function allViewsTip(m,name){const n=M.displayViews(m.type,name,m.options,m.version|0);if(n<2)return'';const raw=m.type===4?stepVal(m,name):M.getParam(m,name),cur=M.viewOf(m,name);
  const L=[...Array(n).keys()].map(v=>M.displayText(m.type,name,raw,m.options,m.version|0,v)).filter(x=>x!=null).map(x=>x.trim());
  if(L.length<2)return'';const c=M.displayText(m.type,name,raw,m.options,m.version|0,cur);return'Formats on the device: '+L.join(' · ')+(c!=null?'\nShown after loading: '+c.trim():'')}
// 0.471 (user 2026-10-17): a click on the value switches its format like a knob press on the device; saved with the patch
const VTOG_TIP='Click to switch the format, like pressing the knob on the device. Saved with the patch.';
const vTog=(m,name)=>m.lockedParams?false:m.type===4?/^step_\d+$/.test(name)&&!!M.seqTracks(m):M.viewSwitchable(m,name);
function vToggle(m,name){commit();
  if(m.type===4){const E=seqEdit(m),k=E?E.t:M.seqShownTrack(m);m.saved[0x22c+k]=m.saved[0x22c+k]?0:1} // the step view of the shown / edited track
  else M.viewNext(m,name);
  renderAll()}
const isStateVal=(m,name)=>M.displayText(m.type,name,M.getParam(m,name),m.options,m.version|0)==null&&!!M.stateText(m.type,name,m.options,m.version|0,m);
function fmtParam(t,name,raw,opts,m){
  // 0.436: the device's own text (firmware tables) wherever there is one; ZoE's formulas below remain for the rest (state blocks, no table)
  // 0.471: sequencer steps: the track's own view (state byte 0x22C + track, firmware view_storage.sequencer): a note for pitch-type
  // tracks (output types 0 and 3) with the note view on, else the number with 3 decimals (confirmed on a ZOIA: DFAM Pitch Seq "0.500" / "A5")
  if(t===4&&m&&/^step_\d+$/.test(name)){const T=M.seqTracks(m);if(T){const E=typeof seqEdit==='function'?seqEdit(m):null,k=E?E.t:M.seqShownTrack(m),x=T[k]||T[0];
    if(!(m.saved[0x22c+k]&&(x.type===0||x.type===3)))return(raw/65535).toFixed(3)}}
  // 0.471: in the knob-press view the module keeps (Hz / ms / BPM …), as the device shows it after loading
  {const dt=M.displayText(t,name,raw,opts,m?m.version|0:0,m?M.viewOf(m,name):0);
   // quantizer cv input: the device shows the knob value; ZoE adds the note that comes out (user 2026-10-14)
   if(dt!=null)return t===28&&name==='cv_input'?dt+' ('+noteName(qOut(raw,opts,m))+')':dt}
  if(t===28&&name==='cv_input')return noteName(qOut(raw,opts,m))+' ('+(raw/65535).toFixed(3)+')';
  if(t===28&&name==='key')return QKEYS[qIdx(raw,12)];
  if(t===109&&name==='pressure')return String(Math.round(raw/65535*127)); // device display 0-127 (confirmed: 38700 = 75)
  if(m&&t!==28){const fv=fixedVal(m,name,raw);if(fv!=null)return fv}
  if(t===28&&name==='scale'){const L=qScales(opts);return L[qIdx(raw,L.length)][0]}
  // 0.468: the device shows the module's state here (tapped tempo, recording, playback, freeze): its text after loading, tooltip STATE_TIP
  {const sx=M.stateText(t,name,opts,m?m.version|0:0,m);if(sx)return sx.text!=null?sx.text.trim():'–'}
  return(raw/65535*100).toFixed(1)+' %';
}
// connection level as the device shows it (firmware 5.41): dB = strength/100 - 100 ("%.2f dB"), percent = 10^(dB/20)*100,
// printed with "%.4f" and cut to 5 characters ("100.0%", "5.623%", "0.001%")
const stDb=s=>(s-10000)/100, stPct=s=>100*Math.pow(10,stDb(s)/20);
// 0.440: at least 1 (−99.99 dB): the device removes a connection at −100 dB
const pctToSt=p=>p<=0?1:Math.max(1,Math.round(10000+2000*Math.log10(p/100)));
function fmtPct(p){return p.toFixed(4).slice(0,5)+'%'}

function renderPalette(){
  const q=$('#search').value.trim().toLowerCase();
  const groups={};
  MODS.forEach(m=>{const cat=catOf(m);if(q&&!((m.n+(M.isEuro(m.id)?' euroburo':'')).toLowerCase().includes(q)||(m.desc||'').toLowerCase().includes(q)))return;(groups[cat]=groups[cat]||[]).push(m)});
  const BLH='<span class="blh" title="Blocks: how many grid buttons the module takes up on a ZOIA page (40 per page). A range means it depends on the options.">Blocks</span>';
  if(q){ // search covers the whole inventory: results grouped by tab, no tab selected
    $('#tabs').innerHTML=CATS.map(([k,short,long])=>`<button type="button" role="tab" data-tab="${k}" aria-selected="false" style="--tc:${tabColor(k)}" title="${long}"${groups[k]?'':' disabled'}>${short}<small>${groups[k]?groups[k].length:0}</small></button>`).join('');
    const itemS=m=>{const dv=M.deviceOnly(m.id);return`<li class="pi${M.UNTESTED.has(m.id)?' untested':''}" draggable="true" data-t="${m.id}" title="${esc((m.desc||m.n)+(M.UNTESTED.has(m.id)?'\n\n'+UNTESTED_TXT:'')+(dv?'\n\n'+DEV_BADGE[dv][1]:''))}"><span class="dot" style="background:${palDot(m)}"></span><span class="nm">${esc(M.isEuro(m.id)?m.n.replace(/^euro /,''):m.n)}</span>${M.UNTESTED.has(m.id)?'<span class="devb newb">NEW</span>':''}${devBadge(m.id,true)}<span class="bl">${m.minB===m.maxB?m.minB:m.minB+'–'+m.maxB}</span></li>`};
    let html='',first=true;for(const [k,short,long] of CATS){const L=groups[k];if(!L)continue;L.sort(palSort);
      html+=`<div class="label catlbl"><span>${esc(short)} · ${L.length}</span>${first?BLH:''}</div><ul class="list">${L.map(itemS).join('')}</ul>`;first=false}
    $('#palette').innerHTML=html||'<p class="note" style="padding:12px">No module found.</p>';return}
  if(!activeCat){$('#tabs').innerHTML=CATS.map(([k,short,long])=>`<button type="button" role="tab" data-tab="${k}" aria-selected="false" style="--tc:${tabColor(k)}" title="${long}"${groups[k]?'':' disabled'}>${short}<small>${groups[k]?groups[k].length:0}</small></button>`).join('');$('#palette').innerHTML='<p class="note" style="padding:12px 14px">Choose a category above or search to show modules.</p>';return}
  $('#tabs').innerHTML=CATS.map(([k,short,long])=>`<button type="button" role="tab" data-tab="${k}" aria-selected="${k===activeCat}" class="${k===activeCat?'on':''}" style="--tc:${tabColor(k)}" title="${long}"${groups[k]?'':' disabled'}>${short}<small>${groups[k]?groups[k].length:0}</small></button>`).join('');
  const list=groups[activeCat]||[];const long=CATS.find(c=>c[0]===activeCat)[2];
  const item=m=>{const dv=M.deviceOnly(m.id);return`<li class="pi${M.UNTESTED.has(m.id)?' untested':''}" draggable="true" data-t="${m.id}" title="${esc((m.desc||m.n)+(M.UNTESTED.has(m.id)?'\n\n'+UNTESTED_TXT:'')+(dv?'\n\n'+DEV_BADGE[dv][1]:''))}"><span class="dot" style="background:${palDot(m)}"></span><span class="nm">${esc(M.isEuro(m.id)?m.n.replace(/^euro /,''):m.n)}</span>${M.UNTESTED.has(m.id)?'<span class="devb newb">NEW</span>':''}${devBadge(m.id,true)}<span class="bl">${m.minB===m.maxB?m.minB:m.minB+'–'+m.maxB}</span></li>`};
  const sorted=list.sort(palSort);
  let html;
  if(activeCat==='Device'){ // same split as the device badges: both devices, ZOIA only, Euroburo only
    const both=sorted.filter(m=>!M.deviceOnly(m.id)),zo=sorted.filter(m=>M.deviceOnly(m.id)==='zoia'),eu=sorted.filter(m=>M.deviceOnly(m.id)==='euro');
    const tip='Modules with a ZOIA or EURO badge work only on that device.';
    const grp=(lbl,arr)=>arr.length?`<div class="label catlbl"><span title="${tip}">${lbl}</span>${q||both.length?'':'<span class="blh" title="Blocks: how many grid buttons the module takes up on a ZOIA page (40 per page). A range means it depends on the options.">Blocks</span>'}</div><ul class="list">${arr.map(item).join('')}</ul>`:'';
    html=(q||both.length?`<div class="label catlbl"><span>${q?'Search results':''}</span><span class="blh" title="Blocks: how many grid buttons the module takes up on a ZOIA page (40 per page). A range means it depends on the options.">Blocks</span></div>`:'')+(both.length?`<ul class="list">${both.map(item).join('')}</ul>`:'')+grp('ZOIA only',zo)+grp('Euroburo only',eu)}
  else html=`<div class="label catlbl"><span>${long}${q?' · search results':''}</span><span class="blh" title="Blocks: how many grid buttons the module takes up on a ZOIA page (40 per page). A range means it depends on the options.">Blocks</span></div><ul class="list">${sorted.map(item).join('')}</ul>`;
  $('#palette').innerHTML=list.length?html:'<p class="note" style="padding:12px">No module found.</p>';
  if(typeof st!=='undefined'&&st)updatePaletteUsed();
}

// free canvas spot near (x,y) so a clicked-in module never lands on top of another one
function freeSpot(m,x,y){const h=M.nodeHeight(m),hit=(px,py)=>st.modules.some(o=>px<X(o)+W+18&&px+W+18>X(o)&&py<o.y+M.nodeHeight(o)+18&&py+h+18>o.y);
  for(let k=0;k<40;k++){const dx=k*(W+36);for(let dy=0;dy<=1800;dy+=GRID)if(!hit(x+dx,y+dy))return{x:x+dx,y:y+dy}}return{x,y}} // new columns always to the right
// ZOIA control port: one jack, one function at a time (CPort in the Config Menu). Expression/CV in and CV out can share it (cv),
// an external footswitch (Stompswitch "ext") cannot share it with either.
const cportUse=m=>m.type===54?'in':m.type===55?'out':m.type===44&&optVal(m,'stompswitch')==='ext'?'ext':null;
const cportClash=(kind,skip)=>st.modules.filter(o=>o.uid!==skip&&cportUse(o)&&(kind==='ext')!==(cportUse(o)==='ext'));
// ---------- multi-selection, copy / cut / paste of module groups ----------

// (New, Open and PatchStorage keep it), so parts of one patch can go into another.

function mselShow(){nodesEl.querySelectorAll('.node').forEach(n=>n.classList.toggle('msel',msel.has(n.dataset.uid)));updEditBtns()}

  if(!pending&&!rewire)setHint(msel.size?`${msel.size} module${msel.size>1?'s':''} selected · Ctrl+C copy · Ctrl+X cut · Del delete · Esc clear`:'')}
// the selection frame in screen pixels; its start point is kept in patch coordinates, so it stays put when the view moves

function rectUpdate(){const d=drag,r=stage.getBoundingClientRect(),v=st.view,ax=d.w0.x*v.k+v.x,ay=d.w0.y*v.k+v.y,bx=d.cx-r.left,by=d.cy-r.top;
  const el=$('#selRect');el.hidden=false;Object.assign(el.style,{left:Math.min(ax,bx)+'px',top:Math.min(ay,by)+'px',width:Math.abs(bx-ax)+'px',height:Math.abs(by-ay)+'px'});
  const w1=toWorld(d.cx,d.cy),x0=Math.min(d.w0.x,w1.x),x1=Math.max(d.w0.x,w1.x),y0=Math.min(d.w0.y,w1.y),y1=Math.max(d.w0.y,w1.y);
  msel=new Set(d.base);if(d.moved)for(const m of st.modules){if(pageFilter>=0&&m.page!==pageFilter)continue;if(X(m)<x1&&X(m)+W>x0&&m.y<y1&&m.y+M.nodeHeight(m)>y0&&inFocus(m))msel.add(m.uid)}
  mselShow();
  // near the edge of the workspace the view scrolls along, so large areas can be framed
  const ex=bx<24?1:bx>r.width-24?-1:0,ey=by<24?1:by>r.height-24?-1:0;clearInterval(rectTimer);
  if(ex||ey)rectTimer=setInterval(()=>{if(!drag||drag.type!=='rect')return clearInterval(rectTimer);st.view.x+=ex*10;st.view.y+=ey*10;applyView();rectUpdate()},30)}
function rectEnd(){clearInterval(rectTimer);$('#selRect').hidden=true;drag=null;sel=null;renderAll()}
function copySel(silent){const mods=msel.size?[...msel].map(byUid).filter(m=>m&&inFocus(m)):[byUid(sel.uid)].filter(Boolean);if(!mods.length)return [];
  const ids=new Set(mods.map(m=>m.uid)),conns=st.conns.filter(c=>ids.has(c.sm)&&ids.has(c.dm)),cids=new Set(conns.map(c=>c.uid));
  const cp=o=>JSON.parse(JSON.stringify({...o,rawName:null}));
  clip={mods:mods.map(cp),conns:conns.map(c=>({...c})),stars:st.stars.filter(x=>(x.m&&ids.has(x.m))||(x.conn&&cids.has(x.conn))).map(x=>({...x,cc:-1})),
    pageNames:Object.fromEntries([...new Set(mods.map(m=>m.page))].map(p=>[p,st.pages[p]||'']))};
  msel.clear();renderAll(true);if(!silent)toast(`${mods.length} module${mods.length>1?'s':''} copied${conns.length?` with ${conns.length} connection${conns.length>1?'s':''}`:''}. Ctrl+V pastes them on the current page.`);return mods}

// target page: the page shown, else the page in the middle of the view (as in the page menu)
// Paste: the page from targetPage. A block from one page keeps its shape (same buttons, else shifted: rows down, then columns
// right …); a block from several pages goes module by module onto free buttons. If it does not fit on the chosen page: popup
// (next page free) or pasted anyway with a note (next page in use). "All pages": the first page from page 0 where it fits.
function pasteClip(){if(!clip)return;const grid=clip.mods.filter(m=>!M.isEuro(m.type)),srcPages=[...new Set(grid.map(m=>m.page))];
  const vis=m=>M.visible(m).length,single=srcPages.length<=1;
  const deltaOn=P=>{const occ=M.occupancy(st,P),free=c=>!occ[c].length;
    const fits=(dr,dc)=>grid.every(m=>{const n=vis(m),c=m.pos%8;if(c+dc<0||c+dc>7||Math.floor((c+dc+n-1)/8)!==Math.floor((c+n-1)/8))return false;
      const a=m.pos+dr*8+dc;if(a<0||a+n>40)return false;for(let i=a;i<a+n;i++)if(!free(i))return false;return true});
    const cand=[[0,0]];for(let r=1;r<5;r++)cand.push([r,0]);for(let c=1;c<8;c++)cand.push([0,c]);
    for(let r=1;r<5;r++)for(let c=1;c<8;c++)cand.push([r,c]);
    for(let r=-1;r>-5;r--)cand.push([r,0]);for(let c=-1;c>-8;c--)cand.push([0,c]);
    for(let r=-4;r<5;r++)for(let c=-7;c<8;c++)if((r<0||c<0)&&r&&c)cand.push([r,c]);
    const f=cand.find(([r,c])=>fits(r,c));return f?f[0]*8+f[1]:undefined};
  // several source pages: do all modules fit completely, one after the other, on page P?
  const allFit=P=>{const keep=st;st=unpack(pack(st));let ok=true;try{for(const o of grid){const m=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(o));m.uid=M.uid();const f=M.place(st,m,P);if(!f||f.cut||f.overlap)ok=false;st.modules.push(m)}}finally{st=keep}return ok};
  const fitOn=P=>{if(!grid.length)return true;if(single){const d=deltaOn(P);return d==null?false:{d}}return allFit(P)?{d:null}:false};
  const n=clip.mods.length,what=`The ${n} copied module${n>1?'s':''}`,many=n>1;
  const T0=targetPage();
  if(!grid.length)return doPaste(T0!=null?T0:(st.activePage||0),null,'');
  if(T0==null){const cnt=pageCount();for(let p=0;p<cnt;p++){const r=fitOn(p);if(r)return doPaste(p,r.d,'')}
    if(cnt>=64)return toast(`No space left on any page for ${what.toLowerCase()}, and all 64 pages are in use.`,5000,'warn');
    const A=firstFreeButtonPage(1);return askRoom({what,many,paste:true,T:null,N:cnt,A,onAnyway:()=>doPaste(A,null,'anyway'),onNew:()=>doPaste(cnt,single?0:null,'new')})}
  const r=fitOn(T0);if(r)return doPaste(T0,r.d,'');
  // 0.450: as for single modules: the first page after the chosen one with room, else a new page at the end (or anyway)
  const cnt=pageCount();for(let p=T0+1;p<cnt;p++){const q=fitOn(p);if(q)return doPaste(p,q.d,'')}
  if(cnt>=64)return doPaste(T0,null,'anyway');
  return askRoom({what,many,paste:true,T:T0,N:cnt,after:true,anyway:true,onAnyway:()=>doPaste(T0,null,'anyway'),onNew:()=>doPaste(cnt,single?0:null,'new')})}
// how: '' fits · 'new' on the new / empty page · 'anyway' on a page without room (free buttons, cut off or overlapping, with a note)
function doPaste(T,delta,how){const grid=clip.mods.filter(m=>!M.isEuro(m.type)),srcPages=[...new Set(grid.map(m=>m.page))];
  commit();const before=st.modules.some(m=>m.page===T),map={},added=[],reused=[];
  for(const o of clip.mods){
    // Euroburo hardware exists only once per patch: the existing one is used, a missing one is added
    if(M.isEuro(o.type)){const ex=st.modules.find(m=>m.type===o.type);if(ex){map[o.uid]=ex;reused.push(ex);continue}}
    const m=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(o));m.uid=M.uid();m.rawName=null;m.importedColor=null;
    if(!M.isEuro(m.type)){if(delta!=null){m.page=T;m.pos=o.pos+delta;while(st.pages.length<=T)st.pages.push('')}else M.place(st,m,T)}
    st.modules.push(m);map[o.uid]=m;added.push([m,o])}
  // canvas: the group keeps its shape, at a free spot in the middle of the view
  const og=added.filter(([m])=>!M.isEuro(m.type)).map(([,o])=>o);
  if(og.length){const k=spreadK(),x0=Math.min(...og.map(o=>o.x)),y0=Math.min(...og.map(o=>o.y)),x1=Math.max(...og.map(o=>o.x)),y1=Math.max(...og.map(o=>o.y+M.nodeHeight(o)));
    const r=stage.getBoundingClientRect(),c=toWorld(r.left+r.width/2-((x1-x0)*k+W)/2,r.top+r.height/3),gs=groupSpot((x1-x0)*k+W,y1-y0,snapV(c.x),snapV(c.y));
    for(const[m,o] of added)if(!M.isEuro(m.type)){m.x=snapV(gs.x)/k+(o.x-x0);m.y=snapV(gs.y+(o.y-y0))}}
  const cmap={};for(const c of clip.conns){const a=map[c.sm],b=map[c.dm];if(!a||!b)continue;if(st.conns.some(k=>k.sm===a.uid&&k.sb===c.sb&&k.dm===b.uid&&k.db===c.db))continue;
    const n={...c,uid:M.uid(),sm:a.uid,dm:b.uid};st.conns.push(n);cmap[c.uid]=n.uid}
  for(const x of clip.stars){if(x.m&&map[x.m]&&added.some(([m])=>m===map[x.m]))st.stars.push({...x,m:map[x.m].uid,cc:-1});else if(x.conn&&cmap[x.conn])st.stars.push({...x,conn:cmap[x.conn],cc:-1})}
  // an empty page takes the page name of the source page, its number counted up ("Voice 1" on page 1 -> "Voice 3" on page 3)
  if(!before&&srcPages.length===1&&!st.pages[T]){const nm=clip.pageNames[srcPages[0]]||'',mm=/^(.*?)(\d+)$/.exec(nm);
    st.pages[T]=(mm?mm[1]+(+mm[2]+(T-srcPages[0])):nm).slice(0,15)}
  // 0.457 (user 2026-10-16): the pasted modules stay selected, ready to move, duplicate or delete (one: selected, several: multi-selection)
  const pm=added.map(([m])=>m).filter(m=>!M.isEuro(m.type));
  // 0.505: one module pasted = a copy on the device (keeps its colour, current = the colour after it); several keep their colours
  // and leave the current colour, like a page copy on the device
  if(added.length===1)M.colourAfter(added[0][0].color);
  msel.clear();sel=null;if(pm.length===1)sel={kind:'m',uid:pm[0].uid};else pm.forEach(m=>msel.add(m.uid));
  if(T!==targetPage())showPage(T);renderAll();
  // the view moves to the pasted block (centred), the zoom stays as it is
  if(pm.length){const r=stage.getBoundingClientRect(),k=st.view.k,cx=(Math.min(...pm.map(m=>X(m)))+Math.max(...pm.map(m=>X(m)+W)))/2,cy=(Math.min(...pm.map(m=>m.y))+Math.max(...pm.map(m=>m.y+M.nodeHeight(m))))/2;
    st.view={k,x:r.width/2-cx*k,y:r.height/2-cy*k};applyView()}
  const pages=[...new Set(added.filter(([m])=>!M.isEuro(m.type)).map(([m])=>m.page))];
  const cut=pm.filter(m=>M.hiddenByPageEnd(m).length).length,ovl=how==='anyway'?pm.filter(m=>{const o=M.occupancy(st,T);return M.visible(m).some((b,i)=>m.pos+i<40&&o[m.pos+i].length>1)}).length:0;
  const note=how==='anyway'?` Page ${T} had no room for the block: placed on free grid buttons${cut?`; ${cut} module${cut>1?'s run':' runs'} past the end of the page (last blocks hidden, see the Module Inspector)`:''}${ovl?`; ${ovl} module${ovl>1?'s overlap':' overlaps'} others`:''}.`:'';
  toast(`${added.length} module${added.length===1?'':'s'} pasted${pages.length?' on '+(how==='new'?'the new page ':'page ')+pages.join(', '):''}${delta?' (moved to free grid buttons)':''}${srcPages.length>1&&how!=='anyway'?' (from several pages: placed on free grid buttons)':''}${reused.length?'; uses the existing '+reused.map(m=>Z.mod(m.type).n.replace(/^euro /,'')).join(', '):''}.${note} Ctrl+Z undoes it.`,note?7000:4500,note?'warn':undefined)}
$('#bCopy').onclick=()=>{if(msel.size||(sel&&sel.kind==='m'))copySel()};$('#bPaste').onclick=()=>pasteClip();

  const gone=new Set(st.conns.filter(c=>ids.has(c.sm)||ids.has(c.dm)).map(c=>c.uid));st.conns=st.conns.filter(c=>!gone.has(c.uid));st.stars=st.stars.filter(s=>!ids.has(s.m)&&!gone.has(s.conn))}
function askCport(kind,clash,go){
  const n=st.conns.filter(c=>clash.some(m=>m.uid===c.sm||m.uid===c.dm)).length,many=clash.length>1;
  ask({title:'Control port already in use',
    q:`The control port on the back can only do one thing at a time (CPort in the Config Menu). ${clash.map(m=>'['+mlabel(m)+']').join(', ')} already use${many?'':'s'} it ${kind==='ext'?'as expression or CV jack':'for an external footswitch'}. Replace ${many?'them':'it'}?`,
    info:(n?`${n} connection${n>1?'s':''} will be deleted too. `:'')+'You can undo with Ctrl+Z.',yes:'Replace',no:'Cancel'},go)}
// Euroburo hardware exists once per jack/button: adding it again selects the one already in the patch
function euroTwice(t){const ex=M.isEuro(t)&&st.modules.find(o=>o.type===t);if(!ex)return false;
  sel={kind:'m',uid:ex.uid};focusModule(ex);renderAll();toast('['+mlabel(ex)+'] is already in the patch. The Euroburo has only one '+Z.mod(t).n.replace(/^euro /,'')+', so it is selected instead.',5000);return true}
// note after placing a module like on the ZOIA (blocks past the page end hidden, or overlapping the next modules)
// ---------- where new modules go (like the ZOIA: nothing moves to another page by itself) ----------
// A page chosen in the page menu is the target. In "All pages" the first page from page 0 where everything fits without clipping.
// If it does not fit on the chosen page: the first page after it with room; if there is none, a popup offers: anyway (on the
// chosen page, cut off / overlapping, with a note), a new page at the end, or Cancel.
const targetPage=()=>pageFilter>=0&&pageFilter<64?pageFilter:null;
const pageUsed=p=>st.modules.some(m=>m.page===p&&!M.isEuro(m.type));
const nextFreePage=T=>T+1<64&&!pageUsed(T+1)?T+1:null;
function askRoom(o){const w=o.paste?'paste':'insert',W2=o.paste?'Paste':'Insert';
  ask({title:o.T==null?'No space left on any page':o.after?'No room on page '+o.T+' or after it':'Not enough room on page '+o.T,
    q:o.T==null?`${o.what} ${o.many?'do':'does'} not fit completely on any page.`:o.after?`${o.what} ${o.many?'do':'does'} not fit completely on page ${o.T} or on any page after it.`:`${o.what} ${o.many?'do':'does'} not fit completely on page ${o.T}.`,
    info:o.combo?`A combo is only inserted when all its modules fit completely, so it never ends up cut off.\nNew page: page ${o.N} is ${o.T!=null&&o.N<st.pages.length?'empty':'created'} and gets it.`:o.T==null?(o.A!=null?`${W2} anyway: on page ${o.A}, the first page with a free grid button – blocks past the end of the page are hidden or modules overlap, a note says which.\nNew page: page ${o.N} is created for ${o.many?'them':'it'}.`:`Page ${o.N} is created for ${o.many?'them':'it'}.`):o.anyway?`${W2} anyway: on page ${o.T}, as on the ZOIA – blocks past the end of the page are hidden or modules overlap, a note says which.\nNew page: page ${o.N} is ${pageUsed(o.N)||o.N<st.pages.length?'empty':'created'} and gets ${o.many?'them':'it'}.`:`Page ${o.T} has no free grid button.\nNew page: page ${o.N} gets ${o.many?'them':'it'}.`,
    yes:`Create page ${o.N} and ${w} there`,safe:true,no:'Cancel',cancelLast:true,alt:o.T!=null&&o.anyway?`${W2} anyway`:o.T==null&&o.A!=null?`${W2} anyway on page ${o.A}`:'',onAlt:o.onAnyway},o.onNew)}
// "All pages", nothing fits anywhere: the first page (from page 0) that still has a free grid button, for "anyway"
function firstFreeButtonPage(n){const cnt=pageCount();for(let p=0;p<cnt;p++)if(M.fitOnPage(st,n,p))return p;return null}
// one new module: decide the page, then done(page) – or a popup, or a note
function placeNew(m,T,label,done){const n=M.visible(m).length,whole=P=>{const f=M.fitOnPage(st,n,P,m.uid);return f&&!f.cut&&!f.overlap};
  if(T==null){const cnt=pageCount();for(let p=0;p<cnt;p++)if(whole(p))return done(p);
    if(cnt>=64)return toast(`No space left on any page for ${label}, and all 64 pages are in use.`,5000,'warn');
    const A=firstFreeButtonPage(n);return askRoom({what:label,T:null,N:cnt,A,onAnyway:()=>done(A),onNew:()=>done(cnt)})}
  if(whole(T))return done(T);
  // 0.449 (user 2026-10-15): the chosen page is full: the first page after it with room, without asking; only after that
  // (never before the chosen page) a new page at the end is offered, or the chosen page anyway
  const cnt=pageCount();for(let p=T+1;p<cnt;p++)if(whole(p))return done(p);
  const f=M.fitOnPage(st,n,T,m.uid);
  if(cnt>=64){if(f)return done(T);return toast(`No room for ${label} on page ${T} or any page after it, and all 64 pages are in use.`,5000,'warn')}
  return askRoom({what:label,T,N:cnt,after:true,anyway:!!f,onAnyway:()=>done(T),onNew:()=>done(cnt)})}
// after placing on another page than the one shown: the page menu follows

function placeNote(m,f){if(!f)return'';const h=M.hiddenByPageEnd(m);
  return (h.length?` ${h.length} block${h.length>1?'s':''} past the end of the page ${h.length>1?'are':'is'} hidden, as on the ZOIA: ${h.map(x=>x.label).join(', ')}.`:'')+(f.overlap?' No free space for all its blocks: it overlaps the modules after it.':'')}
// page: Add New uses the page of the selected module; otherwise the page menu decides (see targetPage)
function addModule(t,at,avoid,replace,page){
  if(euroTwice(t))return;
  if(!replace&&(t===54||t===55)){const cl=cportClash('cv');if(cl.length){askCport('cv',cl,()=>addModule(t,at,avoid,cl,page));return}}
  const m=M.newModule(st,t,at?{x:at.x/spreadK(),y:at.y}:at); // at: screen-world position (stretched); model x is unstretched
  m.x=snapV(X(m))/spreadK();m.y=snapV(m.y);if(avoid){const f=freeSpot(m,X(m),m.y);m.x=snapV(f.x)/spreadK();m.y=snapV(f.y)}
  const fin=P=>{commit();if(replace){removeModules(replace);sel=null}
    const nw=P!=null&&!pageUsed(P),f=M.isEuro(t)?null:M.place(st,m,P);
    // 0.505: the device's current colour (Euroburo hardware: green), then the next colour of the cycle
    m.color=M.takeColour(t);
    st.modules.push(m);sel={kind:'m',uid:m.uid};if(!M.isEuro(t)&&P!==targetPage())showPage(P);renderAll();const pn=placeNote(m,f);
    toast('['+mlabel(m)+'] '+(m.page===M.EURO_PAGE?'added to the Euroburo Interfaces':'placed on '+(nw?'the empty page ':'page ')+m.page+', grid button '+(m.pos+1))+'.'+pn,pn?6000:3000,pn?'warn':undefined)};
  if(M.isEuro(t))return fin(null);
  placeNew(m,page!==undefined?page:targetPage(),'['+Z.mod(t).n+']',fin)}

let gridView=false,gvW=0,gvRW=0,gvHi=null; // gvW: grid width now (zoom), gvRW: width the grids were last rendered at; gvHi: uid of the module selected when the Grid view was opened (white frame)
