function gridPages(){const used=st.modules.filter(m=>!M.isEuro(m.type)).map(m=>m.page);return Math.max(used.length?Math.max(...used)+1:1,Math.min(64,st.pages.length),gridView&&pageFilter>=0&&pageFilter<64?pageFilter+1:0)} // 0.449: also empty pages that were added (page menu) // up to the last page with a module (Euroburo hardware not included), or the page chosen in the page menu
// Fit: the largest grid width at which all pages fit into the view (8 per row; a grid is 5/8 as high as it is wide, plus its title)
const gvCols=()=>{const n=gridPages();return n<=16?4:n<=36?6:8}; // pages per row: up to 16 pages 4 (4x4), up to 36 pages 6 (6x6), else 8
// space between two pages side by side = space between two pages one above the other (row gap 16 + title 1.2 x font + 5 margin)
// column gap = page title height (14-17 px font; 0.425: titles stop at 17 px like the labels) + room
const gvGap=w=>21+1.2*Math.min(17,Math.max(14,w/8*.34));
function gvFitW(){const c=gvCols(),eu=euroInPatch()?1:0,cw=c+eu*1.5,gaps=c-1+eu,w1=(gvEl.clientWidth-36-gaps*gvGap(gvEl.clientWidth/cw))/cw,W0=gvEl.clientWidth-36-gaps*gvGap(w1),H0=gvEl.clientHeight-16-60,rows=Math.ceil(gridPages()/c);
  return Math.max(60,Math.min(W0/cw,(H0-rows*36)/Math.max(rows,eu*1.2)*8/5))} // 0.484: room for the Euroburo Interfaces (1.5 page widths, 6 buttons tall)
// 0.417: labels only where they can be read. Buttons below GV_LBL px: colours only (as the device's LEDs), overlaps as a corner mark;
// below GV_TYPE px: the own name only, without the [type] line (a module without an own name keeps its [type]).
const GV_LBL=30,GV_TYPE=45;
const gvMinW=()=>Math.max(gvFitW(),130),GV_MAXW=960; // Fit = all pages fit, but a grid never narrower than 130 px (smaller is unreadable) = also the smallest zoom; largest: 120 px buttons
// Zoom works like on the canvas (mouse wheel / two-finger swipe / pinch around the pointer, − and + by 1.2 around the middle, Fit):
// while zooming, the rendered grids are only scaled (fast); 150 ms after the last step they are rendered again at the new size,
// keeping the point under the pointer in place (re-rendering every step is too slow for large patches).
function gvZoomAt(f,cx,cy){const w=Math.min(GV_MAXW,Math.max(gvMinW(),gvW*f));if(Math.abs(w-gvW)<.01)return;
  const o=gvZoomAt.a,a0=o&&Math.abs(o.cx-cx)<3&&Math.abs(o.cy-cy)<3?null:gvAnchor(cx,cy);if(a0){a0.cx=cx;a0.cy=cy;gvZoomAt.a=null}
  const v=gvEl.getBoundingClientRect(),px=cx-v.left,py=cy-v.top,s0=gvW/gvRW,s1=w/gvRW,pad=gvPad();
  const x=(gvEl.scrollLeft+px-pad[0])/s0,y=(gvEl.scrollTop+py-pad[1])/s0;gvW=w;
  // the label text stays at its largest size on screen while the grids are scaled, so it does not grow and then jump back
  const g=gvEl.querySelector('.gvpages');if(g){g.style.transform=`scale(${s1})`;g.style.setProperty('--gvcap',(17/s1).toFixed(2)+'px')}
  // Scale notes during zoom preview
  gvScaleNotes(s1);
  gvEl.scrollLeft=x*s1+pad[0]-px;gvEl.scrollTop=y*s1+pad[1]-py;
  // 0.506: the page titles do not scale with the grids (--gvcap), so the grids shift a little while zooming; the spot of the grid
  // under the pointer, taken at the first step (again when the pointer moved), is put back under the pointer at every step and after the new render
  if(!gvZoomAt.a)gvZoomAt.a=a0;gvKeep(gvZoomAt.a,cx,cy);
  clearTimeout(gvZoomAt.t);gvZoomAt.t=setTimeout(()=>{const a=gvZoomAt.a;gvZoomAt.a=null;gvCommit(cx,cy,a)},150)}
// Ensure notes are also scaled during zoom preview
// Notes are now inside .gvpages, so they automatically get the same CSS transform
// No manual scaling needed - the transform on .gvpages handles it
function gvScaleNotes(scale){
  // Notes layer is now inside .gvpages, so it automatically scales with the parent transform
}
// the grid nearest to a point and the point's place in it (fractions of its width and height)
function gvAnchor(cx,cy){const pages=[...gvEl.querySelectorAll('.grid8')];if(!pages.length)return null;
  const d=r=>Math.hypot(Math.max(r.left-cx,0,cx-r.right),Math.max(r.top-cy,0,cy-r.bottom));
  const g=pages.reduce((b,x)=>d(x.getBoundingClientRect())<d(b.getBoundingClientRect())?x:b),r=g.getBoundingClientRect();return {p:g.dataset.page,fx:(cx-r.left)/r.width,fy:(cy-r.top)/r.height}}
function gvKeep(a,cx,cy){if(!a)return;const g=gvEl.querySelector(`.grid8[data-page="${a.p}"]`);if(!g)return;const r=g.getBoundingClientRect();gvEl.scrollLeft+=r.left+a.fx*r.width-cx;gvEl.scrollTop+=r.top+a.fy*r.height-cy}
const gvPad=()=>{const c=getComputedStyle(gvEl);return [parseFloat(c.paddingLeft)+gvEl.clientWidth,parseFloat(c.paddingTop)+gvEl.clientHeight]}; // the grids sit inside one view size of free room on every side
// render at the zoomed size; the grid under the pointer keeps the same point under the pointer
function gvCommit(cx,cy,a0){if(!gridView)return;const a=a0||gvAnchor(cx,cy);const scrollLeft=gvEl.scrollLeft,scrollTop=gvEl.scrollTop;renderGridView();gvEl.scrollLeft=scrollLeft;gvEl.scrollTop=scrollTop;gvKeep(a,cx,cy);gvScaleNotes(1)}
function gvZoomMid(f){const v=gvEl.getBoundingClientRect();gvZoomAt(f,v.left+v.width/2,v.top+v.height/2)}
const gvViewKey=()=>[gvW,gvEl.scrollLeft,gvEl.scrollTop].map(Math.round).join(',');
// Grid view: Fit with a selection shows the page of the selected module(s) (several pages, or a Euroburo Interface: the whole view)
function gvFitSel(){const ps=[...new Set(selUids().map(byUid).filter(m=>m&&!M.isEuro(m.type)&&m.page<gridPages()).map(m=>m.page))];if(ps.length!==1)return false;
  const p=ps[0];if(pageFilter>=0&&pageFilter<64&&pageFilter!==p){pageFilter=p;st.activePage=p;renderAll()}
  gvShowPage(p);gvFitAt={key:selUids().join(','),v:gvViewKey()};return true}
function gvFit(){clearTimeout(gvZoomAt.t);if(pageFilter>=0&&(pageFilter<64||pageFilter===M.EURO_PAGE))return gvShowPage(pageFilter);gvW=gvMinW();renderGridView();gvHome()}
// page menu in the Grid view: one page zoomed in so that it fills the view, centred (the other pages stay around it)
function gvShowPage(p){clearTimeout(gvZoomAt.t);const W0=gvEl.clientWidth-80,H0=gvEl.clientHeight-80-40;
  const eu=p===M.EURO_PAGE; // the Euroburo Interfaces: 12 x 6 buttons of the same size as a page's 8 x 5
  gvW=Math.min(GV_MAXW,Math.max(gvMinW(),Math.min(eu?W0*8/12:W0,eu?H0*8/6:H0*8/5)));renderGridView();gvHome();
  const g=gvEl.querySelector(`.grid8[data-page="${p}"]`);if(!g)return;const r=(eu?g:g.closest('.gvpage')).getBoundingClientRect(),v=gvEl.getBoundingClientRect(); // the Euroburo section spans the whole row: centre its grid
  gvEl.scrollLeft+=r.left+r.width/2-(v.left+v.width/2);gvEl.scrollTop+=r.top+r.height/2-(v.top+v.height/2)}
// free room around the grids (as on the canvas, they can be moved anywhere); home = grids at the top left, as before
function gvHome(){gvEl.scrollLeft=gvEl.clientWidth;gvEl.scrollTop=gvEl.clientHeight}
addEventListener('resize',()=>{if(gridView){gvW=Math.max(gvW,gvMinW());renderGridView()}});
function renderGridView(){if(!gridView)return;let h;gvRW=gvW;gvHi=gvSelUid(); // the selected module is framed (for a selected connection: the module it goes to)
  h=`<div class="gvwrap" style="padding:${gvEl.clientHeight}px ${gvEl.clientWidth}px"><div class="gvpages${gvW/8<GV_LBL?' gvs':gvW/8<GV_TYPE?' gvm':''}" style="--cw:${(gvW/8).toFixed(1)}px">`;
  // 0.506 (user 2026-10-19): buttons about 5 % smaller, the gap between them grows (Grid view: 3 px + 5 % of the column, Euroburo
  // button width to match; inspector grid 7 px instead of 5 px)
  // 0.484 (user 2026-10-17): the Euroburo Interfaces left of the pages, top edge level with them; the frame of the 5 x 8 grid in it
  // lies at the height of the top row's grids
  if(euroInPatch())h+=`<section class="gvpage gveuro${pageFilter>=0&&pageFilter!==M.EURO_PAGE?' gvoff':''}" style="--bw:${euroBw().toFixed(1)}px"><h4 title="Euroburo Interfaces: placed as on the front panel">Euroburo Interfaces</h4><div class="grid8" data-page="${M.EURO_PAGE}"><span class="gvframe"></span><span class="gvframe" style="grid-area:1/1/6/3"></span>${euroGridHTML()}</div></section>`;
  h+=`<div class="gvgrid" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(${gvCols()},${Math.round(gvW)}px)">`;
  for(let p=0;p<gridPages();p++)h+=`<section class="gvpage${pageFilter>=0&&p!==pageFilter?' gvoff':''}"><h4 title="${esc('Page '+p+(st.pages[p]?' · '+st.pages[p]:''))}">Page ${p}${st.pages[p]?' · '+esc(st.pages[p]):''}</h4><div class="grid8" data-page="${p}">${gridHTML(p,null)}${gvW/8>=GV_LBL?gridLabels(p):''}${gridHi(p)}</div></section>`;
  // Notes layer - now inside .gvpages so it shares the exact same transform during zoom
  h+=renderGridNotesLayerHTML();
  gvEl.innerHTML=h+'</div></div></div>';}
// Notes layer rendered inside .gvpages so it shares the exact same transform during zoom
function renderGridNotesLayerHTML(){
  // Build notes HTML in gvpages coordinates (no offset needed since inside .gvpages)
  if(!st.notes||!st.notes.length){
    return '<div class="gvnotes-layer" style="position:absolute;left:0;top:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:10;"></div>';
  }
  let h='<div class="gvnotes-layer" style="position:absolute;left:0;top:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:10;">';
  for(const n of st.notes){
    const selClass=noteSel===n.uid?' gvnote-sel':'';
    // Note positions are stored in gvpages coordinates at baseW; scale to current gvW
    const baseW = n.baseW || gvRW;
    const scale = gvW / baseW;
    const x = n.x * scale;
    const y = n.y * scale;
    const w = n.w * scale;
    const h_ = n.h * scale;
    h+=`<div class="gvnote${selClass}" data-uid="${n.uid}" style="left:${x}px;top:${y}px;width:${w}px;height:${h_}px;pointer-events:auto;">
      <div class="gvnote-hdr" title="Drag to move"></div>
      <div class="gvnote-text" contenteditable="true" spellcheck="false" data-uid="${n.uid}">${esc(n.text)}</div>
    </div>`;
  }
  // Note connections
  for(const c of st.noteConns||[]){
    const note=st.notes.find(n=>n.uid===c.note);
    if(!note)continue;
    let tx=0,ty=0;
    if(c.targetType==='module'){
      const m=byUid(c.target);
      if(!m)continue;
      const occ=M.occupancy(st,m.page);
      const cell=c.targetPos>=0?c.targetPos:m.pos;
      if(cell<0||cell>=40||!occ[cell].includes(m.uid))continue;
      const col=cell%8,row=cell>>3;
      const cols=gvCols();
      const pageIdx=m.page;
      const pageCol=pageIdx%cols;
      const pageRow=Math.floor(pageIdx/cols);
      const bw=gvW/8;
      const gap=gvGap(gvW);
      const pageW=gvW;
      const pageH=gvW*5/8+36;
      const pageX=pageCol*(pageW+gap);
      const pageY=pageRow*(pageH+gap);
      tx=pageX+col*bw+col*gap;
      ty=pageY+row*bw+row*gap;
    }else if(c.targetType==='cell'){
      const [page,cell]=c.target.split(',').map(Number);
      const col=cell%8,row=cell>>3;
      const cols=gvCols();
      const pageCol=page%cols;
      const pageRow=Math.floor(page/cols);
      const bw=gvW/8;
      const gap=gvGap(gvW);
      const pageW=gvW;
      const pageH=gvW*5/8+36;
      const pageX=pageCol*(pageW+gap);
      const pageY=pageRow*(pageH+gap);
      tx=pageX+col*bw+col*gap;
      ty=pageY+row*bw+row*gap;
    }
    // Scale note position for connection endpoint
    const baseW = note.baseW || gvRW;
    const scale = gvW / baseW;
    const nx = (note.x + note.w/2) * scale;
    const ny = (note.y + note.h/2) * scale;
    const tx_ = tx * scale;
    const ty_ = ty * scale;
    h+=`<svg class="gvnote-conn" style="position:absolute;left:0;top:0;pointer-events:none;width:${Math.max(nx,tx_)+50}px;height:${Math.max(ny,ty_)+50}px;">
      <path d="M${nx} ${ny} L${tx_} ${ty_}" stroke="var(--gold)" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="6,4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </svg>`;
  }
  h+='</div>';
  return h;
}
// Notes rendering in Grid View
function renderGridNotes(){
  if(!st.notes||!st.notes.length)return '';
  let h='<div class="gvnotes" style="position:absolute;left:0;top:0;pointer-events:none;">';
  for(const n of st.notes){
    const selClass=noteSel===n.uid?' gvnote-sel':'';
    h+=`<div class="gvnote${selClass}" data-uid="${n.uid}" style="left:${n.x}px;top:${n.y}px;width:${n.w}px;height:${n.h}px;pointer-events:auto;">
      <div class="gvnote-hdr" title="Drag to move"></div>
      <div class="gvnote-text" contenteditable="true" spellcheck="false" data-uid="${n.uid}">${esc(n.text)}</div>
    </div>`;
  }
  // Note connections - compute positions from layout data
  for(const c of st.noteConns||[]){
    const note=st.notes.find(n=>n.uid===c.note);
    if(!note)continue;
    let tx=0,ty=0;
    if(c.targetType==='module'){
      const m=byUid(c.target);
      if(!m)continue;
      const occ=M.occupancy(st,m.page);
      const cell=c.targetPos>=0?c.targetPos:m.pos;
      if(cell<0||cell>=40||!occ[cell].includes(m.uid))continue;
      const col=cell%8,row=cell>>3;
      // Compute page position in the gvpages coordinate system
      const cols=gvCols();
      const pageIdx=m.page;
      const pageCol=pageIdx%cols;
      const pageRow=Math.floor(pageIdx/cols);
      const bw=gvW/8;
      const gap=gvGap(gvW);
      const pageW=gvW;
      const pageH=gvW*5/8+36; // grid height + title
      const pageX=pageCol*(pageW+gap);
      const pageY=pageRow*(pageH+gap);
      tx=pageX+col*bw+col*gap;
      ty=pageY+row*bw+row*gap;
    }else if(c.targetType==='cell'){
      const [page,cell]=c.target.split(',').map(Number);
      const col=cell%8,row=cell>>3;
      const cols=gvCols();
      const pageCol=page%cols;
      const pageRow=Math.floor(page/cols);
      const bw=gvW/8;
      const gap=gvGap(gvW);
      const pageW=gvW;
      const pageH=gvW*5/8+36;
      const pageX=pageCol*(pageW+gap);
      const pageY=pageRow*(pageH+gap);
      tx=pageX+col*bw+col*gap;
      ty=pageY+row*bw+row*gap;
    }
    const nx=note.x+note.w/2,ny=note.y+note.h/2;
    h+=`<svg class="gvnote-conn" style="position:absolute;left:0;top:0;pointer-events:none;width:${Math.max(nx,tx)+50}px;height:${Math.max(ny,ty)+50}px;">
      <path d="M${nx} ${ny} L${tx} ${ty}" stroke="var(--gold)" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="6,4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </svg>`;
  }
  h+='</div>';
  return h;
}

function gvGoTo(m){

  gvEl.scrollLeft+=cx-(v.left+v.width/2);gvEl.scrollTop+=cy-(v.top+v.height/2)}

// Context menu for adding notes
gvEl.addEventListener('contextmenu',e=>{
  if(!gridView)return;
  if(noteDragging)return;
  const note=gvNoteAt(e.clientX,e.clientY);
  const cell=e.target.closest('[data-cell]');
  const euroBtn=e.target.closest('[data-euro]');
  const moduleEl=e.target.closest('.node');
  if(note||cell||euroBtn||moduleEl)return; // Don't show on existing notes, cells, modules
  // Allow context menu on gvpages (grids) or gvwrap (padding area), but not on other elements
  const gvpages=gvEl.querySelector('.gvpages');
  const gvwrap=gvEl.querySelector('.gvwrap');
  if(!gvpages||(!gvpages.contains(e.target)&&!gvwrap.contains(e.target)))return;
  e.preventDefault();
  // Capture the click position in gvpages UNTRANSFORMED coordinates
  // gvpages may have a CSS transform scale during zoom preview
  const pagesRect=gvpages.getBoundingClientRect();
  const gvpagesStyle=window.getComputedStyle(gvpages);
  const transform=gvpagesStyle.transform;
  let scale=1;
  if(transform&&transform!=='none'){
    const m=transform.match(/matrix\(([^)]+)\)/);
    if(m){scale=parseFloat(m[1].split(',')[0])||1}
  }
  const noteX=(e.clientX-pagesRect.left)/scale;
  const noteY=(e.clientY-pagesRect.top)/scale;
  
  const menu=document.createElement('div');
  menu.style.cssText='position:fixed;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--gold);border-radius:6px;padding:4px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);z-index:100;min-width:140px';
  menu.innerHTML='<button class="btn sm" style="width:100%;text-align:left;padding:6px 10px" id="gvAddNote">Add Note</button>';
  document.body.appendChild(menu);
  menu.style.left=e.clientX+'px';
  menu.style.top=e.clientY+'px';
  // Use setTimeout to avoid immediate click event from contextmenu triggering close
  setTimeout(()=>{
    const close=()=>{menu.remove();document.removeEventListener('click',close)};
    document.addEventListener('click',close,{once:true});
  },0);
  $('#gvAddNote').onclick=()=>{
    commit();
    const uid=M.uid();
    st.notes.push({uid,text:'',x:noteX,y:noteY,w:200,h:100,baseW:gvRW});
    noteSel=uid;
    // Preserve scroll position during renderGridView
    const scrollLeft=gvEl.scrollLeft,scrollTop=gvEl.scrollTop;
    renderGridView();
    gvEl.scrollLeft=scrollLeft;gvEl.scrollTop=scrollTop;
    // Focus the text area
    setTimeout(()=>{const txt=gvEl.querySelector(`.gvnote[data-uid="${uid}"] .gvnote-text`);if(txt)txt.focus()},0);
    menu.remove();
  };
});

// Note dragging
gvEl.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
  if(!gridView)return;
  const hdr=e.target.closest('.gvnote-hdr');
  if(!hdr)return;
  const note=hdr.closest('.gvnote');
  if(!note)return;
  const uid=note.dataset.uid;
  const n=st.notes.find(x=>x.uid===uid);
  if(!n)return;
  e.preventDefault();
  e.stopPropagation();
  // Get current effective scale from baseW to screen pixels
  // Note is inside .gvpages which has CSS transform; note CSS position is in baseW space
  const gvpages=gvEl.querySelector('.gvpages');
  const cssScale=gvpages?parseFloat(gvpages.style.transform.replace(/[^0-9.-]/g,''))||1:1;
  // Note positions are stored in baseW; CSS left/top = n.x * (gvW/baseW) but renderGridNotesLayerHTML uses scale=gvW/baseW
  // During preview: baseW=gvRW, gvW updated, render not re-run, so CSS pos = n.x (scale=1), .gvpages transform = gvW/gvRW
  // After commit: baseW=gvRW=gvW, render re-run, CSS pos = n.x, .gvpages transform = 1
  // Effective scale from baseW to screen = cssScale (since render scale = 1 during preview, 1 after commit)
  const effectiveScale = cssScale;
  // Capture grab offset in baseW coordinates: distance from note's left edge to mouse pointer
  const noteEl = gvEl.querySelector(`.gvnotes-layer .gvnote[data-uid="${uid}"]`);
  let grabOffsetX = 0, grabOffsetY = 0;
  if (noteEl) {
    const noteRect = noteEl.getBoundingClientRect();
    const pagesRect = gvpages.getBoundingClientRect();
    // Grab offset in screen pixels relative to note's left edge
    const screenGrabX = e.clientX - noteRect.left;
    const screenGrabY = e.clientY - noteRect.top;
    // Convert to baseW coordinates
    grabOffsetX = screenGrabX / effectiveScale;
    grabOffsetY = screenGrabY / effectiveScale;
  }
  // Store start mouse position in BASEW coordinates (screen pixels / effectiveScale)
  const startMouseX = e.clientX / effectiveScale;
  const startMouseY = e.clientY / effectiveScale;
  // ox/oy = note's left edge position in baseW coordinates at drag start
  // grabOffsetX/Y = distance from note's left edge to mouse pointer in baseW coordinates
  noteDrag={uid,sx:startMouseX,sy:startMouseY,ox:n.x,oy:n.y,moved:false,id:e.pointerId,scale:effectiveScale,grabOffsetX,grabOffsetY};
  noteDragging=true;
  try{gvEl.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)}catch(_){}
});

gvEl.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{
  if(!noteDrag||noteDrag.id!==e.pointerId)return;
  if(!noteDrag.moved&&Math.abs(e.clientX-noteDrag.sx)+Math.abs(e.clientY-noteDrag.sy)>3){
    noteDrag.moved=true;
    gvEl.classList.add('gvmoving');
  }
  if(noteDrag.moved){
    // Convert current pointer position to baseW coordinates using effective scale
    const currentMouseX = e.clientX / noteDrag.scale;
    const currentMouseY = e.clientY / noteDrag.scale;
    // Movement in baseW coordinates = current mouse position - start mouse position (both in baseW)
    const dx = currentMouseX - noteDrag.sx;
    const dy = currentMouseY - noteDrag.sy;
    const n=st.notes.find(x=>x.uid===noteDrag.uid);
    if(n){
      // New position = original position + movement in baseW coordinates
      n.x = noteDrag.ox + dx;
      n.y = noteDrag.oy + dy;
      // Update DOM element in .gvnotes-layer (now inside .gvpages)
      // Note positions are stored in baseW coordinates; renderGridNotesLayerHTML uses scale=gvW/baseW
      // During preview: baseW=gvRW, gvW updated, CSS pos = n.x (scale=1), .gvpages transform = gvW/gvRW
      // After commit: baseW=gvRW=gvW, CSS pos = n.x, .gvpages transform = 1
      // So CSS left/top = n.x (always in baseW coordinates)
      const gvpages=gvEl.querySelector('.gvpages');
      if(gvpages){
        const el=gvEl.querySelector(`.gvnotes-layer .gvnote[data-uid="${n.uid}"]`);
        if(el){el.style.left=n.x+'px';el.style.top=n.y+'px';}
      }
    }
  }
});

['pointerup','pointercancel'].forEach(ev=>gvEl.addEventListener(ev,e=>{
  if(!noteDrag||noteDrag.id!==e.pointerId)return;
  if(noteDrag.moved){
    commit();
    const n=st.notes.find(x=>x.uid===noteDrag.uid);
    if(n){
      n.baseW = gvRW;
      toast('Note moved.',2000);
    }
  }
  noteDrag=null;
  noteDragging=false;
  gvEl.classList.remove('gvmoving');
}));

['pointerup','pointercancel'].forEach(ev=>gvEl.addEventListener(ev,e=>{
  if(!noteConnDrag)return;
  if(ev==='pointercancel'||!noteConnDrag.cur){
    noteConnDrag=null;
    setHint('');
    renderGridView();
    return;
  }
  // Find target
  const target=e.target.closest('[data-euro]')||e.target.closest('[data-cell]')||e.target.closest('.node');
  if(target){
    let targetInfo=null;
    if(target.dataset.euro){
      // Euroburo module
      targetInfo={type:'module',target:target.dataset.euro,targetType:'module',targetPos:-1};
    }else if(target.dataset.cell){
      const page=+target.closest('[data-page]').dataset.page;
      const cell=+target.dataset.cell;
      targetInfo={type:'cell',target:`${page},${cell}`,targetType:'cell',targetPos:cell};
    }else if(target.dataset.uid){
      const m=byUid(target.dataset.uid);
      if(m){
        // Find which cell this module occupies at the pointer position
        const occ=M.occupancy(st,m.page);
        // For simplicity, use the first cell of the module
        const firstCell=m.pos;
        targetInfo={type:'module',target:m.uid,targetType:'module',targetPos:firstCell};
      }
    }
    if(targetInfo){
      commit();
      st.noteConns.push({uid:M.uid(),note:noteConnDrag.note,...targetInfo});
      toast('Annotation connection created.',2000);
    }
  }
  noteConnDrag=null;
  setHint('');
  renderGridView();
}));

// Delete note with Delete/Backspace
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  if(!gridView)return;
  if((e.key==='Delete'||e.key==='Backspace')&&noteSel){
    e.preventDefault();
    const idx=st.notes.findIndex(n=>n.uid===noteSel);
    if(idx>=0){
      commit();
      st.notes.splice(idx,1);
      // Remove associated connections
      st.noteConns=st.noteConns.filter(c=>c.note!==noteSel);
      noteSel=null;
      renderGridView();
      toast('Note deleted.',2000);
    }
  }
});

// Update renderGridView to include note connections preview
const originalRenderGridView=renderGridView;
renderGridView=function(){
  originalRenderGridView();
  // Draw note connection preview if dragging
  if(noteConnDrag&&noteConnDrag.cur){
    const gvpages=gvEl.querySelector('.gvpages');
    if(!gvpages)return;
    const note=st.notes.find(n=>n.uid===noteConnDrag.note);
    if(!note)return;
    const noteEl=gvEl.querySelector(`.gvnote[data-uid="${note.uid}"]`);
    if(!noteEl)return;
    const noteRect=noteEl.getBoundingClientRect();
    const pagesRect=gvpages.getBoundingClientRect();
    const nx=noteRect.left-pagesRect.left+noteRect.width/2;
    const ny=noteRect.top-pagesRect.top+noteRect.height/2;
    const tx=noteConnDrag.cur.x-pagesRect.left;
    const ty=noteConnDrag.cur.y-pagesRect.top;
    // Add preview SVG
    const svg=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','svg');
    svg.className='gvnote-conn-preview';
    svg.style.cssText='position:absolute;left:0;top:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:20;width:100%;height:100%';
    svg.innerHTML=`<path d="M${nx} ${ny} L${tx} ${ty}" stroke="var(--gold)" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="6,4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>`;
    gvpages.appendChild(svg);
  }
};

// By page <-> By signal: the zoom stays; the selected module (else the one nearest the middle of the view) is centred afterwards
function focusUid(){if(sel&&sel.kind==='m'&&byUid(sel.uid))return sel.uid;const ms=st.modules.filter(m=>pageFilter<0||m.page===pageFilter);if(!ms.length)return null;
  const r=stage.getBoundingClientRect(),c=toWorld(r.left+r.width/2,r.top+r.height/2);let best=Infinity,u=null;
  for(const m of ms){const dx=X(m)+W/2-c.x,dy=m.y+M.nodeHeight(m)/2-c.y,d=dx*dx+dy*dy;if(d<best){best=d;u=m.uid}}return u}
function centreOn(m,k){const r=stage.getBoundingClientRect();st.view={k,x:r.width/2-(X(m)+W/2)*k,y:r.height/2-(m.y+M.nodeHeight(m)/2)*k};applyView()}
// an undo step only if the layout really changed (leaving the Grid view to the same layout is not one)
// the page chosen in the Grid view stays for By page (leaving the Grid view would otherwise reset it when it came from By signal)
function switchLayout(mode){const pf=pageFilter;if(gridView)setGridView(false);const k=st.view.k,u=focusUid(),was=pack({...st,view:null}),rs=redoStack.slice();commit(true);st.layoutMode=mode;
  if(mode==='signal'){pageFilter=-1;M.signalLayout(st)}else{pageFilter=pf;M.autoLayout(st)}
  if(pack({...st,view:null})===was){undoStack.pop();redoStack.push(...rs)}
  renderAll();if(selUids().length&&fitSel())return;const m=u&&byUid(u);if(fitMode||!m)fit();else centreOn(m,k)} // 0.450: with a selection, as Fit on it
$('#bByPage').onclick=()=>switchLayout('page');
$('#bBySignal').onclick=()=>switchLayout('signal');
stage.addEventListener('dragover',e=>{if(e.dataTransfer.types.includes('text/zoia-type')){e.preventDefault();e.dataTransfer.dropEffect='copy'}});

// ---------- rendering ----------
function nodeHTML(m){
  const d=Z.mod(m.type),p=ports(m),pv=p.ins.concat(p.outs),h=M.nodeHeight(m);
  const dim=pageFilter>=0&&m.page!==pageFilter;
  const stk=stackText(m);
  const iss=issues.filter(i=>i.uid===m.uid&&i.level!=='info').map(i=>i.msg).join('\n'); // notes (info) get no ! mark
  let rows='';

  p.outs.forEach((b,i)=>{const y=HEAD+i*ROW;rows+=`<div class="port ${b.type.startsWith('audio')?'audio':'cv'}" data-port="out" data-pos="${b.pos}" style="right:-7px;top:${y+4}px" title="${esc(blTip(m,b.name,pv)+(seqOutInfo(m,b.name)?'\n'+seqOutInfo(m,b.name):''))}"></div><div class="prow out ${b.type.startsWith('audio')?'audio':'cv'}" style="top:${y}px"><span class="t">${esc(bl(m,b.name,pv))}</span></div>`});
  const unused=isLoose(m),standalone=noConnNeeded(m)&&!st.conns.some(c=>c.sm===m.uid||c.dm===m.uid);const showPg=true; // 0.465 (user 2026-10-16): the page number always, also with a page chosen (the other pages stay visible, dimmed)

}

function hwIcon(m){
  if(m.type===81)return pixelIcon(m);
  if(m.type===56)return uiBtnIcon(m);
  if(m.type===97||m.type===98)return pbColourIcon(m)+hwSvg(HW[m.type]);
  const h=m.type===44&&optVal(m,'stompswitch')==='ext'?['stompext','External footswitch on the ZOIA control port']:HW[m.type];if(!h)return'';
  return hwSvg(h);
}
function hwSvg(h){return '<svg class="euroic" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" role="img" aria-label="'+h[1]+'" title="'+h[1]+'">'+ICO[h[0]]+'</svg>'} // title attribute (styled tooltip), no <title> element: that would show the browser's own grey tooltip
// Euroburo pushbutton: its LED colour (the module colour). Latching and on after loading: lit; otherwise dark until pressed.
function pbColourIcon(m){const c=colHex(m.color),on=isLatch(m)&&m.saved&&m.saved[0]===1;
  return `<span class="pxic solid" style="border-color:${c};background:${on?c:'var(--panel)'}" title="Colour: ${COLORS[m.color]?COLORS[m.color][0]:'White'}, ${isLatch(m)?(on?'on':'off')+' after loading':'lit while pressed'}"></span>`}
// Pixel: a grid button in the module colour. No cable and CV mode: outline in the button colour, fill brightness = the stored cv_in value (like the LED).
// Cable on cv_in or audio mode: a diagonal gradient (the brightness follows the signal).
function pixelIcon(m){
  const c=colHex(m.color),audio=!!(m.options&&m.options[0]),wired=st.conns.some(x=>x.dm===m.uid&&x.db===(audio?1:0));
  if(audio||wired)return `<span class="pxic" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,transparent 15%,${c} 85%)" title="pixel: brightness follows the ${audio?'audio':'CV'} signal"></span>`;
  const v=m.lockedParams?0:M.getParam(m,'cv_in')/65535;
  const b=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,v));
  return `<span class="pxic solid" style="border-color:${c};background:color-mix(in srgb,${c} ${Math.round(b*100)}%,var(--panel))" title="pixel: ${COLORS[m.color]?COLORS[m.color][0]:'White'}, ${Math.round(Math.max(0,Math.min(1,v))*100)} % brightness"></span>`;
}
// UI Button: a grid button whose colour and brightness come from its input value (colour table from the Empress module description;
// in each colour band the brightness rises from the band start to full at "max bright"). Not verified on the device yet.

function uiBtnColour(m,raw){const ext=optVal(m,'range')==='extended',L=ext?UIB_EXT:UIB_BASIC,w=ext?0.05:0.1,full=ext?0.0375:0.074,v=raw/65535;
  const i=Math.min(L.length-1,Math.floor(v/w+1e-9)),over=v>=L.length*w,b=over?1:Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(v-i*w)/full));return{c:L[i],b,over}}

}

function midiSub(m){
  if(HW[m.type]?.[0]!=='midi')return'';
  const ch=optVal(m,'midi_channel'),cc=optVal(m,'controller');
  const t=[ch!=null?'Ch '+ch:'',cc!=null?'CC '+cc:''].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
  return t?`<span class="midi">${t}</span>`:'';
}
// Parameters with a fixed setting that matters: shown as text instead of the line in the module
function fixedVal(m,name,raw){
  const t=m.type,v=raw/65535;
  if(t===28&&(name==='key'||name==='scale'))return fmtParam(t,name,raw,m.options,m);
  if(t===49&&name==='dividend')return '×'+Math.round(1+v*31);
  if(t===49&&name==='divisor')return '÷'+Math.round(1+v*31);
  if(t===18&&name==='quant_steps')return String(Math.round(2+v*61));
  if((t===31||t===33)&&name==='in_select'||t===34&&name==='in_select'||t===32&&name==='out_select'){
    const n=+(optVal(m,t===31||t===33?'num_inputs':'num_outputs'))||1;return (t===32||t===34?'out ':'in ')+(Math.round(v*(n-1))+1)}
  if(t===62&&name==='pc')return 'PC '+Math.round(v*127);
  return null;
}

// 0.473 (user 2026-10-17): the "All pages" entry stays plain: the page shows on the modules and the page titles, and the menu keeps

function updatePageInView(){const opt=$('#pageSel')&&$('#pageSel').querySelector('option[value="-1"]');if(opt)opt.textContent='All pages'}
const isLevel=(a,b)=>Math.abs(b.y-a.y)<10&&Math.hypot(b.x-a.x,b.y-a.y)>30;
function wirePath(a,b,sag){const dx=Math.max(40,Math.abs(b.x-a.x)/2);
  // a level connection stays perfectly straight, unless it would lie on top of another level connection:
  // then it sags a little like a real cable (longer cables sag more, so parallel cables of different length stay apart)
  const len=Math.hypot(b.x-a.x,b.y-a.y),s=sag&&isLevel(a,b)?Math.min(36,8+len*0.05):0;
  return`M${a.x} ${a.y}C${a.x+dx} ${a.y+s} ${b.x-dx} ${b.y+s} ${b.x} ${b.y}`}
function renderWires(){
  let s='',mvTop='';
  // level connections that lie on top of a shorter level connection (same height, overlapping) get a sag
  const lv=[];for(const c of st.conns){const a=byUid(c.sm),b=byUid(c.dm);if(!a||!b)continue;const p1=portXY(a,c.sb,'out'),p2=portXY(b,c.db,'in');if(isLevel(p1,p2))lv.push({c,y:(p1.y+p2.y)/2,x0:Math.min(p1.x,p2.x),x1:Math.max(p1.x,p2.x)})}
  lv.sort((p,q)=>p.y-q.y);const sagSet=new Set();
  for(let i=0;i<lv.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<lv.length&&lv[j].y-lv[i].y<6;j++)if(lv[i].x0<lv[j].x1&&lv[j].x0<lv[i].x1){const li=lv[i].x1-lv[i].x0,lj=lv[j].x1-lv[j].x0;sagSet.add(li>lj||(li===lj&&i>j)?lv[i].c:lv[j].c)} // of two overlapping level cables the shorter stays straight, the longer sags
  for(const c of st.conns){const a=byUid(c.sm),b=byUid(c.dm);if(!a||!b)continue;
    let p1=portXY(a,c.sb,'out'),p2=portXY(b,c.db,'in');
    if(rewire&&rewire.c===c&&rewire.cur){if(rewire.end==='src')p1={x:rewire.cur.x,y:rewire.cur.y};else p2={x:rewire.cur.x,y:rewire.cur.y}}
    const d=wirePath(p1,p2,sagSet.has(c));
    const moving=rewire&&rewire.c===c&&rewire.cur;
    const kind=blockType(a,c.sb).startsWith('audio')?'audio':'cv';const on=sel&&sel.kind==='c'&&sel.uid===c.uid;
    const mSel=sel&&sel.kind==='m'&&!pending&&!rewire,rel=mSel&&(c.sm===sel.uid||c.dm===sel.uid); // a selected module half-highlights its connections and dims the others
    const dim=pageFilter>=0&&a.page!==pageFilter&&b.page!==pageFilter;
    const off=focus!=='all'&&kind!==focus&&!on; // focus mode: connections of the other kind fade and cannot be clicked
    const op=(off?.08:dim?.15:Math.max(.35,Math.min(1,(c.st-6000)/4000)))*(mSel&&!rel&&!off?.5:1);
    if(moving){mvTop+=`<path class="w ${kind} sel" d="${d}"/>`;continue} // a connection being re-plugged is drawn on the top layer
    s+=`<path class="w ${kind}${p1.hidden||p2.hidden?' hidden':''}${on?' sel':rel&&!off?' rel':''}" d="${d}" style="opacity:${on||rel&&!off?1:op}"/>${off?'':`<path class="hit" data-conn="${c.uid}" d="${d}"/>`}`;
    if(on&&!(rewire&&rewire.cur)){ // drag handles: grab an end to plug the connection somewhere else
      s+=`<circle class="wh ${kind}" data-c="${c.uid}" data-end="src" cx="${p1.x+16}" cy="${p1.y}" r="6" title="Drag to another output to move this end"></circle><circle class="wh ${kind}" data-c="${c.uid}" data-end="dst" cx="${p2.x-16}" cy="${p2.y}" r="6" title="Drag to another input to move this end"></circle>`}
  }
  let top='';
  if(pending&&pending.cur&&byUid(pending.uid)){const m=byUid(pending.uid);const p=portXY(m,pending.pos,pending.dir);top+=`<path class="pending ${blockType(m,pending.pos).startsWith('audio')?'audio':'cv'}" d="${pending.dir==='out'?wirePath(p,pending.cur):wirePath(pending.cur,p)}"/>`}
  wires.innerHTML=s;$('#wiresTop').innerHTML=top+mvTop;markSelPorts();
}
// the two sockets of the selected connection get the same highlight and glow as its wire
function markSelPorts(){document.querySelectorAll('.port.csel,.port.crel').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('csel','crel'));document.querySelectorAll('.node.nbr').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('nbr'));world.classList.remove('msel');
  const q=(uid,dir,pos)=>document.querySelector(`.node[data-uid="${uid}"] .port[data-port="${dir}"][data-pos="${pos}"]`);
  if(sel&&sel.kind==='m'&&!pending&&!rewire){ // half highlight (off while a connection is being drawn, so every target stays fully visible): the module's connections, their sockets and the directly connected modules
    for(const c of st.conns){if(c.sm!==sel.uid&&c.dm!==sel.uid)continue;const a=byUid(c.sm);if(focus!=='all'&&a&&(blockType(a,c.sb).startsWith('audio')?'audio':'cv')!==focus)continue;
      [q(c.sm,'out',c.sb),q(c.dm,'in',c.db)].forEach(x=>x&&x.classList.add('crel'));
      const o=c.sm===sel.uid?c.dm:c.sm;if(o!==sel.uid){const n=document.querySelector(`.node[data-uid="${o}"]`);if(n)n.classList.add('nbr')}}
    world.classList.add('msel'); // modules that are not directly connected dim slightly
    return}
  const c=sel&&sel.kind==='c'&&connBy(sel.uid);if(!c)return;

function patchStatus(){ // status line of the patch inspector: [class, text]
  const e=issues.filter(i=>i.level==='error').length,wn=issues.filter(i=>i.level==='warn').length;
  const empty=!st.modules.length&&!e&&!wn; // an empty patch is neither ready nor faulty
  const same=!dirty&&!empty; // opened (or just saved/exported) and not modified since
  const txt=e?e+(e>1?' errors':' error')+(wn?' · '+wn+(wn>1?' warnings':' warning'):''):wn?wn+(wn>1?' warnings':' warning'):empty?'Empty patch':same?'Unchanged':'Ready to export';
  return [e?'err':wn?'warn':empty?'':same?'same':'ok',txt+((e||wn)&&same?' · Unchanged':''),same?'Nothing has been changed since the patch was opened, saved or exported.':e||wn?'See the checks below.':empty?'':'Changed, no errors or warnings.'];
}

  if(!gridView&&signalMode())return [null,null];

  return [i>0?L[i-1]:null,i<L.length-1?L[i+1]:null];
}

// 0.491 (user 2026-10-17): Edit Parameter as on the device: the circle (the slider's handle) is the knob value, the "bias"; the
// stroke is the result (bias + the connections), the big number shows the result, the line is filled up to it. Without a cable
// the stroke runs through the circle. With a moving source (LFO, sequencer …) ZoE does not know the result: no stroke, the
// number is the bias, and the line below names the modulation. M.inputValue knows the result for value modules as sources.
// 0.494: a value 0..1 (or -1..1) with 3 decimals and a real minus sign
const f3=v=>(v<0?'−':'')+Math.abs(v).toFixed(3);
function inputShown(m,name){if(m.type===4)return{bias:stepVal(m,name),value:stepVal(m,name),kind:'',neg:0};const r=M.inputValue(st,m,name);
  return{bias:r.bias,value:r.fixed?r.value:r.bias,neg:r.fixed?r.neg:0,kind:!r.cabled?'':r.fixed?'fx':'mod',r}}
// 0.494 (user 2026-10-18): the big number as the device shows it: below 0 the firmware's negative text where it is certain
// (M.displayTextNeg), else the text at 0 marked "below" (user: a). Returns { text, below }.
function shownText(m,name,x){const f=v=>fmtParam(m.type,name,v,m.options,m);if(!x.neg)return{text:f(x.value)};
  const t=M.displayTextNeg(m.type,name,x.neg,m.options,m.version|0,M.viewOf(m,name));return t===undefined?{text:f(0),below:true}:{text:t==null?f(0):t}} // null: no firmware table (state blocks): ZoE's own text
const BELOW_TIP='The sum is below 0: the stroke stays at the left end. The device shows a value below the start of the range here; ZoE does not know its text yet and shows the text at 0.';
// the value text for tooltips (canvas port, Grid view): the result as the device shows it, the bias in brackets when it differs
function inputText(m,name){const x=inputShown(m,name),f=v=>fmtParam(m.type,name,v,m.options,m),y=shownText(m,name,x),res=(y.below?'below ':'')+y.text;
  return x.kind==='fx'?res+(x.value!==x.bias||x.neg?' (bias '+f(x.bias)+')':''):x.kind==='mod'?'bias '+f(x.bias)+' + modulation':res}
function rngSync(box,m,name){const x=inputShown(m,name),rg=box.querySelector('.rng'),inp=rg&&rg.querySelector('input');if(!rg)return;
  const bp=x.bias/655.35,vp=x.value/655.35;rg.className='rng'+(x.kind?' '+x.kind:'');rg.style.setProperty('--v',vp.toFixed(2));inp.style.setProperty('--pct',(x.kind==='mod'?bp:vp).toFixed(2)+'%');
  const pvEl=box.querySelector('[data-pv]'),y=shownText(m,name,x);pvEl.textContent=y.text;
  const tag=w=>{const k=document.createElement('small');k.className='pvb';k.textContent=w+' ';pvEl.prepend(k)};
  if(x.kind==='mod')tag('bias'); // user 21:54: without a stroke it must be clear that only the bias is known
  if(y.below)tag('below');
  // 0.501 (user 2026-10-18): no raw value (0..65535); without a cable the 0..1 value only when the big text is another unit
  // (Hz, ms, dB, notes …), not when it is the same number already
  const plain=/^-?\d+\.\d+$/.test(y.text.trim())&&Math.abs(parseFloat(y.text))<=1;
  let t=plain?'':f3(x.bias/65536);
  if(x.kind==='fx'){const T=x.r.total;
    t='bias '+f3(x.bias/65536)+x.r.parts.map(p=>' + ['+mlabel(p.m)+'] '+f3(p.v)+(Math.abs(p.f-1)>.0005?' × '+fmtPct(p.f*100):'')).join('')+' = '+f3(T)+(T>=1-1/65536?' (upper end)':T<0?' (below 0)':'')+(x.r.limited?' (sum limited to ±4 on the way, as the device does)':'')}
  else if(x.kind==='mod'){const src=[...new Set(st.conns.filter(c=>c.dm===m.uid&&c.db===(M.paramList(m).find(b=>b.name===name)||{}).pos).map(c=>'['+mlabel(byUid(c.sm))+']'))];
    t='bias '+f3(x.bias/65536)+src.map(x=>' + '+x).join('')} // 0.493 (user 2026-10-18): the same sum as with a fixed input, without value and result; the tooltip explains
  box.querySelector('[data-raw]').textContent=t;
  // user 21:55: the tooltip explains each of the three states
  const srcs=x.kind?[...new Set(st.conns.filter(c=>c.dm===m.uid&&c.db===(M.paramList(m).find(b=>b.name===name)||{}).pos).map(c=>'['+mlabel(byUid(c.sm))+']'))].join(', '):'';
  const tip=x.kind==='fx'?'**Bias and input: the result is known\nThe circle is the knob value (bias). The stroke and the number show the result as the device shows it: the bias plus the value from '+srcs+'.\n'+t+'\nAt 0 or 1 the stroke stops; turning further moves only the circle.'+(x.neg?'\nBelow 0 the stroke stays at 0; the number shows the value below 0 as the device does.':'')+(y.below?'\n'+BELOW_TIP:'')
    :x.kind==='mod'?'**Bias only: the input value is not known\nThe circle and the number are the knob value (bias). '+srcs+' adds a changing value; the device shows the result as a moving stroke. ZoE cannot know it, so there is no stroke.'
    :'**Bias only: no cable at this input\nThe knob value is the result: circle and stroke lie on top of each other, as on the device.';
  rg.title=tip;box.querySelector('[data-raw]').title=tip;if(pvEl.dataset.t0==null)pvEl.dataset.t0=pvEl.title;pvEl.title=y.below?BELOW_TIP:pvEl.dataset.t0}

function gridHTML(page,sel){
  const occ=M.occupancy(st,page),n=sel?M.visible(sel).length:0;
  const mine=c=>!!sel&&c>=sel.pos&&c<sel.pos+n;
  const owner=c=>c<0||c>=40?null:mine(c)?sel:(occ[c].length?byUid(occ[c][occ[c].length-1]):null); // occupancy order = patch order, last = top
  let h='';
  for(let c=0;c<40;c++){
    const o=owner(c),me=mine(c),col=c%8;
    const kind=!o?'':me?'me':sel?'occ':'full';
    // sequencer: track outputs show their track colour, the steps the colour of the shown track (as on the device); a 6 px stripe
    // at the top keeps the module colour visible (user 2026-10-16)
    const oc=o&&o.type===4?seqOutColour(o,c)||seqStepColour(o,c):null,oo=oc?{...o,color:oc}:o;
    const ga=`grid-area:${(c>>3)+1}/${col+1};--gc:${o?colHex(oo.color):'transparent'}${kind==='full'?';--fill:'+cellFill(oo):''}`;
    if(o){
      if(owner(c+1)===o)h+=`<i class="gj ${col===7?'sr':'r'} ${kind}" style="${ga}"></i>`; // r: to the next button; sr: goes on in the next row
      if(col===0&&owner(c-1)===o)h+=`<i class="gj sl ${kind}" style="${ga}"></i>`;      // sl: comes from the previous row
      // end: the module runs past button 40 (hidden on the device); the same piece as sr, longer and fading out
      if(c===39&&M.hiddenByPageEnd(o).length)h+=`<i class="gj sr end ${kind}" style="${ga}"></i>`;
    }
    const stack=occ[c].length,names=occ[c].slice().reverse().map(u=>(gridView&&!sel&&stack>1&&gvHi===u?'\u25b8 ':'')+gvName(byUid(u))).join(' on top of ');
    // the block of the top module on this button: device name and help (as the device's block help)
    // tooltip parts, separated by lines ('---'): block name with its value, the block's help, the hidden-blocks note on button 40
    // block part: the selected module if it lies on this button (Grid view, click), else the top one
    const bo=gridView&&!sel&&gvHi&&occ[c].includes(gvHi)?byUid(gvHi):o;
    const blk=bo&&!M.isEuro(bo.type)?gridBlock(bo,c):null,bh=blk?bHelp(bo.type,blk.name):'';
    const bv=blk&&blk.param&&!bo.lockedParams?inputText(bo,blk.name):blk&&bo.type===4?seqOutInfo(bo,blk.name):null;
    // first line: the whole module (or modules); second line: the block on this button, with the button number at the right
    const bt=blk?'\n---\n'+bl(bo,blk.name,gvVis(bo))+(bv!=null?' = '+bv:'')+'\tB '+(c+1)+(bh?'\n---\n'+bh:''):o?'\n---\n\tB '+(c+1):'';
    const hid=c===39&&o?M.hiddenByPageEnd(o):[],hn=hid.length,ht=hn?`\n---\n${hn} block${hn>1?'s':''} hidden past the end of the page (button${hn>1?'s '+hid[0].button+'–'+hid[hn-1].button:' '+hid[0].button})`:'';
    h+=`<button type="button" data-cell="${c}" class="${kind}${oc?' seqc':''}" style="${ga}${oc?';--mc:'+colHex(o.color):''}" title="${esc((names?names:'B '+(c+1))+bt+ht)}">${stack>1?`<span class="stk">${stack}</span>`:''}</button>`;
  }
  return h;
}

function gridLabels(page){const occ=M.occupancy(st,page),top=c=>occ[c].length?occ[c][occ[c].length-1]:null,by=new Map();

    // 0.425: the other parts of the module get no label: the stubs at the row ends show where it goes on
  }

// white text wherever it reads; dark text only on very light fills (white, yellow, lime): relative luminance above 0.5
function lightFill(m){let hex=colHex(m.color),b=1;
  if(m.type===81&&!(m.options&&m.options[0])&&!st.conns.some(x=>x.dm===m.uid&&x.db===0))b=m.lockedParams?0:M.getParam(m,'cv_in')/65535;
  else if(m.type===56&&!st.conns.some(x=>x.dm===m.uid&&x.db===0)){const u=uiBtnColour(m,m.lockedParams?0:M.getParam(m,'in'));hex=colHex(u.c);b=u.b}
  const lin=[1,3,5].map(i=>parseInt(hex.substr(i,2),16)/255).map(v=>v<=0.03928?v/12.92:Math.pow((v+0.055)/1.055,2.4));
  return b>0.6&&(0.2126*lin[0]+0.7152*lin[1]+0.0722*lin[2])>0.5}

  return c}

  const optTip=(i,name)=>{const h=M.optHelp(m.type,i),z=OPT_HELP[m.type+':'+name];return [h||(z?'':odesc(name)),z].filter(Boolean).join('\n\n')};

  const params=m.lockedParams?`<p class="note">The stored parameter count (${m.lockedParams.length}) does not match the known layout of this module.     const qs=m.type===28&&(b.name==='scale'||b.name==='key')?(b.name==='key'?QKEYS.map(k=>[k,k]):qScales(m.options).map(x=>[x[0],x[2]===x[0]?x[0]:x[2]+' ('+x[0]+')'])):null;

  const cons=st.conns.filter(c=>c.sm===m.uid||c.dm===m.uid).map(c=>{const a=byUid(c.sm),b=byUid(c.dm);const out=c.sm===m.uid;
    // block names with the device's help text as tooltip
    const bn=(mm,pos)=>{const x=Z.mod(mm.type).b.find(q=>q[1]===pos);return `<span class="cbn" title="${esc(x?blTip(mm,x[0]):'#'+pos)}">${esc((x?bl(mm,x[0]):'#'+pos).replace(/ /g,'\u00a0'))}</span>`};const ARR=' <i class="arr">→</i> ';

  const head=()=>modCard(m,[['Inputs:',esc(p.ins.map(b=>bl(m,b.name)).join(', ')||'–')],['Outputs:',esc(p.outs.map(b=>bl(m,b.name)).join(', ')||'–')],['Category:',esc(d.c)]],{noType:true});

  ${d.o.length?`${m.type===102?sampleRow(m):''}${opts}${isLatch(m)&&m.type!==44?`<div class="row" title="Whether this latching button is on or off when the patch is loaded (stored in the patch)."><span>start state</span><div class="seg" id="mLatch" role="radiogroup" aria-label="State after loading"><button type="button" role="radio" data-on="0" aria-checked="${!(m.saved&&m.saved[0])}">Off</button><button type="button" role="radio" data-on="1" aria-checked="${!!(m.saved&&m.saved[0])}">On</button></div></div>`:''}`:''}</div>

   ${m.page===M.EURO_PAGE?'<p class="note">Integrated Euroburo interface with its own button next to its jack.</p>':`

      return `<br><span class="ohid"><b>Hidden on the device:</b> ${h.map(x=>esc(x.label||x.name)+' (button '+x.button+')').join(', ')}. On an occupied button the modules overlap: the later module covers the earlier one.</p>`}</div>
   ${seqState(m)?'<hr class="isep"><div class="actions"><button type="button" class="btn sm" id="mShowState" title="Show what this module keeps in the patch besides its parameters (read only)">Show stored state</button></div>':''}
  <hr class="isep"><div class="actions"><button type="button" class="btn" id="mDup"${M.isEuro(m.type)?' disabled':''} title="${M.isEuro(m.type)?'The Euroburo has only one of this jack/button, so it cannot be duplicated.':'Duplicate: a copy of the selected module with its name, colour, options and parameters.   const nameEl=$('#mName');

  // 0.505: after recolouring, the next new module gets the colour after the chosen one (as on the device). 0.508 (user

  el.querySelectorAll('[data-color]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{commit();m.color=+b.dataset.color;M.colourAfter(m.color);renderAll()});

  el.querySelectorAll('[data-seqtype],[data-seqcol]').forEach(s=>s.onchange=()=>{commit();const t=+(s.dataset.seqtype??s.dataset.seqcol);M.seqSetTrack(m,t,s.dataset.seqtype!=null?'type':'colour',+s.value);renderAll()});
  el.querySelectorAll('[data-opt]').forEach(s=>s.onchange=()=>{

    renderAll()});
  el.querySelectorAll('[data-vtog]').forEach(v=>v.onclick=()=>vToggle(m,v.dataset.vtog));
  el.querySelectorAll('[data-qsel]').forEach(q=>q.onchange=()=>{commit();const n=q.dataset.qsel,N=n==='key'?12:qScales(m.options).length;m.params[n]=qVal(+q.value,N);renderAll()});
  el.querySelectorAll('[data-param]').forEach(r=>{let started=false;

// inspector glyph: 'mod' = [ bracket, 'conn' = stretched S; colour defaults to the header colour --mc
function glyph(kind,col){const d=kind==='conn'?'M7 2 C 13 16, 1 32, 7 46':'M10 2 H3 V46 H10';
  return`<svg class="glyph ${kind}" viewBox="0 0 12 48" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="${d}" style="stroke:${col||'var(--mc)'}"/></svg>`}
// shared module card (module inspector header + connection inspector ends):
// [ bracket in the module colour, name, "Page n “name”, Button c. Type: t", then label/value rows aligned with the name
const CC_TIP='MIDI CC number for this starred item. A MIDI controller sending this control change number moves it directly (ZOIA MIDI input). None: not mapped (stored as -1). Each number should be used only once per patch.';
function starBtn(on,attr,what){return`<button type="button" class="btn sm wbtn starb" aria-pressed="${on}" ${attr} title="${on?'Starred: click to remove it from':'Click to add it to'} the device’s starred list (${what})" aria-label="Star">★</button>`}
function ccSel(cc,attr){let o='<option value="-1">None</option>';for(let i=0;i<128;i++)o+=`<option value="${i}"${i===cc?' selected':''}>${i}</option>`;return`<label class="ccl" title="${CC_TIP}">MIDI CC Number <select class="field cc" ${attr}>${o}</select></label>`}
function modSub(m,noType){const d=Z.mod(m.type),pn=st.pages[m.page];return esc((noType?'':d.n+'. ')+(m.page===M.EURO_PAGE?'Euroburo Interfaces':'Page '+m.page+(pn?' “'+pn+'”':'')+', Button '+(m.pos+1))+'.')}
// 0.432: in the Module Inspector a named module shows three lines: its name, its type in brackets, its place (the [ glyph spans all three)
function modCard(m,rows,o){o=o||{};const tag=o.click?'button':'div';const named=!!(m.name&&m.name!==Z.mod(m.type).n),three=o.noType&&named;
  const sub=three?`<small class="mty">[${esc(Z.mod(m.type).n)}]</small><small>${modSub(m,true)}</small>`:`<small>${modSub(m,o.noType&&!named)}</small>`;
  return`<${tag}${o.click?` type="button" data-goto="${m.uid}" title="Select this module"`:''} class="cmod${o.click?'':' static'}${three?' three':''}"${o.label?` aria-label="${esc(o.label)}: ${esc(mlabel(m))}"`:''}>${glyph("mod",COLORS[m.color]?COLORS[m.color][1]:'var(--line-2)')}<span class="cmt"><b data-mname>${esc(mlabel(m))}</b>${devBadge(m.type)}</span>${sub}
    ${rows.length?`<span class="crows">${rows.map(([k,v,t])=>`<span${t?` title="${esc(t)}"`:''}>${k}</span><span class="num">${v}</span>`).join('')}</span>`:''}</${tag}>`}
// connection number = 1-based position in the patch file's connection list, zero-padded to 3 digits
const connNo=c=>'#'+String(st.conns.indexOf(c)+1).padStart(3,'0');
function connInspector(el,c){
  const a=byUid(c.sm),b=byUid(c.dm);const bn=(mm,pos)=>{const x=Z.mod(mm.type).b.find(q=>q[1]===pos);return x?bl(mm,x[0]):'#'+pos};
  const s=st.stars.find(s=>s.conn===c.uid);
  const audio=blockType(a,c.sb).startsWith('audio');
  const dIn=M.visible(b).find(x=>x.pos===c.db),knob=dIn&&dIn.param&&!b.lockedParams?fmtParam(b.type,dIn.name,M.getParam(b,dIn.name),b.options,b):null;
  const others=st.conns.filter(k=>k!==c&&k.dm===c.dm&&k.db===c.db).length;
  const end=(lbl,m,rows)=>modCard(m,rows,{click:true,label:lbl});
  el.innerHTML=`<h1 class="ititle">Connection Inspector</h1><div class="ihead" style="--mc:var(--${audio?'audio':'cv'})">${glyph("conn")}<div><h2 title="Position in the patch file: connection ${st.conns.indexOf(c)+1} of ${st.conns.length}. Numbers after a deleted connection move up by one.">${audio?'Audio':'CV'} Connection <span class="cno">${connNo(c)}</span></h2></div></div>
  <div class="cflow">${end('Coming from',a,[['Output:',esc(bn(a,c.sb))]])}
  <svg class="flowtri" viewBox="0 0 14 9" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M1 1 H13 L7 8 Z"/></svg>
  ${end('Going to',b,[['Input:',esc(bn(b,c.db))]].concat(knob!=null?[['Bias:',esc(knob),'The parameter’s own value (set with the knob on the device). The input adds it to all incoming connections']]:[],others?[['Also fed by:',`${others} other connection${others>1?'s':''}`]]:[]))}
  </div><hr class="isep">
  <div class="sec"><span class="label">Strength</span>
   <div class="param"><span class="pn">Level</span><span class="pv${c.st===10000?' full':''}" id="cVal">${stDb(c.st).toFixed(2)} dB · ${fmtPct(stPct(c.st))}</span><input type="range" id="cSt" min="1" max="11200" step="1" value="${c.st}" aria-label="Connection strength" title="Strength of this connection, as on the device: 100 % (0 dB) passes the signal unchanged. Range from silent to 398 % (+12 dB). Shift + scroll: finer steps."><span class="pt"><span class="raw" id="cRaw">raw ${c.st} = 10000 + 100 × dB</span></span></div>
   <div class="actions">${[100,75,50,25,10,200].map(p=>{const db=20*Math.log10(p/100);return`<button type="button" class="btn sm" data-pct="${p}" title="Set the strength to ${p} % (${db>0.05?'+':db<-0.05?'−':''}${Math.abs(db).toFixed(1)} dB)">${p} %</button>`}).join('')}</div>
   <p class="note">The range is −99.99 dB to +12 dB (398 %); the device removes a connection at −100 dB. An input sums all connections plus its own bias.</p></div>
  <hr class="isep"><div class="sec"><span class="label">Star ★</span><div class="actions"><div class="seg" id="cStar" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Star" title="Add this connection to the device’s starred list, or remove it"><button type="button" role="radio" data-on="0" aria-checked="${!s}">Off</button><button type="button" role="radio" data-on="1" aria-checked="${!!s}">On</button></div>${s?ccSel(s.cc,'id="cCC"'):''}</div><p class="note">Starred connections appear in the device’s starred list and show their strength in % for quick access.</p></div>
  <hr class="isep"><div class="actions"><button type="button" class="btn danger" id="cDel" title="Delete this connection (key: Delete or Backspace).">Delete connection</button></div>`;
  const r=$('#cSt');let started=false;
  r.addEventListener('input',()=>{if(!started){commit();started=true}c.st=+r.value;$('#cVal').textContent=stDb(c.st).toFixed(2)+' dB · '+fmtPct(stPct(c.st));$('#cVal').classList.toggle('full',c.st===10000);$('#cRaw').textContent='raw '+c.st+' = 10000 + 100 × dB';refreshLight()});
  r.addEventListener('change',()=>started=false);
  el.querySelectorAll('[data-pct]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{commit();c.st=pctToSt(+b.dataset.pct);renderAll()});
  $('#cStar').querySelectorAll('button').forEach(bt=>bt.onclick=()=>{const want=bt.dataset.on==='1',i=st.stars.findIndex(s=>s.conn===c.uid);if(want===(i>=0))return;commit();if(i>=0)st.stars.splice(i,1);else st.stars.push({conn:c.uid,cc:-1,rest:0});renderAll()});
  const cc=$('#cCC');if(cc)cc.onchange=()=>{commit();{const v=parseInt(cc.value,10);s.cc=Number.isNaN(v)?-1:Math.max(-1,Math.min(127,v))}renderAll(true)};
  el.querySelectorAll('[data-goto]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{sel={kind:'m',uid:b.dataset.goto};renderAll()});
  $('#cDel').onclick=()=>ask({title:'Delete connection?',q:`Are you sure you want to delete the connection between [${mlabel(a)}] and [${mlabel(b)}]?`,info:`[${mlabel(a)}] · ${bn(a,c.sb)} → [${mlabel(b)}] · ${bn(b,c.db)}. You can undo with Ctrl+Z.`,yes:'Delete'},()=>{sel={kind:'c',uid:c.uid};deleteSel()});
}
function patchInspector(el){
  const n=Math.max(st.pages.length,...st.modules.filter(m=>m.page<64).map(m=>m.page+1),1);
  let pg='';for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const cnt=st.modules.filter(m=>m.page===i).length;pg+=`<div><span class="label">Page ${i}</span><input class="field" maxlength="15" data-page="${i}" value="${esc(st.pages[i]||'')}" placeholder="unnamed" spellcheck="false" title="Name of page ${i} on the device (up to 15 characters)."><span class="raw">${cnt} M</span></div>`}
  const errs=issues.filter(i=>i.level==='error'),warns=issues.filter(i=>i.level==='warn').concat(issues.filter(i=>i.level==='info'));
  const ps=patchStatus();
  el.innerHTML=`<h1 class="ititle">Patch Inspector</h1><div class="ihead" style="--mc:var(--accent)"><span class="sw"></span><div><h2>${esc(st.name||'Untitled')}</h2><p>Slot ${String(st.slot).padStart(3,'0')} · ${st.modules.length} modules · ${st.conns.length} connections · ${st.stars.length} stars</p>${st.modules.length?(()=>{const d=DEVICE_TXT[deviceKey()];return`<p class="dev" title="${esc(d[1])}">${esc(d[0])}</p>`})():''}${st.src?`<p class="src">From PatchStorage · by ${esc(st.src.author)} · license: ${esc(st.src.license)}</p>`:''}</div></div>
  <div class="sec"><span class="label">Status</span><div class="pstat ${ps[0]}" id="pStat" role="status" title="${esc(ps[2])}">${esc(ps[1])}</div>${errs.length||issues.some(i=>i.level==='warn')||!st.modules.length?'':'<p class="note">No errors or warnings.</p>'}${issues.length?`<div class="issues">${errs.concat(warns).map(i=>`<div class="issue ${i.level}"${i.uid?` data-uid="${i.uid}"`:''}>${issueHTML(i)}</div>`).join('')}</div>`:''}</div>${(()=>{const L=M.euroLimits(st);return L.length?`<hr class="isep"><div class="sec" id="pEuro"><span class="label">On the Euroburo</span><p class="note">The patch loads and plays on the Euroburo. ${L.length>1?'These ZOIA modules do':'This ZOIA module does'} nothing there:</p><div class="issues">${L.map(x=>`<div class="issue info" data-uid="${x.uid}">${esc(x.text)}</div>`).join('')}</div></div>`:''})()}
  ${interfacesHTML()}<hr class="isep"><div class="sec"><span class="label">Page names</span><div class="pages">${pg}</div><div class="actions"><button type="button" class="btn sm" id="pAdd" title="Add an empty page at the end (the device has up to 64 pages).">Add page</button></div></div>`;
  el.querySelectorAll('[data-page]').forEach(i=>{i.addEventListener('input',()=>commit(),{once:true});i.oninput=()=>{i.value=i.value.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9 .\-]/g,'');const k=+i.dataset.page;while(st.pages.length<=k)st.pages.push('');st.pages[k]=i.value;refreshLight();renderPageSel()}});
  $('#pAdd').onclick=()=>{commit();st.pages.push('');renderAll()};
  el.querySelectorAll('.issue[data-uid]').forEach(d=>d.onclick=()=>{sel={kind:'m',uid:d.dataset.uid};focusModule(byUid(d.dataset.uid));renderAll()});
  el.querySelectorAll('.ifk[data-ifu]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const us=b.dataset.ifu.split(','),k=ifNext.get(b.dataset.ifu)||0,u=us[k%us.length];
    ifNext.set(b.dataset.ifu,k+1);if(!byUid(u))return;sel={kind:'m',uid:u};focusModule(byUid(u));renderAll()});
}
// Hardware Interfaces: every hardware connection and control the patch uses, grouped by connector, with the device it works on.
// MIDI CC is summarised per channel when there are many. Grid controls (buttons, LEDs) come last.
const ifNext=new Map(); // Hardware Interfaces: which module of an entry the next click selects
function interfacesHTML(){
  if(!st.modules.length)return '';
  const ov=(m,k)=>{const L=Z.mod(m.type).o||[],i=L.findIndex(x=>x[0]===k);return i<0?null:String(L[i][1][(m.options&&m.options[i])||0])};
  const ch=m=>'ch '+ov(m,'midi_channel');
  const LR={stereo:'L + R',left:'L',right:'R'},E12={stereo:'1 + 2',left:'1',right:'2'};
  const G=['Audio In','Audio Out','MIDI In','MIDI Out','Control port','Footswitches','Device control','CV In','CV Out','Pushbuttons','Grid'];
  const rows=new Map(G.map(g=>[g,{dev:new Set(),items:new Map(),cc:new Map()}]));
  // 0.502 (user 2026-10-18): every entry remembers its modules; a click selects one (the next one on the next click), so the
  // Module Inspector shows its options
  let cur=null;
  const add=(g,txt,dev)=>{const r=rows.get(g);r.dev.add(dev);const x=r.items.get(txt)||r.items.set(txt,{n:0,u:[]}).get(txt);x.n++;x.u.push(cur.uid)};
  const cc=(g,m)=>{const r=rows.get(g);r.dev.add('both');const k=+ov(m,'midi_channel');(r.cc.get(k)||r.cc.set(k,[]).get(k)).push({c:ov(m,'controller'),u:m.uid})};
  for(const m of st.modules){cur=m;const t=m.type,c=ov(m,'channels');
    if(t===1)add('Audio In',`${LR[c]} (Euroburo: In ${E12[c]})`,'both');
    else if(t===93||t===94)add('Audio In','In '+(t-92),'euro');
    else if(t===2)add('Audio Out',`${LR[c]} (Euroburo: Out ${E12[c]})`,'both');
    else if(t===95||t===96)add('Audio Out','Out '+(t-94),'euro');
    else if(t===92)add('Audio Out','headphones','euro');
    else if(t===20)add('MIDI In','notes '+ch(m),'both');else if(t===21)cc('MIDI In',m);
    else if(t===35)add('MIDI In','pressure '+ch(m),'both');else if(t===86)add('MIDI In','pitch bend '+ch(m),'both');else if(t===82)add('MIDI In','clock','both');
    else if(t===60)add('MIDI Out','notes '+ch(m),'both');else if(t===61)cc('MIDI Out',m);else if(t===62)add('MIDI Out','program change '+ch(m),'both');
    else if(t===84)add('MIDI Out','clock','both');else if(t===108)add('MIDI Out','pitch bend '+ch(m),'both');else if(t===109)add('MIDI Out','pressure '+ch(m),'both');
    else if(t===54)add('Control port','expression / CV in','zoia');else if(t===55)add('Control port','CV out','zoia');
    else if(t===44){const w=ov(m,'stompswitch');w==='ext'?add('Control port','external footswitch','zoia'):add('Footswitches',w,'zoia')}
    else if(t===103)add('Device control',ov(m,'control'),'zoia');
    else if(t>=88&&t<=91)add('CV In',`${t-87} (${ov(m,'in_range')})`,'euro');
    else if(t>=99&&t<=101||t===87)add('CV Out',`${t===87?4:t-98} (${ov(m,'out_range')})`,'euro');
    else if(t===97||t===98)add('Pushbuttons','PB'+(t-96),'euro');
    else if(t===15)add('Grid','pushbutton','both');else if(t===16)add('Grid','keyboard','both');else if(t===56)add('Grid','ui button','both');else if(t===81)add('Grid','pixel','both')}
  const nat=(a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b,undefined,{numeric:true});
  const out=[...rows].filter(([,r])=>r.dev.size).map(([g,r])=>{
    const L=[...r.items].sort((a,b)=>nat(a[0],b[0])).map(([k,x])=>[(x.n>1?x.n+' × ':'')+k,x.u]);
    const nCC=[...r.cc.values()].reduce((a,x)=>a+x.length,0); // a few CCs one by one, many per channel
    if(nCC&&nCC<=4)[...r.cc].sort((a,b)=>a[0]-b[0]).forEach(([k,cs])=>cs.sort((a,b)=>a.c-b.c).forEach(x=>L.unshift(['CC '+x.c+' ch '+k,[x.u]])));
    else if(nCC)L.unshift(...[...r.cc].sort((a,b)=>a[0]-b[0]).map(([k,cs])=>[`${cs.length} CC on ch ${k}`,cs.map(x=>x.u)]));
    const both=r.dev.has('both')||r.dev.size>1,bd=k=>`<span class="devb" title="${esc(both?'Works on ZOIA and Euroburo':DEV_BADGE[k][1])}">${k==='euro'?'EUROBURO':DEV_BADGE[k][0]}</span>`; // the same badges as in the module list, Euroburo written out (there is room here)
    const d=both?bd('zoia')+bd('euro'):bd(r.dev.has('zoia')?'zoia':'euro');
    return `<div class="ifr"><span class="ifn">${esc(g)}</span><span class="ifd">${d}</span><span class="ifi">${L.map(([txt,us])=>{const m=byUid(us[0]),tip=m?'Click to select ['+mlabel(m)+'] and edit its options'+(us.length>1?' ('+us.length+' modules: click again for the next)':''):'';
      return `<button type="button" class="ifk" data-ifu="${esc(us.join(','))}" title="${esc(tip)}">${esc(txt)}</button>`}).join(' · ')}</span></div>`});
  return `<hr class="isep"><div class="sec"><span class="label">Hardware Interfaces</span>${out.length?`<div class="ifl">${out.join('')}</div>`:'<p class="note">No inputs, outputs or controls yet.</p>'}</div>`}
function focusModule(m){if(!m)return;if(gridView)setGridView(false);fitMode=false;const r=stage.getBoundingClientRect(),v=st.view;v.x=r.width/2-(X(m)+W/2)*v.k;v.y=r.height/3-m.y*v.k;applyView()}

// ---------- editing ops ----------
function deleteSel(confirmed){
  if(!sel)return;
  if(sel.kind==='m'&&!confirmed){ // a module that is (probably) in use: ask first. Pixels count as in use, they show something on the grid.
    const m=byUid(sel.uid),n=m?st.conns.filter(c=>c.sm===m.uid||c.dm===m.uid).length:0;
    if(m&&(n||m.type===81)){const u=m.uid;ask({title:'Delete module?',q:`Are you sure you want to delete [${mlabel(m)}]?`,
      info:(n?`It has ${n} connection${n>1?'s':''}, which will be deleted too. `:'pixel modules show a value on the grid even without connections. ')+'You can undo with Ctrl+Z.',yes:'Delete'},()=>{sel={kind:'m',uid:u};deleteSel(true)});return}}
  commit();
  if(sel.kind==='m'){const u=sel.uid;st.modules=st.modules.filter(m=>m.uid!==u);const gone=new Set(st.conns.filter(c=>c.sm===u||c.dm===u).map(c=>c.uid));st.conns=st.conns.filter(c=>!gone.has(c.uid));st.stars=st.stars.filter(s=>s.m!==u&&!gone.has(s.conn))}
  else{st.conns=st.conns.filter(c=>c.uid!==sel.uid);st.stars=st.stars.filter(s=>s.conn!==sel.uid)}
  sel=null;renderAll();
}
// a copy starts with an empty state; 0.440: modules with a device start state get that one, see M.freshState
function duplicate(m){if(euroTwice(m.type))return;const c=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify({...m,rawName:null}));c.uid=M.uid();c.rawName=null;c.x+=24;c.y+=24;c.importedColor=null;c.saved=(m.saved||[]).map(()=>0);c.fresh=true;
  placeNew(c,m.page,'the copy of ['+mlabel(m)+']',P=>{commit();const f=M.place(st,c,P);st.modules.push(c);M.colourAfter(c.color);sel={kind:'m',uid:c.uid};if(P!==m.page)showPage(P);renderAll();
    const pn=placeNote(c,f);if(pn||P!==m.page)toast('['+mlabel(c)+'] placed on page '+c.page+', grid button '+(c.pos+1)+'.'+pn,pn?6000:3000,pn?'warn':undefined)})}
function connect(a,b){ // a={uid,pos} output, b={uid,pos} input
  if(blockType(byUid(a.uid),a.pos).startsWith('audio')!==blockType(byUid(b.uid),b.pos).startsWith('audio')){toast('Audio and CV cannot be connected. The ZOIA only connects audio to audio and CV to CV.',4500,'warn');return}
  if(st.conns.some(c=>c.sm===a.uid&&c.sb===a.pos&&c.dm===b.uid&&c.db===b.pos)){toast('This connection already exists.',3200,'warn');return}
  commit();const c={uid:M.uid(),sm:a.uid,sb:a.pos,dm:b.uid,db:b.pos,st:10000};st.conns.push(c);sel={kind:'c',uid:c.uid};renderAll();
}

  if(e.button!==0&&e.button!==1)return;
  if(e.target.closest('.zoom,.findbox,button,input,select,textarea,a'))return; // overlay controls: no pan/pointer capture, so their click fires
  // multi-selection: Shift+click toggles a module, Shift+drag on empty space draws a selection frame (adds to the selection)

    nodesEl.querySelectorAll(`.port.${kind}[data-port="${want}"]`).forEach(p=>{const r=portRef(p),own=rewire.end==='dst'?(r.uid===c.dm&&r.pos===c.db):(r.uid===c.sm&&r.pos===c.sb);
      if(!own&&(rewire.end==='dst'?connExists(c.sm,c.sb,r.uid,r.pos,c):connExists(r.uid,r.pos,c.dm,c.db,c)))return;p.classList.add('target')});stage.classList.add('rewiring');
    setHint(rewire.end==='dst'?'Drop on another input (Esc cancels)':'Drop on another output (Esc cancels)');stage.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);return}
  let port=e.target.closest('.port');

    stage.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);return}

    if(e.target.closest('.nh')){drag={type:'node',m,el:node,sx:e.clientX,sy:e.clientY,ox:X(m),oy:m.y,moved:false};stage.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)}

  // a text separator ("=====", or a line of ===) ends the description; "…" when something follows it
  const sep=d.search(/={5,}|^={3,}$/m);if(sep>=0){more=/[^=\s]/.test(d.slice(sep));d=d.slice(0,sep).trim()}
  if(d.length<=900)return d+(more?(d?' …':'…'):'');const c=d.slice(0,900),m=[...c.matchAll(/[.!?](?=\s)|\n/g)].map(x=>x.index).filter(i=>i>=400).pop();
  return m!=null?c.slice(0,m+(c[m]==='\n'?0:1)).trim()+' …':c.replace(/\s+\S*$/,'')+' …'}
function psRow(x,i){const tags=(x.tags||[]).map(t=>psCap(t.name)),hit=new Set([...psSel].flatMap(n=>psTagIds.get(n)||[]));
  const ver=psText(x.revision).slice(0,60),when=[psDate(x)?psDate(x).replace(/^u/,'U'):'',ver?'Version '+ver:''].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
  const tip=['**'+psText(x.title),when,psDesc(x.content||x.excerpt),'Tags: '+(tags.join(', ')||'none'),x.files&&x.files.length?'Files: '+x.files.map(f=>f.filename).join(', '):'','License: '+(x.license?x.license.name:'none given')+(x.custom_license_text?' – '+psText(x.custom_license_text).slice(0,300):'')].filter(Boolean).join('\n---\n'); // sections: title, description, tags, files, license
  return `<div class="psit" title="${esc(tip)}"><span class="pt1"><span class="ptt">${i+1}. ${esc(psText(x.title))}</span></span><button type="button" class="btn sm" data-ps-open="${i}"${psCanOpen(x)?'':' disabled title="ZoE opens .bin and .zip files only"'}>Open</button>
    <span class="pt2">Author: ${x.author&&x.author.id?`<button type="button" class="psau" data-ps-author="${+x.author.id}" title="Show all patches by ${esc(x.author.name)}">${esc(x.author.name)}</button>`:esc(x.author?x.author.name:'unknown')} · License: ${esc(psLic(x))} · ♥ ${+x.like_count||0} · ↓ ${+x.download_count||0}${psFiles(x)?' '+psFiles(x):''}${x.state&&x.state.slug&&x.state.slug!=='ready-to-go'?' · '+esc(x.state.name):''}${psWeb(x)?` · <a href="${esc(psWeb(x))}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="Open this patch’s page on patchstorage.com (new tab)">patchstorage</a>`:''}${psZt(x)?` · <a href="${esc(psZt(x))}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" title="Open this patch’s page on zoiatheca.org (new tab)">zoiatheca</a>`:''}</span>
    <span class="pt3">Tags: ${(x.tags||[]).map(t=>hit.has(+t.id)?`<b>${esc(psCap(t.name))}</b>`:esc(psCap(t.name))).join(' · ')||'no tags'}</span></div>`}
async function psSearch(more){if(psBusy)return;if(!psReady&&!(await psInit()))return;psBusy=true;
  // a chosen word button (Zoiatheca) adds its word to the search text
  const q=[$('#psQ').value.trim(),...[...psSel].filter(n=>PS_TERM[n]).map(n=>PS_TERM[n])].filter(Boolean).join(' '),sort=$('#psSort').value==='relevance'&&!q?'date':$('#psSort').value;
  const tags=[...psSel].flatMap(n=>psTagIds.get(n)||[]),states=[...$('#psStates').querySelectorAll('input:checked')].map(c=>c.value);
  // every chosen tag name stands for one or more PatchStorage tags; with "Match all tags" a patch needs one of each name
  const need=[...psSel].filter(n=>(psTagIds.get(n)||[]).length).map(n=>new Set(psTagIds.get(n))),all=psAll&&need.length>1,
    titles=[...psSel].filter(n=>PS_TITLE[n]).map(n=>PS_TITLE[n]),fits=x=>(!all||need.every(S=>(x.tags||[]).some(t=>S.has(+t.id))))&&titles.every(re=>re.test(psText(x.title)));
  if(!more){psPage=1;psItems=[];psSeen=0;$('#psList').innerHTML=''}else psPage++;
  psSay('Searching…');$('#psMore').hidden=true;
  try{const query=ob=>psGet('patches/',{platforms:PS_PLATFORM,per_page:PS_PER,page:psPage,search:q,orderby:ob,order:sort==='title'?'asc':'desc',tags:tags.join(','),states:states.join(','),author:psAuthor?psAuthor.id:''});
    const page=async()=>{if(PS_SORTS[sort]){const names=psSortName[sort]?[psSortName[sort]]:PS_SORTS[sort];let err;
        for(const n of names){try{const r=await query(n);psSortName[sort]=n;return r}catch(e){err=e;if(e instanceof TypeError)throw e}}
        throw err}
      return query(sort)};
    // with all tags required or a title word (Factory), pages without a single match are skipped (at most 10 per click, so the window stays responsive)
    let r,L,more2,tries=0;
    for(;;){r=await page();const raw=Array.isArray(r.data)?r.data:[];psSeen+=raw.length;L=raw.filter(fits);
      more2=r.pages?psPage<r.pages:raw.length===PS_PER;if(L.length||!more2||(!all&&!titles.length)||++tries>=10)break;psPage++;psSay('Searching… '+psSeen+' patches checked')}
    const start=psItems.length;psItems.push(...L);
    $('#psList').insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',L.map((x,k)=>psRow(x,start+k)).join(''));
    $('#psMore').hidden=!more2;
    const n=psItems.length,pl=k=>k+' patch'+(k===1?'':'es');
    $('#psInfo').textContent=all
      ?(n?pl(n)+' with all '+need.length+' tags'+(more2?' so far ('+psSeen+' of '+(r.total||'all')+' with any of them checked; Load more searches on).':'.')+' Hover a result for its description.'
        :more2?'No patch with all '+need.length+' tags among the first '+psSeen+' (of '+(r.total||'more')+' with any of them). Load more searches on.':'No patch has all '+need.length+' tags. Untick “Match all tags” to see patches with any of them.')
      :n?(r.total?pl(r.total)+' found.':'Patches found.')+' Hover a result for its description.':'Nothing found. Try fewer tags or another search text.';
    psDetails(start)}
  catch(e){psSay(e instanceof TypeError?psOffline():'Search failed: '+e.message,1)}
  finally{psBusy=false}}

async function psDetails(start){const todo=psItems.map((x,i)=>[x,i]).slice(start).filter(([x])=>!x.license||!x.content||!x.files);
  const run=async()=>{while(todo.length){const [x,i]=todo.shift();try{const d=(await psGet('patches/'+(+x.id)+'/')).data;Object.assign(x,d);const el=$('#psList').children[i];if(el)el.outerHTML=psRow(x,i)}catch(e){}}};
  await Promise.all([run(),run(),run()])}
async function psOpen(i){const x=psItems[i];if(!x)return;
  const go=async()=>{psSay('Importing “'+psText(x.title)+'”…');
    try{let f=(x.files||[])[0];if(!f){const d=(await psGet('patches/'+(+x.id)+'/')).data;Object.assign(x,d);f=(x.files||[])[0]}
      if(!f)throw new Error('this patch has no file');
      const r=await fetch(PS_API+'patches/'+(+x.id)+'/files/'+(+f.id)+'/download/');if(!r.ok)throw new Error('PatchStorage answered '+r.status);
      const u=new Uint8Array(await r.arrayBuffer()),src={author:x.author?x.author.name:'unknown',license:x.license?x.license.name+(x.custom_license_text?' – '+psText(x.custom_license_text).slice(0,200):''):'none given'};
      const pname=psText(x.title).replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9 .\-]/g,'').trim().slice(0,15).trim(); // patch name: the first 15 characters of the title
      if(u[0]===0x50&&u[1]===0x4b){const ents=await unzipBins(u);if(!ents.length)throw new Error('no .bin file in the archive');closePS();
        if(ents.length===1)return loadBin(ents[0].name,ents[0].data,null,src,pname);psSrc=src;return openBank(ents)}
      if(u.length<1024||u.length>40000)throw new Error('the file is not a ZOIA patch (.bin); open it on PatchStorage instead');
      Z.parse(u);closePS();loadBin(String(f.filename||'patch.bin'),u,null,src,pname)}
    catch(e){psSay(e instanceof TypeError?psOffline():'Could not open the patch: '+e.message,1)}};
  if(dirty&&st.modules.length)ask({title:'Discard patch?',q:`Are you sure you want to discard the patch “${st.name||'Untitled'}” and open “${psText(x.title)}”?`,info:unsavedInfo(),yes:'Discard and open'},go);else go()}

  const legacy=()=>{const ta=document.createElement('textarea');ta.value=t;ta.setAttribute('readonly','');ta.style.cssText='position:fixed;top:0;left:0;opacity:0';document.body.appendChild(ta);ta.select();let ok=false;try{ok=document.execCommand('copy')}catch(e){}ta.remove();return ok};
  const manual=()=>{$('#infoBody').className='infobody';$('#infoBody').innerHTML='<p class="note" style="margin:4px">Your browser does not allow copying from here. The text is selected below: press Ctrl+C (Cmd+C on a Mac).</p><textarea class="field" id="infoTa" style="width:100%;height:50vh;font:12px var(--f-mono);font-style:normal" readonly></textarea>';$('#infoTa').value=t;$('#infoTa').focus();$('#infoTa').select()};
  if(legacy()){toast('Copied to the clipboard.');return}
  try{if(navigator.clipboard&&window.isSecureContext){navigator.clipboard.writeText(t).then(()=>toast('Copied to the clipboard.'),manual);return}}catch(e){}
  manual()}

function cpuBreakdown(){
  // 0.453: module values from the DSP Usage screen (measured), earlier benchmarks or the Empress table; then what is not in a module
  const by=new Map(),SRC={dsp:'Measured (DSP Usage)',bench:'Benchmarked',table:'Empress'};let tot=0;
  for(const m of st.modules){const d=Z.mod(m.type),c=M.cpuMod(st,m),src=M.cpuSource(m);tot+=c;
    const e=by.get(d.n)||{n:d.n,cnt:0,sum:0,src,each:new Set()};e.cnt++;e.sum+=c;e.each.add(c.toFixed(2));by.set(d.n,e)}
  const rows=[...by.values()].sort((a,b)=>b.sum-a.sum),max=rows.length?rows[0].sum:0;
  const pages=new Map();for(const m of st.modules)pages.set(m.page,(pages.get(m.page)||0)+M.cpuMod(st,m));
  const pr=[...pages.entries()].sort((a,b)=>a[0]-b[0]),pmax=Math.max(0,...pr.map(x=>x[1]));
  const tr=(n,cnt,v,src)=>`<tr><td>${n}</td><td class="n">${cnt}</td><td></td><td class="n">${v.toFixed(1)} %</td><td></td><td class="src">${src}</td></tr>`;
  let h=`<h3>By module type (controls standing still)</h3><table class="itab"><tr><th>Module</th><th class="n">Count</th><th class="n">Each</th><th class="n">Total</th><th></th><th>Reference</th></tr>`;
  for(const r of rows)h+=`<tr><td>${esc(r.n)}</td><td class="n">${r.cnt}</td><td class="n">${r.each.size>1?'varies':[...r.each][0]+' %'}</td><td class="n">${r.sum.toFixed(1)} %</td><td>${bar(r.sum,max)}</td><td class="src">${SRC[r.src]}</td></tr>`;
  if(st.modules.length){const mv=M.cpuMoving(st),nmv=st.modules.filter(m=>mv.has(m.uid)).length,mvc=M.cpuMoves(st),pk=M.cpuPeaks(st),bl=M.cpuBaseline(st),cc=M.cpuConns(st),ty=M.cpuTypes(st),bg=M.cpuBig(st);
    const nt=new Set(st.modules.filter(m=>!M.isEuro(m.type)).map(m=>m.type)).size,nm=st.modules.filter(m=>!M.isEuro(m.type)).length;
    h+=(nmv?tr('Controls moved by an LFO, envelope … (extra peaks)',nmv,mvc,SRC.dsp):'')+(pk?tr('Onset detector analysis (peak, once)','',pk,SRC.dsp):'')+tr('Baseline (loaded patch)','',bl,SRC.dsp)+
      (st.conns.length?tr('Connections',st.conns.length,cc,SRC.dsp):'')+tr('Different module types',nt,ty,'Benchmarked')+(bg>0?tr('Large patch (modules beyond 40)',nm-40,bg,'Benchmarked'):'');
    tot+=mvc+pk+bl+cc+ty+bg;
    if(M.cpuDev(st)==='euro'){const ex=tot*(M.CPU_EURO-1);tot+=ex;h+=tr(`Euroburo (about ${Math.round((M.CPU_EURO-1)*100)} % more than a ZOIA)`,'',ex,'Benchmarked')}}
  h+=`<tr class="tot"><td>Total</td><td class="n">${st.modules.length}</td><td></td><td class="n">${tot.toFixed(1)} %</td><td></td><td></td></tr></table>`;
  h+=`<h3>By page (modules, controls standing still)</h3><table class="itab"><tr><th>Page</th><th class="n">CPU</th><th></th></tr>`+pr.map(([p,v])=>`<tr><td>${esc(pageLbl(p))}</td><td class="n">${v.toFixed(1)} %</td><td>${bar(v,pmax)}</td></tr>`).join('')+'</table>';
  const idle=M.cpuTotal(st,true);openInfo('CPU Usage Breakdown','Estimated load '+tot.toFixed(1)+' %: the highest value the device shows while playing (envelopes and LFOs running)'+(idle<tot-0.05?'; at rest, right after loading, about '+idle.toFixed(1)+' %':'')+'. Measured values come from the DSP Usage screen of a ZOIA (Config menu); the real load also depends on the parameters and the device.',h)}
function memBreakdown(){
  const w=M.sizeWords(st),lg={noNames:st.legacyNoNames,noColors:st.legacyNoColors};const by=new Map();let modW=0,stateW=0;
  for(const m of st.modules){const d=Z.mod(m.type),np=m.lockedParams?m.lockedParams.length:M.paramList(m).length,head=(lg.noNames?10:14)+np,ds=Math.ceil(M.dsOf(m)/4);modW+=head;stateW+=ds;
    const e=by.get(d.n)||{n:d.n,cnt:0,w:0};e.cnt++;e.w+=head+ds;by.set(d.n,e)}
  const pagesW=w-6-modW-stateW-(1+5*st.conns.length)-(1+st.stars.length+(lg.noColors?0:st.modules.length));
  const parts=[['Header (name, sizes)',6],['Modules',modW],['Stored module state (e.g. sequencer steps)',stateW],['Connections ('+st.conns.length+')',1+5*st.conns.length],['Page names',pagesW],['Stars ('+st.stars.length+')',1+st.stars.length],['Module colours',lg.noColors?0:st.modules.length]];
  const B=x=>x*4,max=Math.max(...parts.map(p=>p[1]));
  let h=`<h3>By part</h3><table class="itab"><tr><th>Part</th><th class="n">Bytes</th><th class="n">Share</th><th></th></tr>`+parts.filter(p=>p[1]>0).map(([n,x])=>`<tr><td>${esc(n)}</td><td class="n">${B(x).toLocaleString('en-US')}</td><td class="n">${(B(x)/32768*100).toFixed(1)} %</td><td>${bar(x,max)}</td></tr>`).join('');
  h+=`<tr class="tot"><td>Used</td><td class="n">${B(w).toLocaleString('en-US')}</td><td class="n">${(B(w)/32768*100).toFixed(1)} %</td><td></td></tr><tr><td>Free</td><td class="n">${Math.max(0,32768-B(w)).toLocaleString('en-US')}</td><td class="n">${Math.max(0,(32768-B(w))/32768*100).toFixed(1)} %</td><td></td></tr></table>`;
  const rows=[...by.values()].sort((a,b)=>b.w-a.w),mx=rows.length?rows[0].w:0;
  h+=`<h3>Modules by type (incl. stored state)</h3><table class="itab"><tr><th>Module</th><th class="n">Count</th><th class="n">Bytes</th><th></th></tr>`+rows.map(r=>`<tr><td>${esc(r.n)}</td><td class="n">${r.cnt}</td><td class="n">${B(r.w).toLocaleString('en-US')}</td><td>${bar(r.w,mx)}</td></tr>`).join('')+'</table>';
  openInfo('Memory breakdown',`${B(w).toLocaleString('en-US')} of 32,768 bytes used.`,h)}
