function modMap(){
  const L=st.conns.map(c=>{const a=byUid(c.sm),b=byUid(c.dm);if(!a||!b)return null;const bt=blockType(b,c.db);if(!bt||!bt.startsWith('cv'))return null;const blk=Z.mod(b.type).b.find(q=>q[1]===c.db);return{c,a,b,param:blk&&blk[3]===1}}).filter(Boolean)
    .sort((x,y)=>x.b.page-y.b.page||x.b.pos-y.b.pos||x.c.db-y.c.db);
  let h='',t='MOD MAP · '+(st.name||'Untitled')+'\n';let cur=null;
  if(!L.length)h='<p class="note">No CV connections in this patch.</p>';
  for(const x of L){if(cur!==x.b.uid){if(cur)h+='</table>';cur=x.b.uid;h+=`<h3>[${esc(mlabel(x.b))}] · ${esc(locShort(x.b))}</h3><table class="itab"><tr><th>Input:</th><th>Modulated by:</th><th class="n">Strength:</th></tr>`;t+=`\n[${mlabel(x.b)}]\n`}
    const val=x.param?fmtParam(x.b.type,Z.mod(x.b.type).b.find(q=>q[1]===x.c.db)[0],M.getParam(x.b,Z.mod(x.b.type).b.find(q=>q[1]===x.c.db)[0]),x.b.options,x.b):'';
    h+=`<tr class="go" data-go="c:${x.c.uid}"><td>${esc(blkName(x.b,x.c.db))}${x.param?` <span class="src">bias ${esc(val)}</span>`:' <span class="src">control input</span>'}</td><td>[${esc(mlabel(x.a))}] ${esc(blkName(x.a,x.c.sb))}</td><td class="n">${fmtPct(stPct(x.c.st))}</td></tr>`;
    t+=`  ${blkName(x.b,x.c.db)} ← [${mlabel(x.a)}] ${blkName(x.a,x.c.sb)} (${fmtPct(stPct(x.c.st))})\n`}
  if(cur)h+='</table>';
  openInfo('Mod Map',L.length+' CV connection'+(L.length===1?'':'s')+', grouped by the module they control. The small grey “bias” value after an input is the parameter’s own value (set with the knob on the device); the modulation is added to it. “control input” marks inputs without a bias (gate, trigger, select). Click a row to select the connection.',h,t,'mm')}
// ---------- stored states (read only): only what is understood. Sequencer: 8 tracks x 32 steps, uint16 LE, track-major; word 256 low byte = selected track (confirmed on the Euroburo). ----------
function seqState(m){ // null if the stored state cannot be read
  if(m.type!==4||m.lockedParams||!m.saved||m.saved.length<514)return null;
  const u=Uint8Array.from(m.saved),dv=new DataView(u.buffer),sel=dv.getUint16(512,true)&0xff;if(sel>7)return null;
  const steps=(m.options[0]||0)+1,tracks=(m.options[1]||0)+1;if(steps>32||tracks>8)return null; // unknown option values (damaged file): nothing sensible to show
  const val=(t,i)=>t===sel?M.getParam(m,'step_'+(i+1)):dv.getUint16((t*32+i)*2,true); // the selected track is played from the step sliders (written into the state on export)
  let extra=false;for(let t=tracks;t<8;t++)for(let i=0;i<32;i++)if(t!==sel&&dv.getUint16((t*32+i)*2,true))extra=true;
  return{sel,steps,tracks,val,extra}}
const hasKnownState=m=>!!seqState(m)||!!M.samplerFile(m);
// Sequencer tracks: the step sliders always belong to one track (UI only, not stored). The track the device shows after loading
// plays from the step parameters; every other track is read and written directly in the stored state (8 tracks x 32 steps).
const seqTrack=new Map();
function seqEdit(m){const S=seqState(m);if(!S||S.tracks<2)return null;let t=seqTrack.get(m.uid);if(t==null||t>=S.tracks)t=S.sel<S.tracks?S.sel:0;return{t,S}}
const seqStep=n=>{const k=/^step_(\d+)$/.exec(n);return k?+k[1]-1:-1};
function stepVal(m,n){const E=m.type===4?seqEdit(m):null,i=seqStep(n);if(!E||i<0||E.t===E.S.sel)return M.getParam(m,n);const s=m.saved,k=(E.t*32+i)*2;return s[k]|(s[k+1]<<8)}
function setStepVal(m,n,v){const E=m.type===4?seqEdit(m):null,i=seqStep(n);if(!E||i<0||E.t===E.S.sel){m.params[n]=v;return}const k=(E.t*32+i)*2;m.saved[k]=v&255;m.saved[k+1]=(v>>8)&255}
// Sampler: the file comes first, as in the module's edit menu on the ZOIA; it is chosen there from the files on the SD card
const sampleRow=m=>{const f=M.samplerFile(m);return `<div class="row orow-file" title="The sample file this sampler plays. ZoE shows it but cannot change it."><span>file</span><span class="ofile">${f?`<b>${esc(f.file)}</b>${f.folder?` <span class="ofold">in the folder ${esc(f.folder)}</span>`:''}<br>`:''}<span class="ohint">Set this on the device, based on the available sample files on the SD card.</span></span></div>`};
const sampleNote=f=>`Sample file <b>${esc(f.file)}</b>${f.folder?` in the folder <b>${esc(f.folder)}</b>`:''} on the SD card.`;
function statesView(focus){
  const L=st.modules.filter(hasKnownState).sort((a,b)=>a.page-b.page||a.pos-b.pos);
  let h='',t='STORED STATES · '+(st.name||'Untitled')+'\n';
  for(const m of L){const sf=M.samplerFile(m);if(sf){h+=`<h3 id="st-${m.uid}" class="go" data-go="m:${m.uid}" title="Select this module">[${esc(mlabel(m))}] · ${esc(locShort(m))}</h3><p class="note">${sampleNote(sf)}</p>`;t+=`\n[${mlabel(m)}] ${locShort(m)} · sample file ${sf.file}${sf.folder?' in the folder '+sf.folder:''}\n`;continue}
    const q=seqState(m);const tr=[...Array(q.tracks).keys()];
    h+=`<h3 id="st-${m.uid}" class="go" data-go="m:${m.uid}" title="Select this module">[${esc(mlabel(m))}] · ${esc(locShort(m))}</h3><p class="note">sequencer: ${q.steps} step${q.steps>1?'s':''} × ${q.tracks} track${q.tracks>1?'s':''}. Track ${q.sel+1} is selected; its steps are the step sliders in the module inspector.${q.extra?' Unused tracks beyond the track count also hold values (not shown).':''}${M.seqTracks(m)?'<br>Outputs: '+M.seqTracks(m).map((x,k)=>'track '+(k+1)+' '+esc(seqOutName(k,x.type))+', '+esc(seqColName(x.colour))).join(' · '):''}</p>`;
    h+=`<table class="itab stab"><tr><th>Step</th>${tr.map(k=>`<th class="n${k===q.sel?' selt':''}">Track ${k+1}</th>`).join('')}</tr>`+[...Array(q.steps).keys()].map(i=>`<tr class="go" data-go="m:${m.uid}"><td class="n">${i+1}</td>${tr.map(k=>`<td class="n${k===q.sel?' selt':''}">${esc(fmtParam(4,'step_1',q.val(k,i)))}</td>`).join('')}</tr>`).join('')+'</table>';
    t+=`\n[${mlabel(m)}] ${locShort(m)} · ${q.steps} steps × ${q.tracks} tracks, selected track ${q.sel+1}${M.seqTracks(m)?'\nOutputs: '+M.seqTracks(m).map((x,k)=>'track '+(k+1)+' '+seqOutName(k,x.type)+', '+seqColName(x.colour)).join(' · '):''}\nStep\t${tr.map(k=>'Track '+(k+1)).join('\t')}\n`+[...Array(q.steps).keys()].map(i=>(i+1)+'\t'+tr.map(k=>fmtParam(4,'step_1',q.val(k,i))).join('\t')).join('\n')+'\n'}
  if(!L.length){h+='<p class="note">No module in this patch holds a stored state that ZoE can show.</p>';t+='none\n'}
  openInfo('Stored States','What modules keep in the patch besides their parameters, as example the stored sequencer tracks.',h,t,'sv');
  if(focus){const el=document.getElementById('st-'+focus);if(el)el.scrollIntoView({block:'start'})}}
$('#bStates').onclick=()=>statesView();

// Ober 6 (was Poly 6): six voices (eight measured about 104 % at rest and about 120 % while playing on the Euroburo), each 2 oscillators (saw + square) -> state-variable filter (lowpass and highpass, crossfaded by Audio Balance:
// lowpass, notch in the middle, highpass) -> VCA, with a filter envelope and an amp envelope. One set of Value modules on page 0 controls
// all voices at once; every voice has its own page. Voices alternate a little left/right. Inspired by the classic 8-voice modular
// polysynths of the 1970s (architecture only, no sounds or names taken over).
const POLY_VOICES=6;
function poly6(){ // general Audio Output: plays on the ZOIA and on the Euroburo (Out 1 and 2)
  // every voice a little different, like eight individually tuned synth modules: offsets on top of the global controls (knob + cable)
  const CENT=SEMI/100,U=65535,DRIFT=[0,4,7,2,5,9],DRIFT2=[3,0,5,2,6,1], // osc 1 / osc 2 tuning (cents)
    CUT=[0,.02,.01,.03,.015,.025],ENV=[0,.02,.04,.01,.03,.05],ATT=[0,.01,.005,.015,0,.01]; // filter cutoff, envelope times, attack (0-1)
  const mods=[{k:'midi',t:20,n:'MIDI notes',o:{'#_of_outputs':POLY_VOICES,priority:'RoundRobin'},c:0,r:0,pg:0},
    {k:'lfo',t:5,n:'LFO',o:{waveform:'triangle'},p:{cv_control:LFO_HZ(0.3)},c:0,r:1,pg:0,star:['cv_control']},
    {k:'cut',t:45,n:'Cutoff',p:{value:6554},c:0,r:2,pg:0,star:['value']},{k:'res',t:45,n:'Resonance',p:{value:20316},c:0,r:3,pg:0,star:['value']}, // defaults 0.1 / 0.31
    {k:'mode',t:45,n:'LP Notch HP',p:{value:0},c:0,r:4,pg:0,star:['value']},{k:'fdec',t:45,n:'Filter decay',p:{value:36045},c:0,r:5,pg:0,star:['value']},
    {k:'att',t:45,n:'Amp attack',p:{value:3277},c:0,r:6,pg:0,star:['value']},{k:'rel',t:45,n:'Amp release',p:{value:36045},c:0,r:7,pg:0,star:['value']},
    {k:'det',t:45,n:'Osc 2 detune',p:{value:3932},c:0,r:8,pg:0,star:['value']}];
  const conns=[];
  for(let i=1;i<=POLY_VOICES;i++){const v='v'+i,r=i-1,pg=i;
    mods.push({k:v+'o1',t:14,n:'V'+i+' Osc 1',o:{waveform:'sawtooth'},p:{frequency:Math.round(DRIFT[r]*CENT)},c:1,r,pg},
      {k:v+'o2',t:14,n:'V'+i+' Osc 2',o:{waveform:'square'},p:{frequency:Math.round(DRIFT2[r]*CENT)},c:2,r,pg},
      {k:v+'f',t:0,n:'V'+i+' Filter',o:{hipass_output:'on'},p:{frequency:Math.round(CUT[r]*U),resonance:0},c:3,r,pg},
      {k:v+'b',t:64,n:'V'+i+' LP-HP',p:{mix:0},c:4,r,pg},
      {k:v+'ef',t:6,n:'V'+i+' Filter env',p:{attack:0,decay:Math.round(ENV[r]*U),sustain:16384,release:Math.round(ENV[r]*U)},c:5,r,pg},
      {k:v+'ea',t:6,n:'V'+i+' Amp env',p:{attack:Math.round(ATT[r]*U),sustain:52428,release:Math.round(ENV[(r+3)%6]*U)},c:6,r,pg},
      {k:v+'a',t:7,n:'V'+i+' vca',p:{level_control:0},c:7,r,pg});
    conns.push(['midi.note_out_'+i,v+'o1.frequency'],['midi.note_out_'+i,v+'o2.frequency'],['det.cv_output',v+'o2.frequency',-40],
      ['midi.gate_out_'+i,v+'ef.gate_input'],['midi.gate_out_'+i,v+'ea.gate_input'],
      [v+'o1.audio_out',v+'f.audio_in',-6],[v+'o2.audio_out',v+'f.audio_in',-6],
      ['cut.cv_output',v+'f.frequency'],['midi.note_out_'+i,v+'f.frequency',-6] /* keytracking: the filter follows the note at half strength */,[v+'ef.cv_output',v+'f.frequency',-6],['lfo.output',v+'f.frequency',-26],['res.cv_output',v+'f.resonance'],
      [v+'f.lowpass_output',v+'b.audio_in_1_L'],[v+'f.hipass_output',v+'b.audio_in_2_L'],['mode.cv_output',v+'b.mix'],
      ['fdec.cv_output',v+'ef.decay'],['fdec.cv_output',v+'ef.release'],['att.cv_output',v+'ea.attack'],['rel.cv_output',v+'ea.release'],
      [v+'b.audio_output_L',v+'a.audio_in_1'],[v+'ea.cv_output',v+'a.level_control']);
    const near=i%2?'L':'R',far=i%2?'R':'L'; // odd voices a little left, even voices a little right
    conns.push([v+'a.audio_out_1','out.input_'+near,-12],[v+'a.audio_out_1','out.input_'+far,-18]);}
  mods.push({k:'out',t:2,n:'Out',c:8,r:0,pg:0});
  return{id:'poly6',dev:'any',name:'Ober 6 (MIDI)',
    desc:'Six voices for a MIDI keyboard (channel 1), inspired by the classic 8-voice modular polysynths of the 1970s. Each voice: two oscillators (saw and square), a filter that fades from lowpass through notch to highpass and follows the keyboard, a filter envelope and an amp envelope; every voice is tuned and set a little differently, like separate synth modules. The starred controls on page 0 change all six voices at once; every voice has its own page. Out L and R (on the Euroburo: Out 1 and 2). About 95 % CPU while all six voices play.',
    pages:['Ober 6',...Array.from({length:POLY_VOICES},(_,i)=>'Voice '+(i+1))],mods,conns};
}
// ---------- Classic 70 Flanger: rebuild of the A/DA Flanger (1977) from its manual ----------
// Signal: in → compressor (the original has a built-in compressor) → [+ feedback] → delay line (bucket-brigade style, 0.4–14 ms) →
// low-pass 7 kHz (BBD bandwidth; also sits in the feedback loop) → Even/Odd polarity → Enhance (feedback amount) back into the delay.
// Out = dry + wet in equal parts (deepest notches), the wet part behind a noise gate (Threshold, keyed by the dry input), plus bypass.
// Delay time = Manual·(1−Range) + LFO·Range (Range fully up: Manual has no effect, as on the original), scaled into 0.4–14 ms on the
// delay line's exponential time input, so a triangle LFO gives the original's roughly exponential sweep. Speed 0 … 1 ≈ 0.04 … 10 Hz.
// The values for 0.4 / 14 ms: the delay time input spans 0.02–100 ms exponentially with max time 100 ms (firmware display: 0.41 / 14.1 ms).
// 0.454 (user 2026-10-15): every audio module in series delays by one block (1.33 ms). The dry path gets a buffer delay as long as the
// wet path (5 blocks: delay line, low-pass, gate, even/odd, the switch), so dry and wet differ by the delay line's time alone, as on
// the original; the even path gets 1 block to match the odd path's inverter; the feedback runs delay line → Enhance VCA → delay line
// (2 blocks instead of 4 through the mixer and the low-pass).

function setOptByName(m,name,val){const o=Z.mod(m.type).o,i=o.findIndex(x=>x[0]===name);if(i<0)return;const v=o[i][1].findIndex(x=>String(x)===String(val));if(v>=0)m.options[i]=v}
function blockPos(m,name){const b=Z.mod(m.type).b.find(x=>x[0]===name);if(!b)throw new Error('Template: no combo '+name+' in '+Z.mod(m.type).n);return b[1]}
function groupSpot(w,h,x,y){const hit=(px,py)=>st.modules.some(o=>px<X(o)+W+18&&px+w+18>X(o)&&py<o.y+M.nodeHeight(o)+18&&py+h+18>o.y);
  for(let k=0;k<40;k++){const dx=k*(W+36);for(let dy=0;dy<=1800;dy+=GRID)if(!hit(x+dx,y+dy))return{x:x+dx,y:y+dy}}return{x,y}}
// dry run of a combo on page P (on a copy of the patch): true when one of its modules would not fit completely
function comboTight(tpl,swKind,P,replace){const keep=st;st=unpack(pack(st));let tight=false;
  try{if(replace)removeModules(replace.map(m=>st.modules.find(x=>x.uid===m.uid)).filter(Boolean));
    for(const d of tpl.mods){let t=d.t,swOpts=null;if(t==='SW'){t=swKind==='euro'?euroPb().t:SW_KIND[swKind].t;swOpts=tpl.sw}if(M.isEuro(t))continue;
      const m=M.newModule(st,t);if(d.o)for(const[n,v]of Object.entries(d.o))setOptByName(m,n,v);if(swOpts)for(const[n,v]of Object.entries(swOpts))if(n!=='startOn')setOptByName(m,n,v);
      // only the switch placeholder goes to the left footswitch; explicit stompswitch modules keep theirs (0.428: the looper combo had all three on the left)
    if(d.t==='SW'&&swKind==='zoia')setOptByName(m,'stompswitch','left');const f=M.place(st,m,P+(d.pg||0));if(!f||f.cut||f.overlap)tight=true;st.modules.push(m)}}
  finally{st=keep}return tight}
// forcePage: starters (their own pages). A combo decides its page here (targetPage / popup) and then comes back with decided = true.
function insertTemplate(tpl,swKind,forcePage,replace,decided){
  if(!replace){const kinds=new Set(tpl.mods.map(d=>d.t===54||d.t===55?'cv':(d.t===44||d.t==='SW'&&swKind==='zoia')&&d.o&&d.o.stompswitch==='ext'?'ext':null).filter(Boolean));
    for(const k of kinds){const cl=cportClash(k);if(cl.length){askCport(k,cl,()=>insertTemplate(tpl,swKind,forcePage,cl,decided));return}}}
  if(forcePage==null){const T=targetPage(),go=P=>insertTemplate(tpl,swKind,P,replace||[],true),lbl='['+tpl.name+']';
    if(T==null){const cnt=pageCount();for(let p=0;p<cnt;p++)if(!comboTight(tpl,swKind,p,replace))return go(p);
      if(cnt>=64)return toast(`No space left on any page for ${lbl}, and all 64 pages are in use.`,5000,'warn');
      return askRoom({what:lbl,combo:true,T:null,N:cnt,onNew:()=>go(cnt)})}
    if(!comboTight(tpl,swKind,T,replace))return go(T);
    const N=nextFreePage(T);if(N!=null)return askRoom({what:lbl,combo:true,T,N,onNew:()=>go(N)});
    const need=tpl.mods.filter(d=>d.t!=='SW'||swKind!=='euro').length;
    return toast(`${lbl} does not fit completely on page ${T}, and page ${T+1} is in use. Nothing was added: make room or choose another page.`,6000,'warn')}
  const page=forcePage;
  commit();if(replace)removeModules(replace);const made={},added=[],reused=[];
  let shared=false;for(const d of tpl.mods){let t=d.t,swOpts=null;if(t==='SW'){if(swKind==='euro'){const pb=euroPb();t=pb.t;shared=pb.shared}else t=SW_KIND[swKind].t;swOpts=tpl.sw}
    if(M.isEuro(t)){const ex=st.modules.find(o=>o.type===t);if(ex){if(swOpts&&!shared){for(const[n,v]of Object.entries(swOpts))if(n!=='startOn')setOptByName(ex,n,v);setLatchOn(ex,!!swOpts.startOn)}made[d.k]=ex;reused.push(ex);continue}} // Euroburo hardware exists only once: reuse it (a free pushbutton gets the action the block needs)
    const m=M.newModule(st,t);if(d.o)for(const[n,v]of Object.entries(d.o))setOptByName(m,n,v);
    if(swOpts){for(const[n,v]of Object.entries(swOpts))if(n!=='startOn')setOptByName(m,n,v);setLatchOn(m,!!swOpts.startOn)}
    if(d.latch!=null)setLatchOn(m,!!d.latch); // explicit start state of a latching button in a template
    if(d.t==='SW'&&swKind==='zoia')setOptByName(m,'stompswitch','left');
    // Starters and Combos keep the parameter values they were designed and tested with (ZoE's defaults before 0.407)
    Object.assign(m.params,Z.mod(t).zdef||{},d.p||{});m.name=d.n||''; // options first: they decide how many grid buttons it needs
    // 0.427: a Starter (not decided by the user in the placement popup) never puts a module on top of another: it goes to the next page with room
    if(!M.isEuro(t)){let pg=page+(d.pg||0);while(!M.place(st,m,pg)&&!decided&&pg<63)pg++}
    st.modules.push(m);made[d.k]=m;added.push([m,d])}
  // canvas: the group from left to right in signal order, at a free spot near the middle of the view
  // rows are shared across columns (row height = tallest module in that row), so a module in row 1 never sits in the path of row 0
  const colW=W+72,cols=Math.max(0,...added.map(([,d])=>d.c))+1,rows=Math.max(0,...added.map(([,d])=>d.r||0))+1;
  const rowH=[...Array(rows).keys()].map(i=>Math.max(0,...added.filter(([,d])=>(d.r||0)===i).map(([m])=>M.nodeHeight(m)))+28),rowY=i=>rowH.slice(0,i).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);
  // column spacing is set in unstretched model coordinates, so the group keeps its gaps at every <> / >< step
  const k=spreadK(),r=stage.getBoundingClientRect(),o0=toWorld(r.left+r.width/2-(cols*colW*k)/2,r.top+r.height/3),gs=groupSpot((cols*colW-72)*k,rowY(rows)-28,snapV(o0.x),snapV(o0.y));
  for(const[m,d] of added){m.x=snapV(gs.x)/k+d.c*colW;m.y=snapV(gs.y+rowY(d.r||0))}
  for(const[a,b,db,star] of tpl.conns){const[ka,ba]=a.split('.'),[kb,bb]=b.split('.'),A=made[ka],B=made[kb];
    const c={uid:M.uid(),sm:A.uid,sb:blockPos(A,ba),dm:B.uid,db:blockPos(B,bb),st:db==null?10000:Math.round(10000+100*db)};st.conns.push(c);if(star)st.stars.push({conn:c.uid,cc:-1,rest:0})}
  // 0.430: an input the template connects starts at 0 (the cable is the full control) unless the template sets it; ZoE's old defaults (zdef, often 0.5) added an offset to the cable's signal
  for(const[,b] of tpl.conns){const[kb,bb]=b.split('.'),B=made[kb],d=tpl.mods.find(x=>x.k===kb);if(!B||reused.includes(B)||(d.p&&bb in d.p)||!(bb in B.params))continue;B.params[bb]=0}
  for(const[m,d] of added)for(const pn of d.star||[])st.stars.push({m:m.uid,b:blockPos(m,pn),cc:-1});
  if(tpl.pages)tpl.pages.forEach((n,i)=>{while(st.pages.length<=page+i)st.pages.push('');if(!st.pages[page+i])st.pages[page+i]=n});
  sel=null;if(decided&&page!==targetPage())showPage(page);renderAll();
  const pages=[...new Set(added.filter(([m])=>!M.isEuro(m.type)).map(([m])=>m.page))];
  const cutN=decided?added.filter(([m])=>!M.isEuro(m.type)&&M.hiddenByPageEnd(m).length).length:0;
  if(cutN)return toast('['+tpl.name+'] added on page '+page+': '+cutN+' module'+(cutN>1?'s run':' runs')+' past the end of the page, '+(cutN>1?'their':'its')+' last blocks are hidden as on the ZOIA (see the Module Inspector).',6000,'warn');
  toast('['+tpl.name+'] added: '+added.length+' module'+(added.length===1?'':'s')+(pages.length?' on page '+pages.join(', '):'')+(reused.length?'; uses the existing '+reused.map(m=>Z.mod(m.type).n.replace(/^euro /,'')).join(', ')+(shared?' (both pushbuttons were already in use, so it now controls several things)':''):'')+'.',shared?7000:4500)}

let tourI=-1;const tourEls=[];
// one frame per row: when a group wraps onto several toolbar lines (narrow window), each line gets its own frame
function tourRects(sels){const boxes=[];for(const q of sels){const e=$(q);if(!e)continue;const t=e.closest('label.grp')||e;if(t.offsetParent===null&&getComputedStyle(t).position!=='fixed')continue;const b=t.getBoundingClientRect();if(!b.width&&!b.height)continue;boxes.push(b)}
  const rows=[];for(const b of boxes){const r=rows.find(r=>b.top<r.y1-2&&b.bottom>r.y0+2);if(r){r.x0=Math.min(r.x0,b.left);r.y0=Math.min(r.y0,b.top);r.x1=Math.max(r.x1,b.right);r.y1=Math.max(r.y1,b.bottom)}else rows.push({x0:b.left,y0:b.top,x1:b.right,y1:b.bottom})}
  const p=5;return rows.map(r=>{const x0=Math.max(2,r.x0-p),y0=Math.max(2,r.y0-p),x1=Math.min(innerWidth-2,r.x1+p),y1=Math.min(innerHeight-2,r.y1+p);return{x:x0,y:y0,w:x1-x0,h:y1-y0}})}
function tourClose(){tourI=-1;tourEls.forEach(e=>e.remove());tourEls.length=0;document.removeEventListener('keydown',tourKey,true);removeEventListener('resize',tourDraw);['#left','#right'].forEach(q=>$(q).classList.toggle('open',!!tourPanels[q]))} // side panels go back to how they were before the tour
let tourPanels={};
function tourKey(e){if(tourI<0)return;e.stopPropagation();
  const box=document.querySelector('.tourbox'),btns=box?[...box.querySelectorAll('button')]:[];
  if(e.key==='Tab'){e.preventDefault();const i=btns.indexOf(document.activeElement);const n=btns.length;if(n)btns[((i<0?(e.shiftKey?0:-1):i)+(e.shiftKey?-1:1)+n)%n].focus();return} // keyboard focus stays inside the tour window
  if((e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' ')&&btns.includes(document.activeElement)&&document.activeElement.id!=='tNext')return; // Enter/Space on Close or Previous does what that button says
  if(e.key===' '&&!btns.includes(document.activeElement)){e.preventDefault();return}
  if(e.key==='Escape'){e.preventDefault();tourClose()}else if(e.key==='ArrowRight'||e.key==='Enter'){e.preventDefault();tourGo(tourI+1)}else if(e.key==='ArrowLeft'){e.preventDefault();tourGo(tourI-1)}}
function tourGo(i){i=(i+TOUR.length)%TOUR.length;tourI=i; // wraps around in both directions
  if(innerWidth<=980){$('#left').classList.toggle('open',TOUR[i][0]==='Modules Inventory');$('#right').classList.toggle('open',TOUR[i][0]==='Inspector')} // small screens: open the side panel being explained
  tourDraw()}

  const [name,groups,text]=TOUR[tourI],rects=groups.flatMap(tourRects);
  const NS='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg',svg=document.createElementNS(NS,'svg');svg.setAttribute('class','tourmask');
  svg.innerHTML=`<defs><mask id="tourHoles"><rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="#fff"/>${rects.map(r=>`<rect x="${r.x}" y="${r.y}" width="${r.w}" height="${r.h}" rx="9" fill="#000"/>`).join('')}</mask></defs><rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="rgba(0,0,0,.5)" mask="url(#tourHoles)"/>`;
  document.body.appendChild(svg);tourEls.push(svg);
  for(const r of rects){const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='tourhl';Object.assign(d.style,{left:r.x+'px',top:r.y+'px',width:r.w+'px',height:r.h+'px'});document.body.appendChild(d);tourEls.push(d)}
  const box=document.createElement('div');box.className='tourbox';box.setAttribute('role','dialog');box.setAttribute('aria-modal','true');box.setAttribute('aria-label','Tour: '+name);
  box.innerHTML=`<div class="thead"><div><span class="tstep">Tour · ${tourI+1} / ${TOUR.length}</span><h2>${name}</h2></div><div class="tnav"><button type="button" class="btn" id="tBack" title="Previous step (←); from the first step it goes to the last">Previous</button><button type="button" class="btn primary" id="tNext" title="Next step (→); from the last step it starts over">Next</button></div></div>${text.map(l=>`<p>${l}</p>`).join('')}<div class="tbtns"><span class="tdots">${TOUR.map((_,k)=>`<i class="${k===tourI?'on':''}"></i>`).join('')}</span><button type="button" class="btn" id="tClose">Close</button></div>`;
  document.body.appendChild(box);tourEls.push(box);
  // always the same place: centred, with a fixed top edge so the window does not jump between steps of different length;
  // the top edge leaves room for the longest step (measured once per window size)
  if(tourDraw.size!==innerWidth+'x'+innerHeight){const keep=box.innerHTML;let mh=0;for(const [,,tx] of TOUR){box.innerHTML=keep.replace(/<p>[\s\S]*<div class="tbtns">/,tx.map(l=>`<p>${l}</p>`).join('')+'<div class="tbtns">');mh=Math.max(mh,box.offsetHeight)}box.innerHTML=keep;tourDraw.maxH=mh;tourDraw.size=innerWidth+'x'+innerHeight}
  box.style.left=Math.max(16,(innerWidth-box.offsetWidth)/2)+'px';{const top=Math.max(16,Math.min(Math.round((innerHeight-420)/2),innerHeight-tourDraw.maxH-16));box.style.top=top+'px';box.style.maxHeight=(innerHeight-top-16)+'px';box.style.overflowY='auto'}
  box.querySelector('#tClose').onclick=tourClose;box.querySelector('#tBack').onclick=()=>tourGo(tourI-1);box.querySelector('#tNext').onclick=()=>tourGo(tourI+1);box.querySelector('#tNext').focus()}

// file name as the device writes it (firmware 5.41: "%03d_zoia_%s.bin", "." " " "-" become "_"); characters a file system
// does not allow (only in names ZoE did not type) also become "_"
function fileBase(){return String(st.slot).padStart(3,'0')+'_zoia_'+String(st.name||'').replace(/[ .\-\/\\:*?"<>|\x00-\x1f]/g,'_')} // only safe characters in file names (no folders, no tricks)
async function offerFile(filename,data){
  try{const url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([data]));const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download=filename;document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();a.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),4000);toast('Downloading '+filename+'.');return true}
  catch(e){toast('Saving is not possible in this view.',5000,'warn');return false}
}

// ---------- zip (store only) ----------
const CRC=(()=>{const t=new Uint32Array(256);for(let n=0;n<256;n++){let c=n;for(let k=0;k<8;k++)c=c&1?0xedb88320^(c>>>1):c>>>1;t[n]=c>>>0}return t})();
const crc32=u=>{let c=0xffffffff;for(let i=0;i<u.length;i++)c=CRC[(c^u[i])&255]^(c>>>8);return(c^0xffffffff)>>>0};
function zipStore(files){
  const parts=[],central=[];let off=0;
  for(const[name,data]of files){const nb=new TextEncoder().encode(name),crc=crc32(data);
    const h=new DataView(new ArrayBuffer(30));h.setUint32(0,0x04034b50,true);h.setUint16(4,20,true);h.setUint16(8,0,true);h.setUint16(10,0,true);h.setUint16(12,0x21,true);h.setUint32(14,crc,true);h.setUint32(18,data.length,true);h.setUint32(22,data.length,true);h.setUint16(26,nb.length,true);
    parts.push(new Uint8Array(h.buffer),nb,data);
    const c=new DataView(new ArrayBuffer(46));c.setUint32(0,0x02014b50,true);c.setUint16(4,20,true);c.setUint16(6,20,true);c.setUint16(14,0x21,true);c.setUint32(16,crc,true);c.setUint32(20,data.length,true);c.setUint32(24,data.length,true);c.setUint16(28,nb.length,true);c.setUint32(42,off,true);
    central.push(new Uint8Array(c.buffer),nb);off+=30+nb.length+data.length}
  const csize=central.reduce((a,b)=>a+b.length,0);const e=new DataView(new ArrayBuffer(22));e.setUint32(0,0x06054b50,true);e.setUint16(8,files.length,true);e.setUint16(10,files.length,true);e.setUint32(12,csize,true);e.setUint32(16,off,true);
  const all=[...parts,...central,new Uint8Array(e.buffer)];const out=new Uint8Array(all.reduce((a,b)=>a+b.length,0));let p=0;for(const a of all){out.set(a,p);p+=a.length}return out;
}
// reads all .bin files of a .zip (stored or deflated), using the central directory
// inflate at most max bytes: the stream is cancelled as soon as more would come out
async function inflateMax(raw,max){const rd=new Blob([raw]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream('deflate-raw')).getReader();const parts=[];let n=0;
  try{for(;;){const {done,value}=await rd.read();if(done)break;n+=value.length;if(n>max){await rd.cancel();return null}parts.push(value)}}catch(e){return null}
  const out=new Uint8Array(n);let o=0;for(const p of parts){out.set(p,o);o+=p.length}return out}
async function unzipBins(u){const dv=new DataView(u.buffer,u.byteOffset,u.byteLength);let e=-1;
  for(let p=u.length-22;p>=Math.max(0,u.length-65558);p--)if(dv.getUint32(p,true)===0x06054b50){e=p;break}
  if(e<0)throw new Error('Not a valid .zip file.');
  const n=dv.getUint16(e+10,true);let p=dv.getUint32(e+16,true);const out=[];
  if(n>512)throw new Error('This .zip holds too many files for a patch bank.');
  for(let k=0;k<n&&p+46<=u.length;k++){if(dv.getUint32(p,true)!==0x02014b50)break;
    const method=dv.getUint16(p+10,true),cs=dv.getUint32(p+20,true),us=dv.getUint32(p+24,true),nl=dv.getUint16(p+28,true),xl=dv.getUint16(p+30,true),cl=dv.getUint16(p+32,true),lo=dv.getUint32(p+42,true);
    const name=new TextDecoder().decode(u.slice(p+46,p+46+nl));p+=46+nl+xl+cl;
    if(!/\.bin$/i.test(name)||/(^|\/)(__MACOSX|\._)/.test(name)||us!==32768||cs>40000)continue; // a patch is always 32,768 bytes: anything else is skipped unread (no zip bombs)
    const s=lo+30+dv.getUint16(lo+26,true)+dv.getUint16(lo+28,true),raw=u.slice(s,s+cs);let data=null;
    if(method===0)data=raw;else if(method===8&&typeof DecompressionStream!=='undefined')data=await inflateMax(raw,32768);
    if(data&&data.length===32768)out.push({name,data})}
  return out}

// ---------- example patch ----------
function example(){
  const s=M.newState();st=s;s.name='Filter Wobble';s.slot=10;s.pages=['Wobble'];
  const add=(t,opts,name,params)=>{const m=M.newModule(s,t);(opts||[]).forEach((v,i)=>m.options[i]=v);if(name)m.name=name;Object.assign(m.params,params||{});M.place(s,m,0);s.modules.push(m);return m};
  const inp=add(1,[0]);const val=add(45,[0],'Rate',{value:14000});const lfo=add(5,[1],'Wobble');const flt=add(0,[0,0,0,0],'',{frequency:30000,resonance:22000});add(45,[0],'Depth',{value:40000}); /* deliberately left unconnected in the demo */const out=add(2,[0,0]);
  const P=(m,n)=>Z.mod(m.type).b.find(b=>b[0]===n)[1];
  const c=(a,an,b,bn,stv)=>s.conns.push({uid:M.uid(),sm:a.uid,sb:P(a,an),dm:b.uid,db:P(b,bn),st:stv||10000});
  c(inp,'output_L',flt,'audio_in');c(val,'cv_output',lfo,'cv_control');c(lfo,'output',flt,'frequency',pctToSt(35));c(flt,'lowpass_output',out,'input_L');c(flt,'lowpass_output',out,'input_R');
  M.autoLayout(s);
  s.stars.push({m:val.uid,b:P(val,'value'),cc:20});
  return s;
}

// ---------- J: jump between the ends of the selected connection ----------
let jumpEnd='start', jumpConn=null, jumpAnim=0;
function updateJump(){const b=$('#bJump');const on=!!(sel&&sel.kind==='c'&&connBy(sel.uid));b.disabled=!on;
  b.title=on?'Jump between the start and the end of the selected connection with each click (key: J). Next: '+(jumpConn===sel.uid&&jumpEnd==='start'?'end':'start')+'.':'Select a connection first. Then each click jumps between its start and its end (key: J).'}
// ---------- U: jump to the next unconnected module (always in the All pages view) ----------
function unconnected(){return st.modules.filter(isLoose).sort((a,b)=>(a.page-b.page)||(a.pos-b.pos))}
function updateUnconn(){const sb=$('#bStates');if(sb){const has=st.modules.some(hasKnownState);sb.disabled=!has;sb.title=has?'States: what the patch stores besides its parameter values, e.g. sequencer tracks or sample names.':'This patch stores no states (such as sequencer tracks or sample names).'}const n=unconnected().length,b=$('#bUnconn');b.disabled=!n;b.title=n?`Jump to the next unused module (key: U). ${n} unused. Switches to All pages.`:'All modules that need a connection are connected.';
  const t=cutmTargets(),c=$('#bCutm');c.disabled=!t.del.length;c.title=t.del.length?`Clean up the mess: delete all unused modules in the current view (${t.del.length})`:t.keep.length?'Nothing to delete: the only unused modules in the current view are starred (MIDI/encoder controls).':'Nothing to delete: no unused modules in the current view.'}
function jumpUnconn(){const L=unconnected();if(!L.length)return;
  const i=sel&&sel.kind==='m'?L.findIndex(m=>m.uid===sel.uid):-1,m=L[(i+1)%L.length];
  pageFilter=-1;sel={kind:'m',uid:m.uid};renderAll();
  const r=stage.getBoundingClientRect(),v=st.view,tx=r.width/2-(X(m)+W/2)*v.k,ty=r.height/2-(m.y+M.nodeHeight(m)/2)*v.k,fx=v.x,fy=v.y,t0=performance.now();
  const reduce=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;cancelAnimationFrame(jumpAnim);
  const step=t=>{const q=reduce?1:Math.min(1,(t-t0)/260),e=1-Math.pow(1-q,3);v.x=fx+(tx-fx)*e;v.y=fy+(ty-fy)*e;applyView();if(q<1)jumpAnim=requestAnimationFrame(step);else{const el=nodesEl.querySelector(`.node[data-uid="${m.uid}"]`);if(el){el.classList.remove('flash');void el.offsetWidth;el.classList.add('flash');setTimeout(()=>el.classList.remove('flash'),1300)}}};
  jumpAnim=requestAnimationFrame(step);
  toast(`[${mlabel(m)}] · unused ${L.indexOf(m)+1} of ${L.length}`,2200)}
$('#bUnconn').onclick=jumpUnconn;
function jumpWire(){
  if(!(sel&&sel.kind==='c'))return;const c=connBy(sel.uid);if(!c)return;
  jumpEnd=(jumpConn===c.uid&&jumpEnd==='start')?'end':'start';jumpConn=c.uid;
  const m=byUid(jumpEnd==='start'?c.sm:c.dm);if(!m)return;
  const p=portXY(m,jumpEnd==='start'?c.sb:c.db,jumpEnd==='start'?'out':'in');
  const r=stage.getBoundingClientRect(),v=st.view,tx=r.width/2-p.x*v.k,ty=r.height/2-p.y*v.k,fx=v.x,fy=v.y,t0=performance.now();
  const reduce=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;cancelAnimationFrame(jumpAnim);
  const step=t=>{const q=reduce?1:Math.min(1,(t-t0)/260),e=1-Math.pow(1-q,3);v.x=fx+(tx-fx)*e;v.y=fy+(ty-fy)*e;applyView();if(q<1)jumpAnim=requestAnimationFrame(step);else flashPort(m.uid,jumpEnd==='start'?c.sb:c.db,jumpEnd==='start'?'out':'in')};
  jumpAnim=requestAnimationFrame(step);
  toast((jumpEnd==='start'?'Start: ':'End: ')+'['+mlabel(m)+'] · '+(x=>x?bl(m,x[0]):'#')(Z.mod(m.type).b.find(x=>x[1]===(jumpEnd==='start'?c.sb:c.db))),2000);updateJump();
}
function flashPort(uid,pos,dir){const el=nodesEl.querySelector(`.node[data-uid="${uid}"] .port[data-port="${dir}"][data-pos="${pos}"]`)||nodesEl.querySelector(`.node[data-uid="${uid}"]`);if(!el)return;el.classList.remove('flash');void el.offsetWidth;el.classList.add('flash');setTimeout(()=>el.classList.remove('flash'),1300)}

// ---------- cutm: clean up the mess ----------
function cutmTargets(){
  const starred=new Set(st.stars.filter(x=>x.m).map(x=>x.m));
  const inView=m=>pageFilter<0||m.page===pageFilter;
  const unwired=st.modules.filter(m=>inView(m)&&isLoose(m));
  return {del:unwired.filter(m=>!starred.has(m.uid)),keep:unwired.filter(m=>starred.has(m.uid))};
}
$('#bCutm').onclick=()=>{
  const t=cutmTargets();
  if(!t.del.length){toast(t.keep.length?'Nothing to delete. The only unused modules are starred (MIDI/encoder controls).':'Nothing to delete. Every module in the current view is in use.',4200);return}
  const where=pageFilter<0?'all pages':pageName(pageFilter);
  $('#cutmInfo').textContent=t.del.length+' module'+(t.del.length>1?'s':'')+' on '+where+': '+t.del.slice(0,8).map(m=>'['+mlabel(m)+']').join(', ')+(t.del.length>8?' …':'')+'.'+(t.keep.length?' '+t.keep.length+' starred module(s) are kept.':'')+' You can undo with Ctrl+Z.';
  cutmMark(t.del);$('#cutmDlg').hidden=false;$('#cutmNo').focus();
};
function cutmMark(L){document.querySelectorAll('.node.cutx').forEach(n=>n.classList.remove('cutx'));for(const m of L||[]){const n=document.querySelector(`.node[data-uid="${m.uid}"]`);if(n)n.classList.add('cutx')}}

// ---------- light / dark ----------
const MOON='<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20.2 14.6A8.5 8.5 0 0 1 9.4 3.8a8.5 8.5 0 1 0 10.8 10.8z"/></svg>';

const GRID=18; // modules always snap to the background grid
function snapV(v){return Math.round(v/GRID)*GRID}

// ---------- mouse wheel on inspector sliders: 1 % of the range per notch (Shift: 0.1 %); connection strength in 0.5 dB steps ----------
$('#insp').addEventListener('wheel',e=>{const r=e.target.closest('input[type=range]');if(!r)return;e.preventDefault();
  const min=+r.min,max=+r.max,dir=e.deltaY<0?1:-1;
  const step=r.id==='cSt'?(e.shiftKey?10:50):Math.max(1,Math.round((max-min)/(e.shiftKey?1000:100)));
  const v=Math.max(min,Math.min(max,(+r.value)+dir*step));if(v===+r.value)return;
  r.value=v;r.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));clearTimeout(r._wt);r._wt=setTimeout(()=>r.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})),400)},{passive:false});
// ---------- find: pick exactly one module and zoom to it ----------
let findHits=[],findIdx=0;
function findMatches(q){q=q.trim().toLowerCase();if(!q)return[];
  // 0.501 (user 2026-10-18): a place as ZoE shows it: "p0 b14" = page 0, button 14 (P0·B14); pages count from 0 like everywhere
  const pc=/^p(?:age)?\s*(\d+)(?:\s*[,·]?\s*b(?:utton)?\s*(\d+))?$/.exec(q);
  const hits=st.modules.filter(m=>{if(pc){if(m.page!==+pc[1])return false;if(pc[2]==null)return true;const n=M.visible(m).length;return +pc[2]-1>=m.pos&&+pc[2]-1<m.pos+n}
    const d=Z.mod(m.type);return mlabel(m).toLowerCase().includes(q)||d.n.toLowerCase().includes(q)||(m.page===M.EURO_PAGE&&'euroburo'.includes(q))});
  return hits.sort((a,b)=>(a.page-b.page)||(a.pos-b.pos)).slice(0,50)}
function renderFind(){const L=$('#findList');
  if(!$('#findIn').value.trim()){L.innerHTML='';return}
  if(!findHits.length){L.innerHTML='<div class="none">No module found.</div>';return}
  L.innerHTML=findHits.map((m,i)=>{const d=Z.mod(m.type);return`<button type="button" role="option" data-i="${i}" class="${i===findIdx?'on':''}"><span class="fn">${glyph('mod',COLORS[m.color]?COLORS[m.color][1]:'var(--line-2)')}<span>[${esc(mlabel(m))}]${m.name&&m.name!==d.n?' · '+esc(d.n):''}${devBadge(m.type)} <span class="fc">· ${esc(d.c)}</span></span></span><span class="fl">${m.page===M.EURO_PAGE?'Euroburo Interfaces':'Page '+m.page+', Button '+(m.pos+1)}</span></button>`}).join('');
  const on=L.querySelector('.on');if(on)on.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'})}
function openFind(){$('#findBox').hidden=false;const i=$('#findIn');i.value='';findHits=[];findIdx=0;renderFind();i.focus()}
function closeFind(){$('#findBox').hidden=true}
function chooseFind(m){closeFind();if(!m)return;pageFilter=-1;sel={kind:'m',uid:m.uid};renderAll();
  const r=stage.getBoundingClientRect(),v=st.view,k=Math.max(v.k,1.3),tx=r.width/2-(X(m)+W/2)*k,ty=r.height/2-(m.y+M.nodeHeight(m)/2)*k,fx=v.x,fy=v.y,fk=v.k,t0=performance.now();
  const reduce=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;cancelAnimationFrame(jumpAnim);
  const step=t=>{const q=reduce?1:Math.min(1,(t-t0)/320),e=1-Math.pow(1-q,3);v.k=fk+(k-fk)*e;v.x=fx+(tx-fx)*e;v.y=fy+(ty-fy)*e;applyView();if(q<1)jumpAnim=requestAnimationFrame(step);else{const el=nodesEl.querySelector(`.node[data-uid="${m.uid}"]`);if(el){el.classList.remove('flash');void el.offsetWidth;el.classList.add('flash');setTimeout(()=>el.classList.remove('flash'),1300)}}};
  jumpAnim=requestAnimationFrame(step)}
$('#bFind').onclick=()=>$('#findBox').hidden?openFind():closeFind();
$('#findIn').addEventListener('input',()=>{findHits=findMatches($('#findIn').value);findIdx=0;renderFind()});
$('#findIn').addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  if(e.key==='Escape'){e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();closeFind()}
  else if(e.key==='ArrowDown'||e.key==='ArrowUp'){e.preventDefault();if(findHits.length){findIdx=(findIdx+(e.key==='ArrowDown'?1:findHits.length-1))%findHits.length;renderFind()}}
  else if(e.key==='Enter'){e.preventDefault();chooseFind(findHits[findIdx])}});
$('#findList').addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('[data-i]');if(b){e.preventDefault();chooseFind(findHits[+b.dataset.i])}});
$('#findIn').addEventListener('blur',()=>setTimeout(()=>{if(document.activeElement!==$('#findIn'))closeFind()},150));

  if(fitMode&&signalMode()&&!gridView)fit()} // 0.448: Fit is a mode: in By signal it frames the new focus
document.querySelectorAll('#segFocus button').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>setFocus(b.dataset.f));
